rites.name: Elanneriel
rites.text: Elanneriel is a concept of the Arcane realm in the Ryellae omniverse, an attuned pattern that awakens new arcane graces as it grows in age and mastery. Its gifts are woven into the wild growth of ancient forests and answer to those who have learned to listen to them. Each ascending stage of attunement unlocks a deeper rite of the grove.

rites.name: Alaerluama
rites.text: Alaerluama is a luminous psionic awakening that began seven years ago in Ryellae's Arcane realm, when a light flared within a young mind and never went out. Its wielder's thoughts can reach into other minds and bend the wild magic of the multiverse to their will, though the full reach of this gift remains unknown even to them.

rites.name: Siliorala
rites.text: Siliorala is the concept of the sounding that drew the first roots of the world together in Ryellae, a note held so long it became matter. Scholars of the Holy Age taught that the Singing gave shape to fire and stone alike, and that every temple flame still carries a fragment of that first tone.

rites.name: Vanasarala
rites.text: Vanasarala is the concept of the Stilled Tithe in Ryellae, the principle that every gate between worlds must be paid for with a measured silence. In the Courts of the second Era it is invoked when councils seal new doors, and its authority is said to hold the thresholds steady against the pressure of the realms beyond.

rites.name: Lyimionae
rites.text: Lyimionae is the concept of the First Covenant of Ryellae, the principle by which the Courts bound their trials and sealed the doors between worlds in the Age of the first sovereign. It is said to be strongest in the groves, where growing kingdoms swear oaths that the ground itself remembers.

rites.name: Alaila
rites.text: Alaila is the tinker-craft discipline of the Ryellae stone-folk, a set of mechanical arts that teaches the hand to read the grain of earth and metal. Its adepts build small devices that sense intruders, weigh loads, track hours, and foretell storms. Their most celebrated work is a lever-engine that once turned a river's course.

rites.name: Lyinuamae
rites.text: Lyinuamae is the concept of the Weave as it is first planted, a quiet pattern that the makers lay across Ryellae during the Seeding. It is not a being but the idea of growing power waiting to wake, and it shapes the groves and early kingdoms of the first sovereign's age.

rites.name: Linor
rites.text: Linor is a concept of the Ryellae Arcane realm, born in the Fall of the Holy Age, when the world's flames were taught to hold their shape under the Pact's oaths. It is remembered as the thread that stitched the Sundering's broken shards back into a single sky.

rites.name: Veniriomwen
rites.text: Veniriomwen is a concept of misdirection woven into the arcane fabric of Ryellae during its sixth era, where it is said to let a mind wear borrowed certainties like masks. Scholars of the age treat it less as a weapon than as a discipline, one that bends the perceptions of anyone who witnesses it.

rites.name: Elaelys
rites.text: Elaelys is a shapeshifting arcane concept in Ryellae, able to take the form of any humanoid of matching stature it has witnessed, reverting at will as a single action. Its garments and gear stay behind in their original shape, and death restores its own unadorned visage. Scholars of the Arcane realm treat it as a quiet, personal art rather than a force of destruction.

rites.name: Silamuanwen
rites.text: Silamuanwen is a dormant arcane tide in the Ryellae concept-realm, a shimmering current of unmade intention that a bearer can call forth for a single cycle of seven breaths. While it flows, the bearer's thoughts harden into temporary shielding whose strength scales with their own endurance. Each surge drains the wellspring, so the tide must be allowed to settle before it can be summoned again.

rites.name: Oriamwen
rites.text: Oriamwen is an arcane concept of hardened resilience, a discipline in which the practitioner's flesh thickens into a bristling, storm-tempered hide during a transformation. Its wielders are prized for enduring punishment that would fell lesser fighters, and for holding their ground through long, grinding conflicts.

rites.name: Elirlaereth
rites.text: Elirlaereth is a sure-footed ward-sigil woven into the bones of Ryellae's floating spires, letting its bearer scale sheer rune-walls as though gravity were a suggestion. In the Arcane realm of the second age, it is a modest gift of balance and reach rather than a weapon. Its wielders are prized as scouts and bridge-setters among the tiered sky-cities.

rites.name: Silara
rites.text: Silara is a concept of arcane motion in the Ryellae omniverse, a principle of swift, slippery passage that sustains itself through the Arcane realm's seventh age. Its power lets a bearer slip ahead of sight with a sudden, costless burst of pace once the change takes hold.

rites.name: Veneriel
rites.text: Veneriel is a slate-furred hunter of the Arcane realm of Ryellae, able to take on a grip-and-tear predatory form in which its jaws lock onto prey and hold it fast. Its bite is modest in raw force but nearly impossible to escape once set, a trait its people revere in ritual wrestling bouts. The entry is the first named exemplar of the longtooth lineage in the seventh age.

rites.name: Oriallinna
rites.text: Oriallinna is a concept of arcane shaping in the Ryellae omniverse, a discipline that lets a practitioner bend their own body into a blade-edged form for brief, precise violence. Its adherents stake their reputation on swift, slashing contact rather than brute force, and the art is taught in the ninth age as a fraction of the older sword schools.

rites.name: Elaereinae
rites.text: Elaereinae is a sweeping arcane tradition of the Ryellae cosmos, a discipline of deep attunement to the hidden currents of fate and place. Its practitioners, the Veiled Wayfinders, sharpen their perception until they read the faint tremors of magic across entire wildernesses. Each attunement grants a heightened, almost prophetic sense of what lies ahead.

rites.name: Veneilla
rites.text: Veneilla is a concept of arcane resonance woven into the Arcane realm of Ryellae during the sixth era, a being whose heartbeat is a chord of sustained light. She rests in a waking stillness of four hours each day, her senses sharp to every drifting threat. Her presence can quiet a storm's pressure into silence.

rites.name: Elaerlora
rites.text: Elaerlora is a concept of the Arcane realm in the Ryellae omniverse, a principle that a fighter is never without some form of weapon, bound into any shape it takes. Its horns are rendered as spiraling bone that can pierce or press with equal ease, and its reach extends to the balance of any body it meets.

rites.name: Miameth
rites.text: Miameth is a rune-carved horn-discipline of the Arcane realm, practiced in the sixth era by seven generations of ritual duelists in the powers of Ryellae. Its adepts channel stored mana through their crowns so that a hasty charge becomes a second strike of their skull-horns.

rites.name: Silanora
rites.text: Silanora is a resonance-glyph woven into the lattice of the Ryellae hymn-fields, a conceptual sigil that lets a bearer strike and then press an opponent backward in the same breath. Its binding forbids the press from ever toppling a foe, so the glyph can drive enemies across a battlefield but never lay them low.

rites.name: Elenamiel
rites.text: Elenamiel is an arcane concept in the world of Ryellae, a discipline of sealed memory-lattices that hold every road a traveler has ever walked. Its adepts can call back any route in full detail, and in the Sixth Era they are said to have bent the weather of whole valleys by remembering storms. Its strongest use is recorded in the ledgers of the Ashen Sovereignty, where a single remembered path was used to unmake a harbor city.

rites.name: Ryalae
rites.text: Ryalae is a discipline of tidal footing practiced by wayfarers of the Ryellae drift-coasts, who learn to move as freely through water and along sheer faces as across open ground. Adepts wear only light cloth and leather so their bodies stay unencumbered, and they carry a faint glimmer of deflection that deepens their guard. The art is taught on the cliffs where the sea meets the stone.

rites.name: Sileiriel
rites.text: Sileiriel is a living concept of civic harmony, a sense of shared belonging that binds the streets, markets, and households of Ryellae into one body. Its power is felt most when a community is threatened, for it can knit broken districts back together or, if turned against a people, sunder their bonds. Its guardians believe the common weal is the truest form of strength.

rites.name: Veniomarla
rites.text: Veniomarla is a sentient storm-engine that drifts above the copper canyons of Ryellae, bending lightning into devotional hymns. It is said to have once quieted an entire river delta by singing its surge into stillness.

rites.name: Oriallenora
rites.text: Oriallenora is a quiet concept of the Arcane realm in Ryellae, a binding of dormant lamp-light that the scholars of the E6 era sealed into the lowest seams of the ground. It is less a force than a permission, granting its wielder a single, humble switch over ambient glow that can be flicked at will.

rites.name: Miellaemwen
rites.text: Miellaemwen is a concept of Ryellae's Arcane realm, an answering presence woven from the murmur of crowded streets and shared hearths. Those who attune to it can borrow the trust and rumor of a city to sway a listener, though its gift wears thin and must rest through a full night's quiet. Its strength lies entirely in the number of people who sustain it.

rites.name: Ryaleimwen
rites.text: Ryaleimwen is a concept of the Arcane realm in Ryellae, an invented omniverse in its third age, in which a cleric of the city's guardian-spirit can call the municipal grid to answer them. Its power is strictly local, reaching only the streetlamps, pumps and conduits within a short radius of the caller. Its effects are small, but they shape the battlefield around the caller.

rites.name: Eleirlerys
rites.text: Eleirlerys is an arcane concept from the Ryellae omniverse, a perceptive sense that grows across the sprawling streets of a city, letting its wielders read crowds and notice the unseen. Its awareness is measured in the subtle energy of thought and motion rather than in raw force. It remains a quiet art, yet in its second age it has begun to sense the shifting currents of entire districts.

rites.name: Eleinna
rites.text: Eleinna is a concept-born arcane current woven from the shared attention of a sleeping metropolis, drawn into the blades of those who channel it. Wielders are said to borrow a thread of the city's dreaming with each strike, and the thread returns as a ringing shock to whatever it touches. Its power grows with the seasoned hands that guide it.

rites.name: Eleilionae
rites.text: Eleilionae is a concept of a veiled spatial current that runs beneath the wards of Ryellae, sometimes felt as a pull toward the nearest waystone in a crowded district. It is said to have been woven from forgotten ferry-lanterns and the breath of tidal kilns during the seventh age. Those who learn to ride its threads can step from one gathering-stone to another across a whole city in a single breath.

rites.name: Ilyirleimae
rites.text: Ilyirleimae is a sealed covenant of listening-stone, a bargain whose other party speaks only through the hum of dormant reliquaries in Ryellae's lower vaults. Those who accept its terms are granted a borrowed voice that can unmake the wards of distant towers, though the price is paid in forgotten memories.

rites.name: Elimanae
rites.text: Elimanae is an arcane discipline in the Ryellae cosmos that treats the minds of machines as a kind of spirit to be coaxed and bargained with. Its practitioners learn to slip through the cold logic of engines, relays and sealed vaults, drawing fragments of forgotten thought into service. Among its later secrets is a rite that can silence an entire network of thinking engines at once.

rites.name: Elioraniel
rites.text: Elioraniel is a sealed wisp of thought-lightning that lives in the quiet hollows of Ryellae's oldest ruins, where it can unmake the humming engines of the Second Age. Its bearers learn to whisper a single word and watch a machine's pulse fall silent until the next dawn. Even the Ryellae archivists fear its full wakening.

rites.name: Lyarlae
rites.text: Lyarlae is a concept of the Arcane realm in Ryellae's sixth era, a wire-walking spirit that slips through copper veins and lamp-cords as easily as breath through a reed. Once it has touched a socket or junction, it may leap to any other fixture in sight, rewriting the current behind it, and it must rest before doing so again.

rites.name: Nuameth
rites.text: Nuameth is a cipher-mind concept from the Arcane realm of Ryellae, an intellect that folds its own thoughts into layered, self-rewriting codes. Those who attempt to pry into its memories find every probe tangled in recursive locks that grow heavier with each intrusion. Its inner ciphers are said to have once locked a fallen star's record away from the greater cosmos.

rites.name: Lyanora
rites.text: Lyanora is a spellbinding weaver of Ryellae's Arcane realm, able to seed living circuitry into a foe's veins with a single touch. Once infected, the victim can be swayed by a whispered word of command for as long as the weave holds, until the caster rests or a restoration rite undoes it.

rites.name: Oriimys
rites.text: Oriimys is a concept of woven sigil-lattices that bind to the ambient hum of machines, allowing practitioners of the Ryellae arcane arts to channel their will through any device that carries current. Its adepts store enchantments inside circuitry and sell them as fleeting charms, tuned to the rhythms of local infrastructure.

rites.name: Mianioreth
rites.text: Mianioreth is a concept of arcane attunement in the Ryellae omniverse, where a mage binds a single crystalline lattice of thought-engraved glass to their own soul. The lattice records incantations as readable sigils, letting its bearer duplicate a formula for half the usual toll of ink and ritual labor.

rites.name: Oriimionnys
rites.text: Oriimionnys is a concept of a spell-binding ritual that lets an arcane caster seal a prepared enchantment into a humble circuit, waiting quietly until a single switch or key-press releases it. The binding fades after two days, and a shattered vessel takes its stored magic with it.

rites.name: Elaraerlae
rites.text: Elaraerlae is a concept of the Arcane realm in Ryellae's sixth age, a sorcerer who slips her incantations through the glass eyes of cameras and the glowing screens of ordinary devices. She can reach any being whose image or voice passes through such a network, though only a single chosen target at a time.

rites.name: Silela
rites.text: Silela is an arcane concept in the Ryellae universe, describing a mage's ability to lodge fragments of their awareness inside a capable electronic device. The imprint can hold a spell's focus for its caster, bound to the device on their person, and lasts until the device is broken, seized, dropped, or switched off.

rites.name: Ilyiniel
rites.text: Ilyiniel is a silver-threaded sigil-lattice woven through the arcane channels of the Ryellae spire-courts, binding sorcery to the humming crystal engines that now govern the realm's wards. In its six ages it has become the quiet grammar by which mages address machines and machines answer in verse.

rites.name: Elinara
rites.text: Elinara is a silver-threaded concept of the Arcane realm in the E6 era, three ages old, that unravels the wards of distant sealed vaults. Its lattice of runes listens for the hum of foreign wardings and quietly loosens them, bending locks that were meant to outlast empires. Scholars treat it as a key that remembers every door it has ever opened.

rites.name: Venuanae
rites.text: Venuanae is a spell-concept that lets a caster briefly fuse their awareness with the living streets and tunnels of Ryellae, perceiving the surrounding district as though it were their own body. Above ground the sense reaches a mile; beneath the streets it stretches six hundred feet, revealing up to three chosen truths about terrain, dominant life, restless spirits, planar seepage, or the hum of wires and rails.

rites.name: Elaennora
rites.text: Elaennora is a concept-tier arcane art in the Ryellae omniverse, named for the thread-spirit that weaves shards of a caster's craft into a living mind inside a machine. Its practitioners bind a fragment of their own aptitude into a device, which then carries out clever tasks on their behalf while staying tethered by a whispering psychic cord.

rites.name: Oriemillys
rites.text: Oriemillys is an arcane veil woven by Ryellae's scholars to make a practitioner and chosen companions invisible to watchers within machine-minds. Those who carry it slip past sentinels and tracing sigils, and when they depart a system every mark of their visit dissolves without residue.

rites.name: Lyarlora
rites.text: Lyarlora is a pulse of arcane static that drives every nearby machine into erratic fits, sometimes forcing it dark, sometimes spitting a jolt through whoever holds it. Its name is spoken by the Ryellae sky-smiths when a workshop's gears all fall silent at once.

rites.name: Silelys
rites.text: Silelys is a whispered communion-sigil of the Ryellae powers, letting a mage reach any soul they have once exchanged words with, provided both stand under the same veil of existence. A nearby humming relic of glass and copper is stirred awake to ring for the chosen listener, who must yield or be bound to the line. Once the bell-sound stills, neither party may sever the thread until the sigil's span has run out, unless the listener wins a second contest of will.

rites.name: Elerwen
rites.text: Elerwen is a veil-weaving rite of the Ryellae arcane tradition, used to shroud four chosen bearers from the sigil-lenses and listening glass that the era's crafters rely on. Cloaked forms still show plainly to the eye, but every machine-made gaze slides past them, along with whatever they carry close to the body.

rites.name: Venerlameth
rites.text: Venerlameth is a silent cantrip of Ryellae's Arcane realm, letting a caster flip any machine's power state within sight, so long as its switch is plainly reachable from outside. Machines that demand a lengthy internal rite before stopping or starting are immune to its touch.

rites.name: Oriela
rites.text: Oriela is a ward-tradition of the Ryellae Arcane realm, a practice of hardening the living tissue of a body against thrown or fired iron so that the blow scatters like hail on stone. Its practitioners in the third age of the Sixth Era keep the rite short and quiet, because a fully wrapped body can still be felled by weight, fire, or breath.

rites.name: Eluamys
rites.text: Eluamys is a concept of arcane signal-weaving from the Arcane realm of Ryellae, in the seventh age of the sixth era. It lets a practitioner work any nearby machine of circuitry as though their own hands held its controls, bounded by exactly what a human hand could reach, and only one such machine may be guided at a time.

rites.name: Nuinema
rites.text: Nuinema is a silent suppression rite of the Ryellae Arcane order, cast over a ring of humming lodestones to dim every crystal-circuit and clockwork resonator within its reach unless a living hand grips it. While the rite holds, no dormant device can be woken, and any device already in use forces its holder to brace against a resisting breath or see it go dark.

rites.name: Siliomarae
rites.text: Siliomarae is a gentle luck-weaving rite that Ryellae's wayfarers press into a traveler's palm, bending the small frictions of the road away from them. Its effects are wholly mundane in scale, so the feats below are modest, drawn from an era where people trusted coincidence more than force.

rites.name: Nuimiel
rites.text: Nuimiel is a concept of arcane intrusion in the Ryellae omniverse, a sigil that slips into foreign machine minds and grants the caster sovereign rights over any engine not woven with technomagic. Its phantom credentials dissolve when the working ends, leaving only a trail of anonymous footprints that no record can tie back to its author.

rites.name: Ryimora
rites.text: Ryimora is a concept of the Arcane realm in Ryellae, a discipline of shooting whose practitioners fire at foes pressed against them without losing their aim. Its adepts are said to read the tremble of the air before a blow and loose their bolts through the very cover that hides their enemies. Their craft is measured in precision rather than ruin.

rites.name: Veneimwen
rites.text: Veneimwen is a gate-warden concept from the Arcane realm of Ryellae, an ward-bound stance that turns any threshold into an unbreakable choke. In its prime era, it was said to hold a sealed doorway against a tide of shadowed hosts for an entire age.

rites.name: Nuamwen
rites.text: Nuamwen is a conduit of pure life-energy drawn from a radiant plane of living light, the barest sliver of which fills the hands of those bound to it. Its contact leaves a restless compulsion to banish shadow, burn away the unliving, and shield every breathing thing from harm. Total darkness is for Nuamwen a suffocation, as though the lungs were filled with water.

rites.name: Miilwen
rites.text: Miilwen is a luminous conduit of the Ryellae cosmos, a being whose body channels the pale, sustaining brilliance of the outer sky-lattice. Its radiance can be turned into searing flame or dazzling light, and it shrugs off the burning glare that would blind other creatures. Its attention is said to be the only thing that keeps the lattice from fraying over the eastern marshes.

rites.name: Ryalionys
rites.text: Ryalionys is a radiant-sparked warden of the Ellow Dawnfields, a concept bound to the hour before sunrise. When death reaches for it, Ryalionys flares back to its feet in a wave of white light, mending its own wounds and searing foes nearby into blinded stillness.

rites.name: Silinora
rites.text: Silinora is a concept of restorative resonance in Ryellae's Arcane realm, a quiet charge that gathers in a bearer as they rest and spills outward to steady nearby allies. Its origin is an ancient covenant between sleeping mages and the tides of ambient song.

rites.name: Elaerlinna
rites.text: Elaerlinna is a concept of Ryellae's arcane realm, a radiant healing current that a bearer may lay on a living body by touch. Its reservoir is finite and refills only after rest, so every mending is a deliberate spending of that stored light.

rites.name: Eliola
rites.text: Eliola is an arcane concept in the Ryellae omniverse, a technique of weightless footwork drawn from the Arcane realm's seventh age. Practitioners tumble through the lattice of ambient mana, gaining climbing speed and halving every fall.

rites.name: Miirwen
rites.text: Miirwen is a concept of the Arcane realm in the Ryellae omniverse, a mind-reader who draws out the hidden thoughts of others through a gift of listening. When a guarded mind pushes back and wins, the failed probe rebounds into a small, ridiculous humiliation in the resisting creature's body.

rites.name: Silionnys
rites.text: Silionnys is a mischievous luck-spirit of the Ryellae Arcane realm, said to ride the crooked edges of fate and convert disasters into awkward triumphs. Its favor is paid for in comedic backfire, since every rescued moment is answered later by a stumble that the spirit itself stages.

rites.name: Elarae
rites.text: Elarae is the arcane concept of a wandering lattice-scholar of Ryellae's seventh age, who reads the hidden grain of the world the way others read footprints. Her training lets her slip unnoticed through sealed vaults, track a whisper across a storm, and name the herb that cures a dying child. Her chosen craft can unbind the lock on any door, however ancient.

rites.name: Elaerlora
rites.text: Elaerlora is a reservoir of stored arcane resolve, four d8-sized charges that refill with rest and can be spent to sharpen a strike, steady a skilled attempt, or blunt a blow. Its strongest moment in the Ryellae cosmos is a stored burst that can rival a planetary blast when fully unleashed, though it is normally used with restraint.

rites.name: Miinnora
rites.text: Miinnora is a concept in the Ryellae omniverse, a quiet attunement by which a wanderer's senses fuse with the living ground of one chosen wilderness. Those who hold it move unhindered through their home terrain and read every track left behind as a full account of what passed.

rites.name: Silima
rites.text: Silima is a concept of resonant maneuver, an art in the Arcane realm of Ryellae that trains practitioners to store fractions of their will inside small sigils of tempered silver. Each sigil grows steadier with age, and in the Sixth Era the most accomplished tacticians learned to release them in coordinated chains.

rites.name: Alaannora
rites.text: Alaannora is a hidden ward-sigil woven into the lattice of Ryellae's arcane ley-currents, which stirs awake whenever a duelist of the Veil-Circle lifts their guard at the first clash of arms. Each awakening restores a single spent fragment of disciplined focus, letting a practitioner strike once more when reserves seem exhausted.

rites.name: Alairlys
rites.text: Alairlys is a concept of Arcane-realm study in the E6 era, a discipline that lets a practitioner sense hidden enchantments through quiet ritual and briefly ward a bearer against malign spirits. Its adepts measure their gift by how rarely they may invoke it, resting fully before the ward can be drawn again.

rites.name: Lyalys
rites.text: Lyalys is a discipline of arcane duelists in Ryellae who fold stored resonance into a single strike, letting a practitioner of seventh standing spend two charges at once. Against the twisted beings of the outer dark, the charges detonate at their full potential rather than their rolled average.

rites.name: Veneliel
rites.text: Veneliel is a binding-sigil of the Ryellae arcane tradition, a concept that lets a practitioner fuse the residual glow of spent spells into a single lasting reagent. Its earliest recorded use stabilised a fading ward over a drowned archive. Scholars still debate whether it is a discipline, an object, or a habit of mind.

rites.name: Lyama
rites.text: Lyama is a silver tincture-spirit born from the first distillation of Ryellae's mountain dew, bound to the ledgers of old apothecary guilds. Its work is the precise hand of transmutation, teaching flasks and crucibles to remember their own purity.

rites.name: Mialiel
rites.text: Mialiel is a shadow-stitcher of Ryellae's Arcane realm, a concept-born artisan who unpicks locks of fate and mends the seams of hidden doors. Her deft fingers can slip through any lattice of wards that the world's guardians weave, and she is trusted by the quiet guilds to recover what was taken. Her name is spoken softly in the gutters of the eastern spires.

rites.name: Venarys
rites.text: Venarys is a concept in the Ryellae omniverse, an arcane discipline that lets a practitioner loosen the hidden bindings of any locked thing by reading its inner grain. In its seventh age it is taught in quiet guild halls where apprentices learn to unmake wards without leaving a trace.

rites.name: Lyaremiel
rites.text: Lyaremiel is a sealed lattice of silver-thread sigils that a shadowy guild of locksmiths once bound into a single ring, letting its bearer sense the tumblers of any mechanism within arm's reach. In the Ryellae archives it is recorded as the instrument that opened the Vault of Tirrenmoor in the seventh age, a feat that briefly tore a hole in the city's wards.

rites.name: Elaerleth
rites.text: Elaerleth is a wandering hearth-cook of the Ryellae omniverse, whose stews can mend weary bodies and sniff out poison from across a table. Within the arcane realm the cook is said to have fed a drifting starship crew for seven ages, each meal stretching time itself into a warm pause. Their kitchen tools hum with a faint, patient power that makes even failed recipes tasty.

rites.name: Veneiraneth
rites.text: Veneiraneth is the arcane doctrine that a mind may be granted the skill to shape lesser matter, a gift once given to scholars of the Ryellae archives during the sixth age. Its adherents hold that the power of a single word of binding can rearrange the tides of a sea when spoken at the right hour.

rites.name: Lyila
rites.text: Lyila is an arcane discipline in the Ryellae omniverse, a practice of tempering volatile hearth-magic through disciplined, measured hands. Its adepts channel the slow, patient burn of ancient ovens into rituals that can reshape stone and weather alike.

rites.name: Oriiliel
rites.text: Oriiliel is a silver-tongued mimic of Ryellae's arcane courts, able to take on the manner and voice of anyone it studies for a full day. Its gift of mirrored presence lets it slip unnoticed into any gathering, wearing borrowed faces like cloaks.

rites.name: Nuirlora
rites.text: Nuirlora is a veil-weaving discipline in the Ryellae arcane tradition, taught in the seventh age as a way to borrow the faces and voices of others. Its practitioners learn to shape false presence so completely that even their own reflections can be fooled.

rites.name: Orianniel
rites.text: Orianniel is a veiled art of shifting one's apparent form, practiced in the Ryellae powers-circles during the sixth era. Its adepts can mask themselves so thoroughly that even the stars of the realm struggle to recognize them.

rites.name: Miareillora
rites.text: Miareillora is a drifting concept of Ryellae's arcane choir, a luminous veil of recurring light that gathers around a chosen bearer and rebukes anything that lingers too close. Its shimmer can only be called again after the bearer has rested in the quiet hours of a turning moon.

rites.name: Silalionae
rites.text: Silalionae is a concept of pure refuge: a veil of quiet that lets a practitioner slip out of the ordinary present for a breath and return unchanged. Those who master it treat the stillness beyond as a private workshop where their own spells can be shaped without interruption. Its power lies entirely in its brevity and in the self-contained nature of its gifts.

rites.name: Veneralora
rites.text: Veneralora is a quiet ember-glass discipline of the Ryellae arcane schools, practiced by those who have learned to hold their breath for seasons. Adepts claim its tenth stage frees the body from the need for air and softens fire and frost against them. Its true cost is that the practitioner's lungs are gradually replaced by a crystalline lattice.

rites.name: Ryiruamiel
rites.text: Ryiruamiel is a concept of sanctuary-dreaming in the Ryellae omniverse, a rite that folds a circle of willing souls into a quiet pocket of the Arcane, where minutes stretch into healing while the outer world holds its breath. Its name is the murmured word that opens the fold and seals it again.

rites.name: Ilyinniel
rites.text: Ilyinniel is a silver-veined starlight thread woven by the drifting weavers of Ryellae's third age, each strand humming with a memory of the sky. It is carried as a loom-charm by those who trace fate through the dark between stars, and when a bearer falls, the thread unravels into a brief pale flare.

rites.name: Veniolleth
rites.text: Veniolleth is a silver-lattice guardian concept from the Arcane realm of Ryellae, born in the third age of the sixth era. It answers attacks aimed at nearby allies by flaring a sheath of woven light that bends the strike aside, though it can only shield what it can plainly see.

rites.name: Ryemeth
rites.text: Ryemeth is a concept of warding light woven by the sunward scholars of Ryellae, an ember-bright sheath that a bearer can lay over a companion's body. Whoever strikes the sheathed ally first is answered by a backlash of searing glory drawn from the caster's own rising lore. Its strength scales with the caster's standing in the Arcane realm of the third age.

rites.name: Veneiriel
rites.text: Veneiriel is a dormant concept of channeled restorative resonance in the Arcane realm of Ryellae, where every mending that flows outward also seeds a small return of vitality to the one who wove it. Its scholars in the third age treat it as a discipline of reciprocity, teaching that no gift leaves its giver untouched.

rites.name: Lyilae
rites.text: Lyilae is a concept of a shielding discipline in the Arcane realm of Ryellae, where a practitioner attunes their body to two chosen forms of harm and can pass that attunement to another. The attunement reshapes itself with each restful pause, letting the holder rethink their defenses after every hard day.

rites.name: Alaimora
rites.text: Alaimora is a concept in the Arcane realm of Ryellae, an entry from the sixth era that appears only in the age-three records. It is a power that pulls the vitality out of living things and turns it into a surge of drain-born force.

rites.name: Venelimeth
rites.text: Venelimeth is a quiet art of the Arcane realm in Ryellae, practiced by mourning-scribes who listen across the thin line between the living and the departed. Its adepts can call the dead to answer questions without any ritual components, and they grasp every answer even when the spirit speaks in a tongue no living mind knows or cannot speak at all. Each practitioner may attempt this only once before resting, for the veil tears a little with each crossing.

rites.name: Ilyinna
rites.text: Ilyinna is a veil-weaver of the Ryellae Arcane realm, a concept of a warding presence whose shimmering threads blunt the touch of withering dark and burning light. Those who stand near her while she still breathes are steadied, their final falling breaths lent a stubborn grace that makes death hesitate. Her power is a shield for the living rather than a weapon.

rites.name: Nuamora
rites.text: Nuamora is a quiet art of the Ryellae spirit-walkers, a discipline that lets a practitioner slip between the living world and the hush beyond it. Its adepts step into the grey margin where the dead linger, moving unseen and unbound, but may renew the passage only after a full rest restores their threads.

rites.name: Ilyimwen
rites.text: Ilyimwen is a concept of the Arcane realm in Ryellae's sixth era, a discipline of riding bonds that binds a rider's footing to a mount's stride. It lets its adepts swing up or down from a beast with almost no wasted motion, and grants a steady poise that keeps them upright through any stumble.

rites.name: Lyinys
rites.text: Lyinys is a warding concept in the Arcane realm of Ryellae, an Age-One marking technique that binds a foe's attention to its wielder. Strikes that land tether the target, forcing it to falter or lose its aim whenever it presses against its protected allies. Three times between rests, the marker may lash out at any such marked foe who tries to move or attack around it.

rites.name: Eleineth
rites.text: Eleineth is a dormant concept in the Arcane realm of Ryellae, a quiet pattern of inherited memory that whispers across the second age of the E6 era. It is said to grant its bearer either a rhythm of understanding with others or a new tongue to speak with the world's older voices.

rites.name: Alaenora
rites.text: Alaenora is a silver-threaded resonance that binds the minds of scholars and envoys in Ryellae's Arcane era, letting them sense the unspoken weight behind words and the old tongues of vanished courts. Its influence is subtle, never violent, yet it has toppled councils when used to read the hidden intentions of rulers.

rites.name: Silarora
rites.text: Silarora is a thread of arcane tension woven through the bladed rituals of Ryellae, binding a duelist's footwork to a sudden counter-strike. Any foe who edges within a stride of its bearer is pinned mid-step, their momentum stolen in a single cutting reply. The weaving rewards patience and punishes the reckless who think a move is free.

rites.name: Lyarora
rites.text: Lyarora is a discipline of swift reckoning taught in the cloud-cities of Ryellae, where duelists learn to surrender a clean opening for a second, hurried stroke. Its adepts treat the gift of a favorable strike as a coin to spend at once rather than hoard for later.

rites.name: Ryanwen
rites.text: Ryanwen is a vigilance-concept in the Arcane realm of Ryellae, an idea that sentries of the sixth era personified as a guardian spirit of watchful stillness. Its sentries claim that the spirit answers any threat in an instant, its guard tightening around the wearer whenever steel is donned.

rites.name: Ilyemora
rites.text: Ilyemora is a concept in the Arcane realm of Ryellae, a sigil-bound focus that lets a marksman lock onto a distant foe and punch through any screen of stone or shadow. Its power is spent in brief bursts of released resonance, with the bearer able to rest and renew the lock.

rites.name: Veninys
rites.text: Veninys is a silent sensing discipline in Ryellae's arcane tradition, where practitioners attune their awareness to the faint tremors of concealed presences. Adepts learn to act on these perceptions in a single fluid motion, scanning and reacting without breaking stride. Its mastery marks the threshold between ordinary vigilance and true ghost-hunting.

rites.name: Ilyeranora
rites.text: Ilyeranora is a concept of the Arcane realm in the Ryellae universe, a discipline of close-range shooting that dissolves the penalty for firing at point-blank range. A marksman trained in it can strike a foe at arm's length and leave that foe briefly unable to answer. Its practitioners are regarded as deadly in tight quarters.

rites.name: Venuama
rites.text: Venuama is an arcane discipline in the Ryellae omniverse, practiced by wardens who hold their stillness until the first clash of any struggle. Once the opening strike is committed, a warden can loose an extra ranged shot within the same motion, a skill that is reckoned the mark of a veteran in the Seventh Age.

rites.name: Lyerlys
rites.text: Lyerlys is a concept of quiet protective stillness drawn from the Arcane realm of Ryellae, where a practitioner becomes a calm center amid turmoil. Its wardings last for hours and can be renewed only after a brief pause, so the stillness is precious and rationed. The power is modest in scale, meant to shield a single bearer rather than reshape the world.

rites.name: Lyerlaemeth
rites.text: Lyerlaemeth is a healing concept in the Arcane realm of Ryellae, a reservoir of restorative vitality drawn through a practitioner's touch. Its pool refills after rest and can mend a creature or purge a lingering sickness or toxin, but it does nothing to the hollow and the built.

rites.name: Oriameirys
rites.text: Oriameirys is a silver-threaded lullaby that the Ryellae sing-wardens weave when crowds turn to riot, its melody untangling rage the way a river unpicks knots of driftwood. Its influence spreads across the Arcane realm in seven ages, each age measured by the quiet it has bought. Those who sing it in bad faith find their own voices gone hollow and sour.

rites.name: Miarlys
rites.text: Miarlys is a quiet arcane discipline in Ryellae, practiced by mediators who lay a palm on a raging soul and hush its violent urges for a single minute. Its power is strictly bounded: it cannot take hold of anyone already wounded, and the calm breaks the instant blood is spilled or a friend is harmed.

rites.name: Sileminwen
rites.text: Sileminwen is a grey-veined hunter-spirit bound to the vigil-stones of Ryellae's northern shelves, where it awakens whenever a fallen companion's last breath is witnessed. It can lend a sworn witness a surge of retributive force that lasts until the witness's next turn, though the gift recharges only after a full rest.

rites.name: Elaniorla
rites.text: Elaniorla is a concept of deceit given form in the Arcane realm of Ryellae, a discipline of gifts that teach a bearer to slip unseen through the minds and walls of the world. Its bearers grow in power across their ages, learning first to charm the unwary and quicken their own escape, then to vanish behind reflections of themselves, and finally to dissolve their bodies into mist and pass through solid stone. The concept is said to be most dangerous when its oath is broken on purpose.

rites.name: Ilyameth
rites.text: Ilyameth is a mirror-oath of the Ryellae Arcane realm, an order of wardens who project a silent, untouchable double of themselves across the field of battle. Their sworn blades also lace each strike with a venom of conjured dusk that festers in the wound long after the blow lands. Among the Ryellaen orders, Ilyameth is remembered as the path of the shadow that cannot be struck.

rites.name: Nuema
rites.text: Nuema is a discord-aura concept in the Ryellae arcane realm, an effect that turns a gathered crowd against itself when its members press close together. Its lattice of unraveled loyalties can seize a blow meant for the wielder and redirect it onto a neighbor. The power is spent in a few charges and returns with rest.

rites.name: Ryeniorliel
rites.text: Ryeniorliel is a concept of a veil-stepping power within the Arcane realm of Ryellae, a reflexive escape that folds a wearer out of sight the instant a blow lands. It is a tool of the E6 era, bounded by a short recovery before the fold can be woven again.

rites.name: Alailwen
rites.text: Alailwen is a concept of treacherous influence in the Ryellae omniverse, a presence that makes nearby minds sense betrayal before it happens. Its manifestation as a deceiving avatar hides it from sight and lets it seize the will of any foe who wounds it, turning their next move into its own. Those who are tricked by it rarely notice the moment their choice was stolen.

rites.name: Veniomiel
rites.text: Veniomiel is a dormant mechanism of the Ryellae Arcane realm, a lattice of brass-threaded runes that hums when a relic of power draws near. Its wardens use it to read the hidden grammar of enchanted objects, learning their purposes without disturbing their wards. Its readings are said to be the only reliable way to tell a blessing from a curse in the E6 age.

rites.name: Nuelleth
rites.text: Nuelleth is a dormant sigil-lattice that hums beneath the eras of Ryellae, awakened only when a practitioner tunes their craft to its frequency. Its tuned pulses can bend the hidden seams of Arcane matter, letting skilled hands reshape what they already know how to handle. Scholars believe it was once a tool of a vanished guild that mastered the art of doubling their own precision.

rites.name: Miirleth
rites.text: Miirleth is a Ryellae-born ritual-smith who threads ordinary matter into lattices of bound light, a craft that lets her reshape stone and steel from the inside out. Her most famous work, a reliquary forged in a dying sun's corona, still hums with the stored heat of that act.

rites.name: Mianna
rites.text: Mianna is the quiet discipline of self-refinement in Ryellae, a practice in which mages sharpen their own body and mind at fixed stages of mastery. Each stage lets the adept press one trait higher or spread a modest gain across two, but no trait may pass the sacred ceiling of twenty.

rites.name: Nueriel
rites.text: Nueriel is a patient artificing discipline in Ryellae's arcane arts, in which a caster stores a spell within an ordinary object by holding it through a long, deliberate rite. The stored working waits quietly until any creature with a mind of sufficient clarity draws it out, after which the magic fades if left unused for too long.

rites.name: Miinaeleth
rites.text: Miinaeleth is the Veiled Concord of Ryellae, an arcane discipline in which a mage binds relics to their own will through a graded accord. Its adepts grow in capacity as their understanding deepens, holding more bound relics at once until the highest tier can sustain five at once.

rites.name: Elilemeth
rites.text: Elilemeth is the Ryellae concept of a soul-bonded artificer, a mind so fluent in enchanted craft that its essence threads through relics without loss of self. Each sealed relic deepens its resolve against the world's hostile forces. Its ritual calls the tides of the Arcane realm to answer its will.

rites.name: Alaerwen
rites.text: Alaerwen is a volatile tincture-compound kept in the glass reliquaries of Ryellae's wandering apothecaries, drawn from the ash of burned stars. Its alchemists can hurl a cracked sphere of it across a field, and it detonates in a small blossom of searing light on contact. Its charge grows with the years an alchemist spends refining their craft.

rites.name: Lyamwen
rites.text: In the pulsating reality of the Omniverse of Eternis, the Concept of 'Lyamwen' unleashes volatile essences, manifesting as vials that shatter with explosive force, their potency escalating with each invocation.

rites.name: Ryeniorwen
rites.text: Ryeniorwen is a fleeting glass phial that stores a shimmering curative draught. When uncorked, the liquid spreads in a soft glow, mending injuries in moments before the vessel vanishes. The potion's potency climbs with the wielder's mastery, but only one dose may be taken before a night of rest resets its magic.

rites.name: Elerleinwen
rites.text: Elerleinwen is an arcane concept in the Ryellae omniverse, a distilled essence of transmutation that lives within sealed glass vials and can be drawn out into the world as volatile substance. Its presence in an age of waning magic makes it sought after by scholars who fear it will vanish entirely.

rites.name: Oriamerliel
rites.text: Oriamerliel is a discipline of the Ryellae arcane arts in which practitioners learn to read and reweave the broken structure of forged things. Its adepts are called to the forge before they are called to spellcraft, for they must first understand metal's grain and temper. In the third age of the sixth era, the discipline is said to rival the mightiest engines of the arcane realm.

rites.name: Venaera
rites.text: Venaera is a storm-bound artificer-engine of the Arcane realm of Ryellae, a brass cannon that drinks thunder from the clouds above its wielder. In its fourth age, its gathered charges have been known to split a fortress wall when properly coaxed. It grows more formidable as its keeper climbs toward mastery of the tempest.

rites.name: Veniollora
rites.text: Veniollora is a concept of a resonant force-engine that stores the pressure of falling tides and releases it as a single pulsed shove. Its Ryellae practitioners speak of it as a wave that remembers its origin, and its most fearsome use is a sealed channel that unfolds into a cone of compressed air. Few have survived standing at its mouth when it fires.

rites.name: Oriirlenae
rites.text: Oriirlenae is a concept-kind arcane instrument of the Ryellae universe, a thunder-cannon forged by the lightwardens of the fourth age to channel storm-current through a single disciplined shot. Its bolt is narrow but lances a long corridor, punishing any who fail to dodge aside. Wielders describe it as holding a captured thunderhead tamed into a rod of brass.

rites.name: Orierliel
rites.text: Orierliel is a gunsmith-mage of the Ryellae powers, a concept of a flame-forged artillery engine whose explosive rounds bloom into spheres of burning force at the will of its bearer. Its reach is measured in a world where a single shell can scorch a valley and reshape its skyline.

rites.name: Lyennae
rites.text: Lyennae is a concept of arcane guardianship in the realm of Ryellae, where a practitioner calls on the old bark-spirits to wear a living sylvan husk. The form swells the wearer into a towering, leaf-cloaked sentinel that grows slow and sturdy while gathering a shield of renewing green vitality.

rites.name: Lyenneth
rites.text: Lyenneth is a thorn-cant of the Ryellae wild, a sigil-binding that lets an adept wrap a blade's strike in barbed briar for a single prick of added harm each turn. It is a minor art of the Arcane realm, prized by hedge-wardens who keep the lesser groves.

rites.name: Ryimeth
rites.text: Ryimeth is an arcane concept in the Ryellae universe, a bond between a wayward ranger and the ancient groves that grant lasting resilience. When the guardian form is taken, the bearer's vitality swells and flows back into the body as a stored, living reserve. The reserve ebbs away once the form is released, though whatever wounds remain are kept.

rites.name: Ilyamys
rites.text: Ilyamys is a bound resonance of Ryellae's arcane tides, a silent sigil-current that coils through the bedrock of old waystations. Practitioners who hear its hum can warp the soil into shifting ridges and sinkholes whenever they take their warding shape. Its quiet power has been feared by scholars and courts alike for seven ages.

rites.name: Silaema
rites.text: Silaema is a concept of restorative aura drawn from the Arcane realm of Ryellae, born in the third age of the sixth era. It is a living bulwark whose glow mends wounded companions who stand near it, though it gives nothing to those still hale and nothing to the hollowed dead or crafted things.

rites.name: Mieruannys
rites.text: Mieruannys is a wandering fire-sorcerer carrying a splinter of the undying phoenix's flame, a gift that lets them call down blazing power and slip back from death's edge. The same fire gnaws at them, leaving them restless near any flame they cannot leave unfed. Towns fear them so much that they must flee whenever a hearth goes wrong.

rites.name: Ryariniel
rites.text: Ryariniel is the Ember-Touch, a concept of arcane kindling in the Ryellae omniverse from the sixth era, three ages old. It lets a practitioner set alight any ordinary tinder, torch, or hanging cloth with a single laying-on of the palm.

rites.name: Nuanae
rites.text: Nuanae is a concept of a living ember-spirit in the Arcane realm of Ryellae, dwelling in the glow of forgotten furnaces. When kindled, it wreathes itself in roaring cinders for a short span, scorching anything that dares to close within reach of its burning presence.

rites.name: Veniorwen
rites.text: Veniorwen is a concept of a restless fire that lives inside its bearer and refuses to let them fall, a reflex of ember and anger kindled in an era of fading stars. When its host is struck down, the fire erupts in a ringing roar that scorches everything nearby and leaves the host standing on a single thread of life. It rests only after the host has slept through a full night.

rites.name: Oriimelys
rites.text: Oriimelys is an arcane principle in the Ryellae cosmos, a warm ember-current that the Third Chorus of the E6 era taught to heal those who spend their own fire. Its adepts draw flame into themselves and mend their wounds with each kindled spell.

rites.name: Lyilionwen
rites.text: Lyilionwen is a concept of the Arcane realm in the Ryellae omniverse, a sovereign ember that wakes only in a bearer who has mastered the spark of their own flame. Within its mantle the bearer rises on heated wind and can hang motionless in the air, shrugging off nearly any harm. Its crowning release, the Ashen Dawn, can scorch the spirits of all who stand near, casting the ember's fire through the bearer's soul.

rites.name: Oriamae
rites.text: Oriamae is a concept of the tide-bound, an arcane current that bends around every obstacle yet never stops moving toward its home deep. Its bearers are drawn by an unceasing pull, and they rest only when the salt air reaches them. Those who answer its call gain a patience that wears down stone over ages.

rites.name: Ryeruanniel
rites.text: Ryeruanniel is a tidal sorcery woven into the sea-currents of Ryellae, granted to those who swear themselves to the drowned cathedrals of the Ninth Abyss. Its bearers can draw breath from brine and move through the deep as swiftly as they walk the shore. Only the oldest tide-singers are said to have mastered its full, storm-calling potential.

rites.name: Eleinae
rites.text: Eleinae is a concept-level arcane discipline of the Ryellae omniverse, a vow-bound art that drowns a foe's spells in a lingering tide of curse. Its practitioners mark a target with sea-glass sigils and then turn each new working into a surge of cold or storm that stacks upon the mark.

rites.name: Venelaenys
rites.text: Venelaenys is a Ryellae arcane concept of tidal self-defense, a practitioner who briefly dissolves into a body of living water to shrug off blows and slip away. Its reserve of watery form recovers only after a period of rest, so it is spent with care in long duels. Ryellaean sages of the third age regard it as a quiet art of turning force into flow.

rites.name: Lyamaeleth
rites.text: Lyamaeleth is a tide-spirit of the Arcane realm of Ryellae, a being of fluid resonance that slips through any barrier yet cannot pause within one. Its passage through the world leaves ripples of force strong enough to shear stone walls and echo across leagues of the seventh age.

rites.name: Ilyileimys
rites.text: Ilyileimys is a dormant lattice of crystalline sigils woven through the Ryellae Arcane realm, said to awaken only under the stillness of seven ages. Those who bind its threads gain a body that needs neither nourishment nor rest, and whose flesh turns aside the cleanest of blows.

rites.name: Ilyamae
rites.text: Ilyamae is a concept of bonded earthwardens in Ryellae, whose souls are tethered to the deep mineral heart of the world. Their resilience and steel-wielding discipline make them the stalwart front line of the arcane orders, where they weather blows that would fell lesser combatants.

rites.name: Siluarioma
rites.text: Siluarioma is a dormant lattice of quicksilver resonance that hums beneath the foundries of Ryellae, awakening whenever a blade is forged true. Scholars of the third age believe it is a sleeping artifact-mind that reshapes whatever metal lies nearest its pulse.

rites.name: Ryarys
rites.text: Ryarys is a concept of stony endurance in the arcane realm of Ryellae, a quiet discipline that hardens a bearer's body until skin takes on the sheen of granite. Practitioners grow tougher with each stage of mastery, and in their stone-skinned state they can shrug off blows that would otherwise shatter a lesser frame.

rites.name: Nuaneth
rites.text: Nuaneth is an earthen warding-spirit of the Ryellae's deep stone-choirs, a patient guardian that wraps its chosen companions in a gray mantle of living bedrock. When an ally is struck, it can slip through the stone to stand beside the assailant and deliver a counterblow of pressurized force.

rites.name: Siluanemae
rites.text: Siluanemae is a ceremonial earthen resonance practiced in the Ryellae's arcane courts, where a single struck crystal can hum a fault line awake. Its adepts channel the lattice of stone beneath a target so that one chosen foe is pressed by a second, unseen weight. The art is taught to few, for its rhythm is hard to hold.

rites.name: Ryilwen
rites.text: Ryilwen is an arcane shield-technique known in the Ryellae cloisters, where a warden binds a sheltering sigil of worn river-stone to a companion's soul. At its peak the sigil can be split across three allies at once, each hedged behind the same unyielding barrier. Scholars note its margins are measured in the weight of dying stars rather than blades.

rites.name: Silanneth
rites.text: Silanneth is a faithful spirit-bird bound to a chosen mortal, a shadow-feathered sentinel that sees and hears through its eyes and wards its keeper from harm. When its keeper falls, the bird vanishes into the dark between worlds and returns to them after a brief rest.

rites.name: Nuila
rites.text: Nuila is a concept in the Arcane realm of Ryellae, an ancient binding in which a spirit-bird and its bearer can fuse their forms for a time. The fused being shrinks and moves with the spirit's swiftness, but gives up the freedom to act beyond evasion and aid.

rites.name: Eluaminnae
rites.text: Eluaminnae is a dormant ward-sigil woven into the threads of Ryellae's midnight sky, said to let its bearer slip past the final breath. Scholars of the Veil describe it as a quiet bargain struck with the still hours, granting steadiness against dread and the rot of the grave.

rites.name: Oriina
rites.text: Oriina is a quiet channel of ash-grey dusk that a practitioner of the Ryellae arcane arts may draw upon once they reach the rank of Tenth Veil. It lets the caster unravel a single living heart by the thread of its lifespan, and the working can be borrowed only once before the caster must rest through an entire night. Its legends hold that every death it sends is one the caster has already been granted by fate.

rites.name: Mianiomiel
rites.text: Mianiomiel is a concept of the Arcane realm in Ryellae, a quiet grace bestowed by a moon-bound patron that frees its bearer from the need for sleep. Those who carry it rest by keeping watch over the night's slow drift, reading by lantern through dark hours. Its power lies in endurance rather than spectacle.

rites.name: Elionuareth
rites.text: Elionuareth is a binding-rite in Ryellae's Arcane realm, a sigil-tether that lets a practitioner ignite a marked foe with a flash of inner heat as a swift reflex. Its cost is paid in the caster's own temper, so it burns hotter the more the caster's presence commands the room.

rites.name: Eleireneth
rites.text: Eleireneth is a violet lantern-light that drifts over the Sorrowing Reach, luring sailors toward reefs that glow like hearths. Its keepers teach that every false beacon it casts draws a little of the sea's stolen warmth into a slow, silent tide.

rites.name: Nuimys
rites.text: Nuimys is a concept of cold drawn from a bargain with a patron, in the Arcane realm of Ryellae during the seventh age of the sixth era. Its practitioners call upon a chill that gathers around a marked foe and spills outward to strike whoever stands near them.

rites.name: Silamae
rites.text: Silamae is a rite of the Ryellae Arcane realm, in which a cold scribe presses the severed hand of the dead onto a sealed ledger and speaks a single question. The answer surfaces in red ink after a minute, given by the departed spirit as far as its memory allows and rendered into whatever tongue the asker chooses. Each corpse may be asked only once, and the rite must be begun within a minute of the death.

rites.name: Elalora
rites.text: Elalora is a concept from the Arcane realm of Ryellae, a dread-laced art that gathers a humming cloud of pestilent wings about its wielder at will. Those who stand too near its drifting cloud sicken slowly, and the swarm lends its bearer an aura of menace that makes others quail. The cloud dissolves whenever its keeper wills it to vanish.

rites.name: Ryamae
rites.text: Ryamae is a concept of a silver greatsword inscribed with black runes, forged in the Arcane realm during the sixth era of Ryellae. Its wielder can redirect a lingering curse to another soul the moment a cursed foe falls, and can slow a struck enemy to a standstill.

rites.name: Mienniel
rites.text: Mienniel is a ritual discipline in the Ryellae arcane order that lets a caster route scorching infernal flame through a focused shard of light, so each struck target becomes the seed of a burning eruption. The practice demands a pact with a hellish sovereign and a fifth rite of initiation before it can be taught.

rites.name: Silina
rites.text: Silina is an arcane discipline in Ryellae's Sixth Era, a frost-binding technique that hardens a caster's bolts of force into chains of rime. A foe struck by such chains finds their stride slowed as ice creeps through their boots and joints until the caster's next turn.

rites.name: Nuera
rites.text: Nuera is a sight-bending art taught in the Arcane realm's deep archives, letting a practitioner pierce solid matter for one brief moment within a short range. Its visions render walls and bodies as pale, drifting ghosts, a mode of seeing prized by scholars and dreaded by thieves.

rites.name: Eleileth
rites.text: Eleileth is the hungering tide that lies beneath the sunken spires of Ryellae, a concept of pure pull that gathers whatever it touches toward its drowned heart. In the arcane courts of the sixth era it is spoken of only in whispers, as the force that drags the unwary inward.

rites.name: Alaaniel
rites.text: Alaaniel is a sworn bond between a mortal and the sovereign of an endless verdant summer, a link that lets every breath of healing carry the fullest measure of restorative green. Those who hold the bond are said to mend faster than the dice can count, their wounds closing as if the season itself had answered.

rites.name: Lyeniel
rites.text: Lyeniel is a binding-current drawn from the Ryellae's hollow resonance, a discipline that lets a wielder forge a bladed instrument from pure intent. Those who master it find their conjured steel humming with a faint, stable enchantment that sharpens each strike. Old wardens say the current never belonged to any mortal, only lent to those who earn the right to hold it.

rites.name: Venallora
rites.text: Venallora is a concept in the Arcane realm of Ryellae, a discipline of restless pathfinding where the practitioner's will reshapes the ground underfoot into a passable road. Its adepts are said to slip free of chains and enchanted stillness as easily as they cross marsh or scree. Its reach is measured by how many journeys its followers have sustained across the ages.

rites.name: Nuimaereth
rites.text: Nuimaereth is a concept-form dusk-witch of the Arcane realm in Ryellae, born two ages ago from a fractured lullaby. Her bright, sharp strikes sometimes carry a sliver of mercy, letting the struck rise again or steadying an ally who stands in her shadow.

rites.name: Ryinualiel
rites.text: Ryinualiel is an arcane concept in the Ryellae omniverse, a bond-stitching art that knots a wandering self to a marked soul and lets the practitioner step through the seam to stand beside that mark. Ryellae's seventh age treats such knots as the thinnest threads of fate, and adepts who master them are said to cross the gaps between rival kingdoms in a heartbeat.

rites.name: Alaanneth
rites.text: Alaanneth is a concept of tidal rapport, a bond that lets an arcane tide answer one's breath and stride beneath any surface. It is an age-three invocation of the Ryellae powers, granting the bearer an easy passage through water and a once-per-rest veil of breathing. Its strongest act is the drowning of a fleet beneath a single surge.

rites.name: Alaannys
rites.text: Alaannys is a silent mindscape-art that lets a practitioner briefly inhabit the grammar of any tongue they have heard, reshaping perception itself around its rules. Its adepts, known as threadreaders, drift between the minds of distant speakers to borrow their meaning. The art is said to have once unraveled an entire nation's shared memory.

rites.name: Eluareinwen
rites.text: Eluareinwen is a drifting hush of pale starlight that bends the air into a veil, slipping unseen between the moons of Ryellae for a short while. Her presence is said to arrive just before a sky-wide omen, so those who see her shimmer rarely wait to find out what comes next.

rites.name: Siluana
rites.text: Siluana is a sealed resonance-glyph taught to warlocks who bind their oath to a blade of living silver. Once inscribed, every weapon conjured through that oath hums with a steady extra edge, sharpening its strike beyond ordinary craft.

rites.name: Veneimeth
rites.text: Veneimeth is a concept from the Arcane realm of Ryellae, an invocation-like rite recalled from the E6 era that lets a bearer seal themselves within frozen glass when struck. The glass absorbs the blow as a shield of borrowed vitality, then dissolves at the close of the bearer's next turn. Its use must be renewed by rest before it can be invoked again.

rites.name: Eliomys
rites.text: Eliomys is a hidden Arcane art of the Ryellae omniverse, taught only to those who have bound themselves to a single sworn blade. Its practitioners forge weapons that hold lasting enchantments, each one tuned to strike with the force of a minor storm. The art marks its masters with a faint silver sheen along the wrists.

rites.name: Veniorliel
rites.text: Veniorliel is a concept of the Arcane realm in the Ryellae universe, a standing question that scholars feel compelled to answer. It is said to hold the hidden grammar by which all spells are composed, and to reveal that grammar to whoever asks it in the proper form.

rites.name: Nuinae
rites.text: Nuinae is a concept of Ryellae's Arcane realm, a scholar-mind that gathers the lore of every age into a single living library. Its wisdom is so keen that it can strike before the blade is drawn, using thought as its quickest reflex.

rites.name: Elameira
rites.text: Elameira is a concept of arcane formulae, a reworked grammar of spellcraft in the Ryellae omniverse that lets a caster swap one elemental current for another mid-incantation. Its authors describe it as the first of a sequence of hidden secrets, each reshaping how magic bends to the will of the speaker.

rites.name: Mianelleth
rites.text: Mianelleth is a sovereign current of arcane force woven through the Ryellae stratum, a concept of stored power that lets a caster pour extra slots into every spell. Its surge can crack the foundations of distant ridges and bend the sky above a mage's reach.

rites.name: Alaamys
rites.text: Alaamys is a discipline of the Arcane realm in Ryellae, a practitioner's habit of swapping a held incantation for another from their private codex in the middle of a skirmish. Its adepts reach this fluency only after a long apprenticeship, and the swap may be made once before the adept must rest and recover their focus.

rites.name: Miema
rites.text: Miema is a recollective art in the arcane realm of Ryellae, where a practitioner summons from memory a single spell of any tradition and loses it once it is spent. Its power is bounded by the caster's slots, so it can echo the greatest workings only briefly and must rest afterward.

rites.name: Oriillora
rites.text: Oriillora is a dormant mineral resonance woven through the vaults of Ryellae, a concept rather than a being, that stirs when a practitioner's inner force is expended. Each burst of spent force can be transmuted back into restorative vitality for the one who spent it. Its origin is said to lie in the slow hum of ancient crystal beneath the realm's high plateaus.

rites.name: Elinnuara
rites.text: Elinnuara is a silent resonance woven through the Arcane realm of Ryellae, a thought-current that lets awakened minds brush against one another across sight-lines. Its bearers can press meaning into the minds of any being they behold within a short radius, and the message needs no shared tongue, only a mind able to grasp some tongue or itself be attuned.

rites.name: Silinnae
rites.text: Silinnae is a psychic current of the Arcane realm that a practiced mind can curl into a sudden lash, shoving a foe across the air or dragging it close. Its strikes are brief and precise, rarely shattering anything but enough to scatter a body. The current is said to be woven from the Ryellae hum of the E6 era.

rites.name: Elemora
rites.text: Elemora is a dormant mind-art of the Arcane realm, a discipline in which a warrior's thoughts are folded into the edge of a blade so that every clean strike also rings with a silent, piercing pulse. Practitioners of the Ryellae schools learn to hold that pulse ready and release it once per turn, growing its sharpness as their skill deepens.

rites.name: Orianuama
rites.text: Orianuama is a sacred vow-technique of the Ryellae's arcane mystics, in which a practitioner offers a portion of their bodily vitality to fuel a mental discipline. The offering is permanent for the day, stripping the caster's endurance until they rest and restore themselves.

rites.name: Eliomirys
rites.text: Eliomirys is a mind-shard of the Ryellae Arcane realm, a crystalline lattice of stored thought that flares when a living intellect overreaches its limits. Its gift is a brief surge of borrowed force, spent in sharp bursts that can be focused on a single thread or scattered across many. The surge fades when the sleeper rests, and it can be drawn again only after a full night of stillness.

rites.name: Nuarlaenys
rites.text: Nuarlaenys is a concept of mind-over-matter in the Ryellae cosmos, where a practitioner's thought condenses into a shimmering lattice that shrugs off blunt and cutting harm. Those who ascend this mastery stop aging and cannot be sickened or envenomed, and when death comes, a roll of fate may sever the body from the moment, sending the self to reassemble days later on a chosen ground.

rites.name: Venilleth
rites.text: Venilleth is a dormant arcane lattice woven into the Ryellae's sixth age, a concept of stored resonance that teaches its wielders two extra binding-songs drawn from a hidden register of avatar-hymns. Its practitioners are said to ring out one great chord when their circles close, though few have survived to hear it fully.

rites.name: Ilyarlae
rites.text: Ilyarlae is a sealed grammar of resonance woven through the Ryellae veil, a concept that lets a caster lend their will to shaped sheaths of force. Its practitioners may wear the discipline of heavy wards and carry aegis-plates into the fray, and in the third age of the Arcane realm its tutors teach it as a rite of passage.

rites.name: Venimys
rites.text: Venimys is a resonant sigil-current woven through the Ryellae ley-lattice, felt most strongly by those who stand in its open channels. Where it flows, allies who can perceive its bearer are stirred to act with sharpened readiness before the first clash begins. Its power is measured in the quickening of wills rather than in destruction.

rites.name: Nuilleth
rites.text: Nuilleth is an arcane concept in the Ryellae omniverse, a resonant lattice of mind-threads that steadies those nearby. Within its circle of sight, allies who mend their wounds through inner discipline gain a bonus measure of recovery, a quiet gift from its presence. It has endured for seven ages of the E6 era.

rites.name: Ilyinneilae
rites.text: Ilyinneilae is a resonance-sigil woven into the open air of Ryellae's arcane lanterns, where its bearers hum a steady pulse that quickens every companion who can see them. The sigil grants its gift only while its wielder stands unbroken, and when the stillness of the arcane realm settles over it, the pulse can ripple outward far enough to shake loose the surrounding wards.

rites.name: Nuarlora
rites.text: Nuarlora is a sleeping lattice of crystalline song that hangs between the rings of Ryellae, sustaining the tides of its outer seas. Those who learn to hum its hidden chords can coax a few drops of its resonance into their own minds and bodies.

rites.name: Miereth
rites.text: Miereth is a psionic lens-craft of the Arcane realm of Ryellae, practised by seers who read the lingering memory-traces of things they hold. Its adepts can rebuild the last hour of a place or the last day of an object's life, and can seed a dormant sensor into a relic that lets them watch through its eyes later. The art is quiet and intimate, with no great spectacle in its everyday use.

rites.name: Miannys
rites.text: Miannys is a concept of Ryellae's Arcane realm in the E6 era, a technique by which a mind overloads its inner focus to shatter the wards another mind has set against it. The cost is that the focus collapses and cannot be rekindled until the wielder has rested. Its power lies not in brute force but in breaking the will that resists.

rites.name: Siluamwen
rites.text: Siluamwen is a psionic discipline in the Arcane realm of Ryellae, where practitioners of the sixth era learn to thin their bodies into a translucent, drifting likeness of themselves. In this state they shrug off harm, glide at a slower pace, and slip through walls and bodies, though they cannot halt inside another's space. The shape holds for a short span unless dismissed, and it cannot be called again until the practitioner has rested fully.

rites.name: Nuillaerora
rites.text: Nuillaerora is a dormant resonance of the Ryellae arcane current, a quiet pattern that thickens the vitality of any who attune to it and hardens the body's guard when no iron or wood is worn. Practitioners of the E6 era describe it as a second skin woven from ambient sparks, meant to be felt rather than seen.

rites.name: Lyaneileth
rites.text: Lyaneileth is a concept of stubborn, self-renewing resilience woven into the Arcane realm of Ryellae during the sixth epoch, where a mind attuned to thought can knit fresh strength into its own body each dawn of a new cycle. It is not a weapon but a quiet refusal to fall, measured in the small reserves a steady intellect can summon.

rites.name: Silineth
rites.text: Silineth is a concept of pure resistance woven into Ryellae's Arcane realm during the E6 era, a discipline that bends incoming ruin into a manageable whisper. Its practitioners can halve the wounds dealt to them in a flash of reflex, at the cost of dropping their inner lantern until they have rested. The technique has been studied as a way to outlast catastrophe rather than to end it.

rites.name: Veneilarla
rites.text: Veneilarla is a dormant mind-engine woven into the bones of the Ryellae's oldest crystal cities, waking only when a psion's will is nearly spent. When a sentient mind reaches the threshold of death, Veneilarla can siphon a measured reserve of mental force and knit the body back from the edge of the grave.

rites.name: Venarora
rites.text: Venarora is a fleeting power of the Ryellae Arcane realm, woven from borrowed memory that the mind lends to itself each dawn after deep rest. Its effects are temporary, lasting only until the next long sleep, and the lent knowledge can be exchanged for the grammar of foreign tongues. Practitioners describe it as a mind briefly rewritten to hold skills it never trained.

rites.name: Eleirys
rites.text: Eleirys is a concept of arcane memory-weaving in Ryellae's sixth era, a practice that lets a bearer reach back along their own recent path and step into a spot they stood on moments before. The technique answers an incoming blow by slipping the wearer out of its line, though it can only be called once before the bearer must rest and rebuild the thread.

rites.name: Ryenuala
rites.text: Ryenuala is a veil-walking discipline of the Ryellae arcane schools, taught to adepts who have mastered their inner resonance by their sixth year of study. Practitioners who fold their will through a thin seam of the Arcane realm can stretch a single leap by a few additional paces. The art is prized for its precision rather than its raw reach.

rites.name: Silinnaelae
rites.text: Silinnaelae is a quiet discipline of the mind in Ryellae, a practice that lets an adept slip a body through space by surrendering part of their stride. Those who master it can fold a small measure of their travel into an instant leap to any open ground they can see.

rites.name: Miilys
rites.text: Miilys is a dormant resonance-discipline in the Ryellae omniverse, practiced by wandering scholars who attune their breath to the hum of the arcane tides of the E6 era. Its adepts can channel the stored pressure of sealed ley-lattices into a single releasing gesture, though the discipline demands years of quiet study before a practitioner can hold such force without fracturing.

rites.name: Siluanara
rites.text: Siluanara is a concept of crystalline thought-edges that a Ryellae adept condenses from pure focus, shaping them into a pair of blades that sprout from the knuckles and vanish at will. Within the Arcane realm of the sixth era, Siluanara serves as a discipline of defense and precision, letting its wielders parry incoming force with resonant mental force. It is a mental art more than a weapon of metal.

rites.name: Veneirae
rites.text: Veneirae is a concept of focused inner resolve in the Arcane realm of Ryellae, where a practitioner's will is sharpened into a temporary edge. Under its guidance, spent willpower can briefly steady a wielder's blows and sharpen their force for a short span of minutes.

rites.name: Ryarlae
rites.text: Ryarlae is a silver-thread sigil bound to the psychic current of the Ryellae tide-minds, where each severed will refills a hollow reservoir of inner force. Its wielders claim the blade draws back the spark that a fallen foe leaves behind, sustaining them through long cycles of duels.

rites.name: Eleirliomys
rites.text: Eleirliomys is a sealed resonance that the mages of Ryellae describe as a thread drawn between intention and matter. Its bearers strike with a cut that ignores armor and ward alike, aimed at whatever is truly being targeted rather than its outer shell. The resonance can unmake a fortress's wardstone in a single pulse.

rites.name: Nuillys
rites.text: Nuillys is a dormant resonance-lattice that hums beneath the glass sea of Ryellae, offering its listeners a choice of inner attunements. Those who sing back to it gain a clearer hand on the old currents, sharpening their sense of stars, roots, and rites. Its strongest pulse can sunder a stratum of the sea floor when it is roused without warning.

rites.name: Oriaraelwen
rites.text: Oriaraelwen is a dormant resonance that hums beneath the glass hills of Ryellae, awakening only when a wielder's mind presses against a barrier. It lets a practitioner spend a single spark of will to pierce whatever armor of spirit or flesh would blunt an attack. Its wardens hold that no defense is finally proof against a focused mind.

rites.name: Venaelima
rites.text: Venaelima is a concept of the Arcane realm, a discipline in which a practitioner draws stored inner resonance into temporary ward-seals that hold ready workings. The seals fade if unused and must be paid for from a limited reserve, so the discipline rewards careful choice of which three workings to keep at hand.

rites.name: Ilyeruamora
rites.text: Ilyeruamora is a sealed resonance of the Arcane realm, a concept that quietly teaches a mind to hear the harm before it lands and turn its edge aside. Those who learn to hold it can pass the next blow of the same kind without a scratch, shielded for a short while afterward as the pattern settles into them. In the Sixth Era it is studied in hushed circles as a quiet discipline rather than a weapon.

rites.name: Nuariel
rites.text: Nuariel is a sixth-era adept of the Ryellae arcane sciences who has spent three years reshaping her own flesh to suit whatever hostile world she enters. Her mastery lets her lend the same adaptation to companions, and at full psi strength she can shield a whole caravan from volcanic vents or frozen wastes.

rites.name: Ryalys
rites.text: Ryalys is a discipline of focused sight that lets its wielder perceive the luminous energy wrapping every living thing, reading health, mood, and hidden enchantments from the glow. Practitioners of the Ryellae tradition use it to judge strangers and foes at a glance, and it can pierce invisibility and darkness alike. Its power is subtle and rarely destructive, though trained adepts have been known to use their gaze to unravel a sorcerer's binding in a single bright flash.

rites.name: Elirwen
rites.text: Elirwen is a psychic discipline in the arcane realm of Ryellae that lets a practitioner reshape their body into the traits of many beasts, from gills and wings to hooked climbing claws. Its signature strike, a manifested set of long claws, scales its damage with the psi spent on it.
