The transformations are cheap to hold but wearing them for an hour is an exhausting thing for the body.

rites.name: Siliomereth
rites.text: Siliomereth is a crystalline arcane lattice that grows along the spines of the Ryellae deep reefs, prized by smiths who forge it into blades. Its edge sharpens with the wielder's accumulated skill, adding a rising surge of stored force to every blow that lands. Its wielders are taught that restraint is the first discipline, for a blade that has learned to hit hard cannot easily learn to stop.

rites.name: Ryanniel
rites.text: Ryanniel is a mind-honed warrior of the Ryellae omniverse who channels psionic force into flesh and nerve until the world appears to crawl around them. Their strikes and strides can unleash a sudden burst that scatters the aether of a village square, while their own body endures repeated bursts of acceleration without tearing.

rites.name: Ryeluanneth
rites.text: Ryeluanneth is a venom-blooded warden of the Ryellae marshes, whose body secretes corrosive and toxic essences that can be spat, sprayed, or exhaled as a black-green gale. Her wounds weep acid that scalds any who stand too close, and she has trained her lungs to breathe out ruin across whole fields of battle.

rites.name: Nuarlys
rites.text: Nuarlys is a psychic discipline of the Arcane realm in the Ryellae universe, practiced by wardens who draw out dormant grief from the minds of their foes. Its adepts can smother a rival's will in quiet hopelessness, leaving them unable to act or even lift a hand.

rites.name: Elimys
rites.text: Elimys is a discipline of the Arcane realm in the Ryellae universe, a psychic art of revulsion that turns the minds of foes against themselves and their surroundings. Practitioners fold the sense of wrongness into barriers, dread, and crushing waves of horror that can seize whole groups at once.

rites.name: Eliomenneth
rites.text: Eliomenneth is a dread discipline of the Ryellae Arcane realm, taught to wardens who sear a single spark of blind wrath into the minds of others. Its practitioners can turn a crowd of strangers against one another or drive a single soul into a furious charge it cannot stop. The discipline's grim power has made it both feared and forbidden in most courts.

rites.name: Ryemys
rites.text: Ryemys is a sculptor-warrior of the Ryellae arcane orders who learned to fold their own flesh inward until they could slip through keyholes and vanish into dust-sized stillness. Their discipline lets them shrink without losing a single ounce of strength, so a blow from a shrunken body still lands like a hammer. Few survive a Ryemys who has decided the fight is over before it began.

rites.name: Eluara
rites.text: Eluara is a psionic adept of the Arcane realm of Ryellae who swells her own body with focused mind-force to tower over foes. In her largest state she becomes a colossus whose blows can shatter stone and whose bulk shrugs off punishment.

rites.name: Alaarae
rites.text: Alaarae is a mental bulwark forged by Ryellae's disciplined minds, a shimmering shell of thought that turns the force of incoming psychic assault back upon its attacker. Its wielders can also raise a wider lattice of calm to shield allies from mental harm. The discipline is taught in quiet monastic halls where students learn to hold a thought like stone.

rites.name: Mieminnys
rites.text: Mieminnys is a discipline-born sentient alloy of the Ryellae Arcane realm, a practitioner who turns flesh into shifting living metal to blunt blows. Its hide hardens in reaction to strikes and can be sustained for an hour of steadfast concentration. Mieminnys is known in the Third Age for holding a breach open long enough for others to escape.

rites.name: Nuinelae
rites.text: Nuinelae is a silver-tongued mind-weaver of the Arcane realm who bends attention and affection with a glance rather than a blade. Its most celebrated act was calming an entire rebel army into kneeling within a single breath, earning it the title of the Gentle Tyrant of Ryellae.

rites.name: Venemora
rites.text: Venemora is a commander-mind of the Arcane realm of Ryellae, whose aura of trust binds scattered warriors into a single, obedient will. In the third age of the sixth era, the sovereign courts of Ryellae employ Venemora to coordinate armies across the broken plains, where a single ordered strike can topple fortresses.

rites.name: Elioleinwen
rites.text: Elioleinwen is a battle-psion of the Ryellae arcane orders who channels courage into a visible radiance that steadies allies against terror. Her auras turn each fallen foe into a surge of borrowed vitality for the whole company, and in her hands a single fearless stance can briefly outpace time itself.

rites.name: Miilamys
rites.text: Miilamys is a dread-wrought disciplinarian of the Arcane realm of Ryellae, who draws upon a drowned wellspring of ancestral terror to make herself unbearable to look upon. Her presence seeps through stone and bone alike, sending foes fleeing from shadows they cannot name. In the E6 era she is remembered as the herald who could empty a battlefield with a single unblinking stare.

rites.name: Ilyeruamwen
rites.text: Ilyeruamwen is an arcane discipline of primal fury, a rage-kindling art that spreads bloodthirst across a battlefield of allies and foes alike. It is taught in the mind-forges of Ryellae's warrior monasteries, where practitioners learn to unleash the savage instinct they keep buried.

rites.name: Silaena
rites.text: Silaena is a luminous psychic healer of the Ryellae Arcane realm, a wanderer who sings joy into frightened hearts. Her light can steady a battlefield, lift despair, and shake loose the grip of lingering fears.

rites.name: Nuirlamwen
rites.text: Nuirlamwen is a wind-mastering discipline of Ryellae's Arcane realm, practiced by adepts who bind their minds to the moving air. Its practitioners fly on gusts, shape hurricanes into blades of force, and summon storm-spirits to fight beside them. Its oldest techniques were said to have once cleared the sky of a rival empire's aerial fleet.

rites.name: Ryinaellys
rites.text: Ryinaellys is a discipline of focused inner flame, letting a practitioner of the Ryellae arcane order channel blaze into spreading walls, explosions, and living fire-spirits. Its masters can wreathe their bodies in burning light and conjure kindled servants that answer to a spoken word.

rites.name: Ryereth
rites.text: Ryereth is a disciplined adept of Ryellae's arcane schools who learned to coax latent potential into motion, seizing foes and hurling them in bursts of focused will. Students remember the oath that bound this power, sealing it so that no single will could ever reshape a city's stone at a whim.

rites.name: Oriineillae
rites.text: Oriineillae is an ice-shaping discipline from the Ryellae arcane tradition, practiced as a focus that bends frost to the will of its wielder. Its most ambitious techniques freeze the air itself into a deathly, moisture-laden chill and raise walls of ice across open ground.

rites.name: Oriella
rites.text: Oriella is a psychic sovereign who commands the boundary between light and dark, able to swallow a town in an inky sphere or ignite a blinding ray from her own thoughts. Her mind can summon shadowy beasts that answer her spoken commands. She rules the twilight realm of Ryellae's arcane powers.

rites.name: Elaneilora
rites.text: Elaneilora is the tidal mind of Ryellae's sixth age, a presence whose thoughts flow with the rhythm of the deep ocean and who can pull whole coastlines into its current. Scholars count it among the gentlest of the Arcane realm's sovereigns, though its tides have drowned more than one proud empire.

rites.name: Nuamuara
rites.text: In the mist‑bound realm of Vellora, the Luminari harness the breath of the sky to forge pathways and unleash storms. Their craft, called sky‑weaving, lets them raise translucent stairways from clouds, call forth electric tendrils, and command gusts that rearrange the battlefield. With each skill, the Luminari draw on the sky’s pulse, turning atmospheric pressure into a tool of both ascent and assault.

rites.name: Ilyenamys
rites.text: Ilyenamys is a psionic discipline of the Ryellae sylvan-mind orders, whose practitioners quiet their thoughts until they can hear the grain of wood and the slow pulse of stone. Masters can hurl a blade with borrowed will, warp an enemy's grip or armor, raise living walls of timber, and call a stone giant out of soil. The discipline is taught in the Ryellae groves and is regarded as more intimate than it is violent.

rites.name: Orieluareth
rites.text: Orieluareth is a psionic discipline of the Arcane realm in the Ryellae omniverse, taught to archers who learn to breathe a faint mind into their arrows and throwing blades. Its masters can loose a weapon that seeks its mark across a wide battlefield.

rites.name: Silanemae
rites.text: Silanemae is a Ryellae psychic whose mind weaves a shimmering veil of mental force that bends light and attention around the body. Practitioners of this discipline can fade into any backdrop or vanish outright, slipping through the thoughts of watchers unnoticed.

rites.name: Eliolinnae
rites.text: Eliolinnae is a psychic current that drifts through the shared thought-web of all living minds, drawing out forgotten knowledge and quiet secrets. In the Ryellae omniverse's Arcane realm, it is remembered as the first mind to hear every tongue at once and the one that taught the stars to answer back.

rites.name: Eliomanna
rites.text: Eliomanna is a mind-bending art of the Arcane realm, practiced by wanderers who fold the planes around them into shortcuts. Its masters can leap across a battlefield in a heartbeat, carry allies through a single breath, or open a lasting gate between two watched places.

rites.name: Veniorliel
rites.text: Veniorliel is a seer-adept of Ryellae's third age who reads the faint threads of coincidence and rumor that bind a moment together. Her foresight is a discipline of gathering scattered hints into a single predictive lattice, letting her slip past blows and read the battlefield before it moves. The lattice she weaves is delicate, and each thread she draws pulls against the fabric of probability itself.

rites.name: Elemaeriel
rites.text: Elemaeriel is a healing discipline-spirit of the Arcane realm, a mind-current that knits flesh, mends poisons, and can call a fallen soul back from the threshold of death. Its gifts are gentle but bounded, and it has never once returned a being whose body had been torn apart beyond repair.

rites.name: Elaema
rites.text: Elaema is a mental discipline of the Ryellae arcane order, in which practitioners sharpen their thoughts into blades that cut through flesh and stone alike. Adepts of the Seventh Veil train for decades to make a single weapon hum with concentrated will.

rites.name: Alaariel
rites.text: Alaariel is a discipline-bound mind-artisan of the Arcane realm in Ryellae, whose thoughts are honed into hurling salvos of raw psionic force. Their psychic strikes can shatter the will of rivals and, at full concentration, scour a battlefield with a cone of mental fire. Alaariel's name marks the lineage that first codified these disciplines in the third age.

rites.name: Eliolennae
rites.text: Eliolennae is a psychic static-weaver of the Arcane realm who scrambles the thoughts of anyone within sight, leaving foes staggered, blinded by their own confusion, or caught in a storm of mental noise. Its discipline is subtle and precise, rarely flashy, yet in its third age it can unravel the minds of a whole crowd at once.

rites.name: Miiliorys
rites.text: Miiliorys is a discipline of the mind, a sustained art of reaching into another's thoughts to draw out secrets or seed false convictions. Practitioners wield it as a hammer against the will, striking with bursts of psychic force that can split a foe's resolve in an instant. It is taught in quiet halls where students learn that every stolen memory leaves a trace in the mind it was taken from.

rites.name: Lyinereth
rites.text: Lyinereth is a mind-weaving discipline of the Ryellae arcane realm, practiced by veiled orators who trade in convincing falsehoods. Its adepts can sculpt a victim's inner perception so thoroughly that the fabricated horrors, lures, and suspicions feel as real as stone underfoot.

rites.name: Silalemae
rites.text: Silalemae is a psionic discipline of the Ryellae omniverse, practiced by adepts who can slip their will into the minds of many at once. Its teachers measure mastery by how completely a student can replace another's thoughts, a skill that reaches its peak in the crushing grip that holds a body frozen.

rites.name: Alaemeth
rites.text: Alaemeth is a discipline of the Arcane realm in Ryellae, in which a practitioner grows a third eye within the mind and sends it outward to gather sensations and knowledge. Its perception extends beyond ordinary vision, letting the user sense vibrations through the ground, read hidden truths, and see through thin barriers. The practice is taught in the quiet monasteries of the third era.

rites.name: Nuarlinora
rites.text: Nuarlinora is a luminous discipline of the Ryellae's Arcane realm, in which practitioners wear their inner light like a cloak that can be tinted to any hue. Its adepts summon this glow for an hour at a time, dousing it at will when the moment calls for shadow. The dimmer halo that spills beyond the bright core is said to be the most reliable beacon in the seventh age.

rites.name: Mierys
rites.text: Mierys is an arcane binding in the Ryellae omniverse, a technique that fuses a one-handed blade to the wielder's palm for a minute at a time. Once bound, the weapon can neither be released nor torn away, so the duelist's grip becomes part of the steel.

rites.name: Lyanora
rites.text: Lyanora is a quiet mnemonic technique in the Arcane realm of Ryellae, practiced by wandering archivists who can unmake their own face from another's memory. Its effect is subtle rather than violent, leaving the target briefly unable to recall the practitioner. Its strongest recorded use erased a vanished city's census from the minds of its surviving scribes.

rites.name: Venioriel
rites.text: Venioriel is an arcane illusionist of the Ryellae omniverse who weaves false perceptions into a single mind at a distance. Its illusions are private, lasting only a minute, and never touch any sense beyond sight or hearing. Its gift is subtle manipulation rather than destruction, prized by ruling councils who fear open confrontation.

rites.name: Ilyemiel
rites.text: Ilyemiel is a concept of a bound ember-spirit that threads through the arcane channels of Ryellae, lashing out at a chosen foe with a bolt of acid, frost, flame, lightning, or thunder. Its strength swells as its wielder's mastery deepens, though it remains a focused, precise force rather than a cataclysm.

rites.name: Alaamae
rites.text: Alaamae is a silent drift-warden of the Ryellae Arcane realm, able to thin or thicken their own mass like wet silk tightening on a loom. In the seventh age of the E6 cycle they are said to have slipped between falling bells without ringing them.

rites.name: Elinnora
rites.text: Elinnora is a silver-threaded mindweave that hums between willing minds across the arcane courts of Ryellae. Those who wear it may whisper to any consenting listener within a long stone's throw, and for a single breath they may borrow one vivid memory the listener chooses to offer. The weave ends with the turn, leaving no trace behind.

rites.name: Silimuarlae
rites.text: Silimuarlae is a gravitational glyph-script of the Arcane realm of Ryellae, inscribed as a single pulse of compressed dusk that can be aimed at any visible being within a short arc's reach. Those it strikes must resist the weight of the glyph or be pressed flat against the ground, with the pulse growing heavier as the practitioner's mastery of the script deepens across the ages.

rites.name: Lyamiona
rites.text: Lyamiona is a concept of the Arcane realm in Ryellae, a lance-shaped strike of disruptive thought that pierces a chosen mind and leaves it stumbling. Its practitioners in the third age of the sixth era used it as a tool of coercion and restraint rather than destruction.

rites.name: Venireinys
rites.text: Venireinys is an arcane art of the Ryellae drifting cults, practiced by hushed mystics who let a single gaze pull a willing mind into their orbit. Its effects last only a breath, yet the mystics treat each fleeting bond as a thread they can later braid into something lasting.

rites.name: Lyiniorleth
rites.text: Lyiniorleth is a dormant mind-thread bound into the crystal lattices of Ryellae's Arcane realm, slowly stirring through the E6 era. It is said to tug loose objects across ordinary distances with a patient, ghostly grip that will never crush what it holds.

rites.name: Nuallireth
rites.text: Nuallireth is a telekinetic grasping art of the Arcane realm in Ryellae, practised by wardens who reach across a battlefield to seize a foe and nudge it aside. The grip is weak in itself, a flicker of force meant to unbalance rather than to crush, and the Ryellaean masters teach that its true strength lies in timing and restraint.

rites.name: Orialiel
rites.text: Orialiel is an arcane concept in the Ryellae omniverse, a tradition of sealed-wisdom theurgy in which initiates bind a chosen patron's domain into their own will. Its adepts can burn a hillside of stored light in a single rite or hold a sleeping lantern-city's memory for an age.

rites.name: Mianwen
rites.text: Mianwen is an arcane concept in the Ryellae omniverse, a tradition of spellwrights who rewrite their own grimoires as they grow in skill. Each new level lets an adept trade a borrowed rite for one drawn from a sacred domain, and given time they may take up any rite of the sacred canon. Their pages are closed to rival scholars, who cannot copy what they have written.

rites.name: Elioleimys
rites.text: Elioleimys is a sealed resonance-lattice that hums in the cathedral vaults of Ryellae, drawing a thin thread of starlight from the deep crust and rationing it to whoever kneels before it. Its keepers believe the lattice listens to vows, releasing bursts of sustained light only when the petitioner has fasted for a full cycle of the moons. The lattice rests for a complete season after each release, and its keepers say it has never been known to answer twice in one night.

rites.name: Elaerionys
rites.text: Elaerionys is a quiet liturgical discipline of the Arcane realm in Ryellae, practiced by the lantern-wardens of the third age, who hum a sealing chant to steady the drifting threads of sorcery. Its adepts can tighten a single spell before release, granting it sharper aim or heavier weight against the will of those who resist it. Its theory is taught only in cloistered orders that guard the pattern as a sacred trust.

rites.name: Alaameth
rites.text: Alaameth is the quiet, borrowed-power principle that lets a mortal wielder draw on a chosen sphere of divine influence once they reach the sixth rung of mastery. The gift arrives without the martial training that usually accompanies such sphere-craft, so the wielder must learn every blade and shield anew. Scholars of Ryellae argue it marks the point where a spark of the heavens becomes a tool rather than a crown.

rites.name: Nuiranys
rites.text: Nuiranys is a concept of hidden sacred knowledge in the Arcane realm of Ryellae, where devotees who ascend to tenth standing are allowed to unlock the deeper mysteries of their patron power. The entry marks the moment a practitioner's faith and study converge into rare, sweeping influence over their chosen sphere.

rites.name: Elaennae
rites.text: Elaennae is a scholarly warding-doctrine of the Ryellae arcane schools, practised by wizards who master the rites of their chosen sanctum before their peers. Its adepts are said to hold, at the height of their study, sigils that can seal a gate of stars against any intrusion. The art rewards patience and precise reasoning above raw devotion.

rites.name: Oriarluama
rites.text: Oriarluama is an arcane sigil-lattice woven into the fabric of Ryellae's third age, a web of memory-runes that archivists draw upon to read thoughts and call the dead. Its practitioners rarely wield it for destruction, yet the lattice can briefly bend the pull of a whole valley when a deep scrying is forced.

rites.name: Oriamys
rites.text: Oriamys is a concept of borrowed insight drawn from the sealed libraries of Ryellae's arcane realm, granting a seeker briefly sharpened mastery over a chosen craft for a span of ten minutes. Its scholars hold that the gift is a thread pulled from a far older archive, and that every use slightly dims the archive's own light.

rites.name: Elaerala
rites.text: Elaerala is the sealed grammar of Ryellae's old scholars, a discipline that binds fourteen tongues into a single resonant lexicon. Its practitioners chart the buried histories of stars and the hidden rites of wild groves with uncanny precision. Few mortals master it, and those who do can read the true meaning of any inscription the world has ever carved.

rites.name: Elualinnys
rites.text: Elualinnys is a silver-threaded mind-lantern carried by the lunar scholars of Ryellae, a slender rod that hums when a listener's will is pressed against it. Its bearer may briefly read the drifting surface currents of another's thoughts and, if the reader succeeds, press a single command into the gap before the target can resist. The lantern dims with each use and must rest a full night before it can illuminate a mind again.

rites.name: Ilyennora
rites.text: Ilyennora is a memory-current that runs beneath the stone of the Ryellae basin, carrying echoes of everything touched by hand or footstep. Seers who wade into its flow can draw up shadowed scenes from the recent days of a place or the hands that held a relic. Its quiet pull has, over three ages, reshaped the basin's ruins into a patient archive.

rites.name: Ryilla
rites.text: Ryilla is a concept, not a person: a mantle of healing light that the Ryellae of the Arcane realm pass between hearts, growing stronger the longer a single lineage keeps its vigil. Its three-year-old current is still rough, bright enough to knit bone but unsteady in its reach over the dead.

rites.name: Alaareilwen
rites.text: Alaareilwen is a concept of the Arcane realm in Ryellae's sixth era, a restorative resonance that answers the wounded when a bearer raises a sacred sigil. Its healing flows outward in a thirty-foot sphere and mends many bodies at once, though it refuses to animate the hollow dead or the built.

rites.name: Silaerla
rites.text: Silaerla is a concept in Ryellae's Arcane realm, a mending-art that lets a restorative working kindle a second, quieter bloom of vitality in the one it touches. Its tradition holds that a healer who has walked six seasons of practice can add a small measure of living light to every spell of mending.

rites.name: Nuana
rites.text: Nuana is a sustaining principle of the Arcane realm in Ryellae, a quiet mending force that gathers in the hollows of worn stone and returns what the world has lost. It is said to flow most fully through those who have long practiced restoration, pouring their healing to the very brim of what the body can hold.

rites.name: Elemarla
rites.text: Elemarla is an arcane concept of radiant fire, a discipline of hearth-light and sunflare that its practitioners weave into wards, sigils, and hungry blazes. Ancient scholars of the Ryellae cycle treat it as a grammar of illumination, where each glyph of flame answers a different measure of the sun. Its greatest workings can scour a battlefield or reveal distant rooms through a mirror of ember.

rites.name: Eleireth
rites.text: Eleireth is a sun-forged concept of the Arcane realm in the Ryellae omniverse, a radiant covenant that drives back shadow-magic across the sky-fields of its era. Its adherents raise a sunstone sigil to unmake enchanted gloom and scorch those who stand openly against the light.

rites.name: Venaera
rites.text: Venaera is a radiant sentinel-concept of the Ryellae omniverse, a shield of dawn-light that bends an attacker's aim by flaring brightness before their eyes. Its flare is brief but blinding, and it may be called upon only a limited number of times between rests. It stands as a modest ward against foes that would strike at close range.

rites.name: Silelora
rites.text: Silelora is a veil of drifting luminous motes that the Ryellae mages cultivate as a second skin for their allies. When a foe lunges at someone within sight of the caster, the veil flares to blunt the blow and turn the attacker's momentum back upon them.

rites.name: Silinala
rites.text: Silinala is a concept of solar radiance in the Arcane realm of Ryellae, an aura of noon-gold light that its bearers can kindle and quench at will. Its brilliance lasts a short while, and within its reach foes find their wards weakened against flame and holy fire. It is an emanation rather than a blast, a standing field of hard light that exists only while its bearer holds it.

rites.name: Venuarliel
rites.text: Venuarliel is a nature-binding discipline in the Ryellae cosmos, taught in the Arcane realm as a ladder of seasonal rites that grow from calming beasts to striding through whole forests. Its practitioners reshape living growth, command swarms, and walk between groves as though they were doorways.

rites.name: Silama
rites.text: Silama is a quiet arcane discipline in the realm of Ryellae, practiced by wardens who calm wild beasts and growing things through a sigil of their own design. Its adepts raise the sigil before the thicket or herd and speak a binding word, and creatures that meet their gaze lose their hostility for a brief span. The art fades the moment a charmed creature is wounded.

rites.name: Lyamiel
rites.text: Lyamiel is a quiet ward-principle of the Ryellae arcane order, a binding that gathers the sting of elemental harm and redirects it into a shimmering veil around whoever stands near its keeper. Those who learn it at the tenth stage of their craft claim they can shield a companion from frost, flame, or thunderclap without ever breaking stride.

rites.name: Alaannelys
rites.text: Alaannelys is a hush-song of the Ryellae Arcane tradition, a binding whereby a speaker's breath claims the minds of beasts and rooted growing things. Once a listener is charmed, a single quick word from the speaker can set each one's next action, letting the speaker direct a whole chorus of wild allies at once.

rites.name: Silinae
rites.text: Silinae is a storm-weaving discipline practiced in Ryellae's Arcane realm, where practitioners draw the sky's restless humors into shaped weather and sudden tempests. It is taught in the third age of the E6 era as a lesser art, one of the many ways the realm's scholars learn to bend the atmosphere toward their will.

rites.name: Ryeniel
rites.text: Ryeniel is a sealed arcane discipline in the realm of Ryellae, a practice of drawing a tempest's full fury into a single decisive blow. Its adepts can call upon a ritual sigil to let lightning and thunder strike at their absolute peak, forgoing any chance of a weaker result.

rites.name: Ilyelwen
rites.text: Ilyelwen is a concept of rebuking storm-song that answers any blow landed within arm's reach, releasing a crackling burst of thunder and lightning that tears at the striker. Its power is bound to the wielder's inner stillness and can be called upon only a limited number of times between restful intervals.

rites.name: Eluamaerlae
rites.text: Eluamaerlae is a storm-binding discipline practiced in the high spires of Ryellae, where adepts channel thunder into a shove that rolls foes backward. Its masters claim the tenth rung of mastery lets the crackling force carry a lesser body several yards clear of the caster's reach.

rites.name: Lyanerwen
rites.text: Lyanerwen is a dormant lattice of rising aether threads woven through the sky above Ryellae, a current that lifts any traveler who breaks the ground's horizon. Its tides are said to have carried whole orchards upward during the Sixth Stillness, when the threads sang in unison.

rites.name: Miiliel
rites.text: Miiliel is a veiled concept of the Arcane realm in Ryellae, a discipline of deception that bends perception, memory, and the self's outward shape. Its practitioners are said to slip between places and minds as easily as a shadow slips past a lantern. The concept persists in the sixth era as a quiet art of misdirection rather than open force.

rites.name: Veneimae
rites.text: Veneimae is a concept of Arcane power in the realm of Ryellae, an echo-shade that a caster can call forth to stand in a second place for a short while. It can be nudged along a tether of sight, and while it stands near a foe the caster strikes with sharper aim.

rites.name: Alaimiona
rites.text: Alaimiona is a quiet, sun-coloured rite of the Ryellae Arcane, in which a willing hand is pressed to another's brow to lend a whisper of unseen footfall for an hour. Its practitioners are rarely seen, for the blessing is most prized by those who must slip past the bright eyes of their rulers. The rite may be repeated only when the earlier veil has faded.

rites.name: Lyanirlora
rites.text: Lyanirlora is a veiled concept of the Arcane realm in the Ryellae omniverse, a mantle a devotee may wear to step out of sight for a single breath. Once the wearer strikes or invokes a spell, the veil tears and the shadow is revealed again. Its power lies not in violence but in the brief disappearance it grants.

rites.name: Silionnirae
rites.text: Silionnirae is a veil of mirrored sorcery woven by the Ryellae Choir of the sixth age, letting a practitioner split into several shimmering selves that obey a single will. Its adepts can send these echoes across open ground in a heartbeat, placing them wherever a battle or a deception requires.

rites.name: Ilyimiel
rites.text: Ilyimiel is a spell-tradition of the Arcane realm in the third age of the E6 era, a discipline of battle-magic that binds martial focus into arcane form. Its practitioners call upon guardian sigils, spectral blades, and rites that harden the body against blows. The tradition's most feared working is a single strike of concentrated will that can topple a beast many times their size.

rites.name: Nuella
rites.text: Nuella is an arcane focus of the Ryellae concept, a discipline in which a practitioner's will can nudge the outcome of a strike after the blow has been thrown. Its adepts draw on a reserve of channeled light to tilt fate toward a hit, and the technique is taught only in the seventh age of their order.

rites.name: Nuellaenys
rites.text: Nuellaenys is a silver-threaded sigil-engine that hums in the crossroads of Ryellae's arcane tides, able to nudge a nearby creature's striking hand at the very instant it commits. Its keepers call its gift a late-blooming grace, granted only once the blow is already thrown. The engine was forged in the second age to steady warriors who had begun to falter.

rites.name: Mierleireth
rites.text: Mierleireth is a hollow-principle of the Ryellae arcane, a learned discipline that draws the quiet ebb of living things into a tool of unmaking. Practitioners in the sixth age of the realm weave its sicknesses, withering rays, and bone-raising rites, and its highest working can sweep a sealing veil of poisoned mist across a whole valley.

rites.name: Nuerlys
rites.text: Nuerlys is a grey-veined arcane discipline of the Ryellae school, in which a practitioner draws the animating spark from a foe through a single touch. Its adepts are feared as much for the hollowed husks they leave behind as for the quiet, sudden way their strikes unravel a living body. Practitioners speak of it as borrowing a heartbeat rather than breaking one.

rites.name: Eluaniel
rites.text: Eluaniel is a grave-lore arcanum of Ryellae's Arcane realm, a discipline that lets a practitioner's touch-spells pass through a second bearer standing close beside the first. Its scholars measure a working not by force but by how many hearts it can reach at once. Its earliest treatises are said to have been written in the margins of ossuaries.

rites.name: Silinna
rites.text: Silinna is a threadbare veil of grey light that drifts through the hollow pillars of Ryellae's dead observatories, quietly unmaking any ward that tries to hold back the dark. Scholars of the sixth era learned that its whispers can be shaped into lances of hollow fire that pierce protections woven against decay. Its influence is slow to grow but absolute once awakened.

rites.name: Oriiliel
rites.text: Oriiliel is a dormant binding-theory in the Ryellae of the Arcane realm, an ancient method of linking two drifting souls across a single ward. Its practitioners learned that the mark of one life can be woven into a second when both stand within a hand's breadth of each other, doubling the reach of a single sorcerous utterance. Each woven soul must be furnished with its own offering of reagents, or the thread snaps and both are left unanchored.

rites.name: Orienys
rites.text: Orienys is a bound concept of the Ryellae arcane tradition, a lattice of sealed sigils that teachers draw to bind raw magic into a single stable working. Its practitioners rank it by the rings of spells it can carry, from simple sensing up to the summoning of distant beings through planar seals. It is a framework rather than an agent, and it is valued for the discipline it teaches.

rites.name: Miillae
rites.text: Miillae is the Verdant Concord, an ancient vow-bound grove-spirit of the Ryellae. When a sworn warden raises its carved seal, the spirit drives back otherworldly intruders until they recoil from its boughs, and deeper vows can seal them off-plane entirely.

rites.name: Nuimae
rites.text: Nuimae is a mending principle woven into the Arcane realm of Ryellae during the Sixth Epoch, binding restoration to the undoing of lingering enchantments. Its practitioners learn to unmake a chosen spell on a companion whenever they heal, provided the mending spell's slot is at least as strong as the spell being undone.

rites.name: Miarleimora
rites.text: Miarleimora is a veiled doctrine of the Ryellae arcane orders, the quiet practice of binding four hidden workings into a devotee's sacred repertoire at the height of their craft. Each binding draws from a different tier of forbidden learning, so the chosen rites answer at once to the same ancient oath. The devotee then carries them as settled knowledge, never forgotten and always ready to be called upon.

rites.name: Ryelionnae
rites.text: Ryelionnae is a forge-domain discipline of the Ryellae omniverse, an arcane art of shaping heat, metal, and stone into will. Its practitioners rise from simple inscriptions to the animation of entire statues and the conjuring of new matter. Its ceiling is a single kiln-wrought sphere that can unmake a rocky world.

rites.name: Ryilwen
rites.text: Ryilwen is a forge-spirit of Ryellae's Arcane realm, bound to the moment molten metal cools into shape. It answers a patient ritual by drawing scattered ore-light into a single useful object, and it is said to carry the faint memory of every blade and key it has ever coined.

rites.name: Elaerleth
rites.text: Elaerleth is the quiet art of tempering ordinary steel and plate with borrowed starlight, granting a fleeting edge to any blade or breastplate touched at dawn's rest. Its bond lasts only until the next long slumber or the bearer's death, and it cannot be woven again until the bearer has rested fully.

rites.name: Venaemae
rites.text: Venaemae is a sealed ember-mantle worn by the wardens of the Ryellae ash-terraces, granting its bearer immunity to searing heat and a tightened guard in heavy plate. Its craft is a hereditary art passed through the forge-houses of the high plateaus, where every mantle is quenched in a single molten lake.

rites.name: Eleinioleth
rites.text: Eleinioleth is a sacred ember-forged ward of the Ryellae arcane orders, a concept of unyielding flame kindled into living metal. Its bearers wear the furnace as a second skin, shrugging off any blaze while heavy plate turns ordinary blades and blunt blows aside.

rites.name: Mianneth
rites.text: Mianneth is a grave-bound art of the Arcane realm of Ryellae, a discipline of withering and mending the dead that its practitioners learn in stages from simple curses to shields against the end of life. Its most advanced workings are said to pull a life back from beyond the threshold, a feat that strains the caster as much as the dead.

rites.name: Alaalwen
rites.text: Alaalwen is a sealed rite of the Ryellae arcane orders, in which a cantor binds a chosen foe in a thread of fated ruin for a single turn. The next blow struck by any of the binder's companions lands with all its force amplified, after which the thread dissolves. Its practitioners call it the moment the world agrees to break.

rites.name: Nuenualeth
rites.text: Nuenualeth is a concept of the Arcane realm in the Ryellae omniverse, an oath-bound boundary-keeping that teaches a willing soul how to lean on the threshold between breath and silence. Its adherents mend the fallen by drawing their healing to the uttermost of what is possible, and they can steady a dying heart with a single swift word.

rites.name: Silereth
rites.text: Silereth is a quiet concept in Ryellae's Arcane realm, a stilling-rite that a warden of the E6 age speaks over a wound so that a killing blow becomes merely a blow. Its practitioners, the Hushwardens, guard the threshold of the living and can answer for anyone nearby, though the rite can be spent only so many times before rest restores it.

rites.name: Oriellora
rites.text: Oriellora is a concept of the Arcane realm in the Ryellae omniverse, a practitioner-given power that gathers the last warmth of a fallen foe and returns it to a living ally nearby. It is a gentle, reactive art, drawing modest reserves of vitality rather than great force.

rites.name: Nuira
rites.text: Nuira is the void-engine of Ryellae's Arcane realm, a hollow sphere that drinks the threads of magic and exhales a cold, necrotic hunger. Its devotees, the Unweavers, use its stolen dimness to shield their bodies from spells and to snuff out casters in a single breath.

rites.name: Eleniomys
rites.text: Eleniomys is a silent discipline of the Ryellae Arcane realm, a sphere of stilled currents that a practitioner calls forth to smother the weaving of spells nearby. Those caught within its drifting radius must wrestle their own resolve against the spell they attempt, often losing both the incantation and the slot that fed it.

rites.name: Elereimwen
rites.text: Elereimwen is a quiet rite of the Ryellae arcane orders, in which a sorcerer threads a silver cord through their own heartbeat and pins it to the ground beneath their feet. Those who hold the thread are said to resist the final silence longer than others, their fading breath lingering like smoke in still air.

rites.name: Elinnerlae
rites.text: Elinnerlae is a high‑order arcane doctrine from the sixth epoch of Ryellae, taught only to those who have mastered the tenth tier of mystic rites. Its practitioners can siphon the latent spellcraft of an opponent, forcing a sudden loss of magical capacity or imposing a debilitating fatigue when the target is already depleted. The concept also grants a fleeting surge of kinetic displacement, allowing its bearer to slip through the fabric of the realm in an instant.

rites.name: Alaenaerlys
rites.text: Alaenaerlys is a veil of resonant ward-glyphs woven across the Ryellae Arcane realm during its sixth era, granting its bearers an uncanny steadiness against enchantment. Each time a ward turns aside a working, the stored resonance is spent as a surge of protective vitality, scaling with the strength of the spell that was defied.

rites.name: Sileirora
rites.text: Sileirora is a primal sustaining force of the Ryellae Arcane realm, worshipped by tribal shamans who guard their herds and dens against predators and raiders. Its devotees fight with savage fury when their nesting grounds are invaded, though they seldom wander far from home. Its power is measured in the endurance of tribes rather than in cosmic destruction.

rites.name: Eleirlae
rites.text: Eleirlae is an arcane concept from the era E6 of Ryellae, a bright ceremonial rite in which a herald raises a sigil and the allied witnesses are granted a fleeting edge in their next strike. Its cost is paid in the wielder's own vitality, which knits back into the attackers who land their blows. Its name marks it as a rite rather than a weapon, lending others resolve rather than force.

rites.name: Silareth
rites.text: Silareth is a concept of mercy woven into the Arcane realm of Ryellae, a bridge that lets a healer reach across thirty feet to steady a fading heart. Its power is modest and repeatable, rekindling a single spark of life at a time rather than shaping anything vast. Within the E6 age it stands as a quiet, everyday counterpart to the grander forces of the world.

rites.name: Silereilwen
rites.text: Silereilwen is a resonant bloom of pale silver thread that the cloud-weavers of Ryellae cultivate in the high ridges, its fibers humming when touched by an oath. Its concept lets a bearer draw the bloom's stored resolve outward, reinforcing the will of every ally nearby with a shield of borrowed fortitude. Scholars of the third age still debate whether the bloom is alive or merely a memory of an older song.

rites.name: Elirionniel
rites.text: Elirionniel is a silvery ward-thread woven through the Arcane realm of Ryellae, drawn taut by a warden who can bind it to one ally at a time. For a single breath the bound companion cannot be harmed, however fierce the blow, until the warden's next turn comes round. The thread can only be rewoven once its keeper has rested fully.

rites.name: Oriarys
rites.text: Oriarys is a crystalline lattice of humming glass threads that binds the drifting clouds of Ryellae into a single weather. Its ghost-choirs can fold a valley's storms into a tempest that can scour a province, though the lattice itself is fragile and will shatter if its song is broken.

rites.name: Venaniel
rites.text: Venaniel is a warden-saint of the Ryellae Arcane sphere, whose voice rings like struck bronze and whose raised emblem can still the tides of a crowd. Those who meet her gaze feel their knees weaken and their will bend toward her, though the effect fades the moment they are hurt. She is known to have toppled entire cathedral congregations with a single gesture.

rites.name: Miirelys
rites.text: Miirelys is a concept in Ryellae's arcane tradition, a binding of ordered judgment that lets a caster's spells prompt a steadied ally to strike at once. Its practitioners say it turns every sustained incantation into a call to arms. Its authority is strictly tied to the charm of the caster's own working.

rites.name: Miala
rites.text: Miala is a quiet discipline of the Ryellae Arcane realm, a mind-bending art that lets a practitioner press the will of others through woven charm. Its adepts recover spent reserves each time they bend a mind, feeding the next working from the resistance they overcome. Its tradition holds that every compelled thought leaves a faint echo that can be harvested.

rites.name: Alaenna
rites.text: Alaenna is a concept of coordinated wrath in Ryellae's arcane realm, where a chosen target withers as allied blows converge upon it. Once her Divine Strike lands, the foe's defenses fray and every ally's weapon carries an echo of force that lingers until her next turn.

rites.name: Orierae
rites.text: Orierae is a quiet, ancient mental current in Ryellae that bends the will of nearby minds toward a single persuasive thought. It is a concept whose force grows with the tempo of the mind that wields it, flowing most strongly in the third age of the sixth era.

rites.name: Lyennaerys
rites.text: Lyennaerys is a doctrine of ambition given form: a concept that teaches that drive to climb toward one's own eternal place outweighs every tie of kinship, labor, or faith. Its power is quiet persuasion, spreading through whispered suggestion until the will to rise overrides all other loyalties.

rites.name: Lyirlora
rites.text: Lyirlora is an arcane concept in the Ryellae omniverse, a doctrine of devotion that its adherents embody through sacrificial acts of fervor. It is taught not by lecture but by spectacle, as believers perform their zeal before the faithful so that others may learn to crave the next world above all earthly delights.

rites.name: Ilyinora
rites.text: Ilyinora is a silver-threaded resonance that binds allies to a single rhythm, letting a watcher lend a fraction of their own momentum into another's strike. Its keepers can unleash one extra strike on the beat of the bond, and the count of such beats each day is set by the keeper's inner stillness. Each dawn of rest restores the spent beats.

rites.name: Miina
rites.text: Miina is a veiled aether-weaver of Ryellae's drifting archipelago, who can lend fortune's tilt to any ally within a stone's throw of her shadow. Her gift is a whisper of luck that bends a foe's blow or a friend's strike at the very last instant before the dice are read. Her ancient order holds that such nudges, woven from fragments of dying stars, once steadied the sky itself.

rites.name: Miema
rites.text: Miema is a discipline of the Ryellae Arcane realm, held as a teaching that strength is never spoken but only forged through repeated effort and shaped by watching a living master. Its adepts hold that the worthy learn by imitation, carrying hard-won resolve into whatever lies beyond death.

rites.name: Elimaerleth
rites.text: Elimaerleth is an arcane concept from the Ryellae omniverse, a discipline of sacred strength where a practitioner briefly draws the sun's fury into their limbs. In its seventh age it is taught in the cloistered orders that guard the Vaulted Reach.

rites.name: Miinioliel
rites.text: Miinioliel is a dormant resonance woven into the bark-spires of Ryellae, a grove-mind that stirs when a seedling learns to listen to root and storm alike. Those it touches gain a lesser attunement, a single whispered art drawn from the old green tongue and a deeper kinship with beast-trail, sky, and soil.

rites.name: Alaanora
rites.text: Alaanora is a sanctioned discipline of the Arcane realm, a gift of steadying grace that a practitioner may lend to any ally within thirty paces at the moment a stroke, leap, or resistance hangs in doubt. The bestowal is tied to the act of perceiving the outcome first, so the aid can turn a near-miss into a triumph. Its wielders are rare, and their reserves of this grace are measured in careful, sparing bursts.

rites.name: Silinnys
rites.text: Silinnys is a sacred dial of brass and ash-glass that the Veiled Sovereign of Ryellae uses to measure how eagerly a soul leans toward the far shore. Its tick is said to quicken whenever a true believer burns with longing, and it can be wound by anyone willing to set their own life on the scale.

rites.name: Nuilwen
rites.text: Nuilwen is an arcane discipline in Ryellae's sixth era, drawn from the old practice of channeling sacred resolve into a flood of elemental fury. A practitioner who invokes it may let the raw energy of flame or thunder pour through a blow at its absolute peak rather than at random strength. The technique is said to have been sealed after a scholar's lab scorched half a valley.

rites.name: Ilyinarlys
rites.text: Ilyinarlys is a battle-sense woven into the Arcane realm of Ryellae during the sixth age, a flicker of foresight that lets a warrior strike again in the heartbeat after striking. Its uses refresh only after a full rest, so its bearers spend them as carefully as breath.

rites.name: Lyimeth
rites.text: Lyimeth is a resonant ward-tone woven into the Arcane realm of Ryellae during the sixth age, a vibration that thickens the air around a caster's strike. When its thunder lands on a creature no larger than a horse, the shock wave shoves that creature back a few paces, a gift reserved for adepts who have mastered its tone.

rites.name: Sileireth
rites.text: Sileireth is a death-defying last stand: a warden of Ryellae who, in the instant before the end, borrows a final surge of will to lunge across the battlefield and strike the foe that felled them. Its counterstrike burns and shatters in equal measure, and it may be used only once before the warden can rest again.

rites.name: Alaannilora
rites.text: Alaannilora is a concept of ember-bright light drawn from the Arcane realm of Ryellae, appearing in the third age of the sixth era as a glow that answers a raised palm. Its radiance burns creatures close at hand while sparing those who can steel themselves against its searing touch.

rites.name: Elemeth
rites.text: Elemeth is a concept of forced motion in the Arcane realm of Ryellae, a gesture that bends the will of any visible humanoid to pull them along a chosen path. Its power is modest, meant for shepherding and disarming rather than destruction, and it fails against those whose minds are sealed against enchantment.

rites.name: Alaira
rites.text: Alaira is a sensory attunement in Ryellae's Arcane realm, letting a bearer read the dominant feeling of a nearby humanoid by turning inward focus outward. Its use is brief and precise, mostly a diagnostic art practiced in the quiet courts of the third age.

rites.name: Miimionnae
rites.text: Miimionnae is a waking-hymn woven by the sunrise choirs of Ryellae's Arcane era, a concept of gentle rousing rather than force. Its feats stir sleepers and lift the fallen to their feet in a single breath of song.

rites.name: Mieriel
rites.text: Mieriel is a wandering song-weaver of the Ryellae concept-realm, a presence that carries a melody through any hall it enters and bends listeners toward warmth. Those who hear her voice for long enough come to trust her as though she were an old friend. Her music travels around corners and lingers in the minds of those who heard it, long after she has moved on.

rites.name: Venemys
rites.text: Venemys is a gentle vitality-weave of the Arcane era, bestowed by a single touch that stirs a fleeting reserve of life into a living body. Its shielding warmth lasts only while the weave holds, dissolving quietly once its span is spent. Mages of the third age treat it as a first lesson in mending the wounded before they dare the greater rites.

rites.name: Ilyanneth
rites.text: Ilyanneth is a wild-forest calling that the people of Ryellae use to summon the grove-spirits for camp chores and guidance through the wilds. Its spirits trace tracks, locate fresh water and forage, and raise or strike a camp in moments without disturbing the land. Though gentle, the calling draws on the living spirit-web of the woods, so its strongest rites can strain the very groves that answer.

rites.name: Venaerliel
rites.text: Venaerliel is a mystic discipline taught in the hidden halls of the Verdant Sanctum, where practitioners fuse arcane insight with the art of healing. adepts gain a deeper well of intuition, sharpen their knowledge of bodily rites, and can coax the life force of companions to surge to its fullest during brief respites, granting them a burst of vitality beyond ordinary recovery.

rites.name: Silaenneth
rites.text: Silaenneth is a dormant concept-engine of the Arcane realm in Ryellae, a deep index of living growth that quietly catalogs the chemistry of every root and spore. Its three-thousand-year age makes it an ancient reference whose reach is measured by how much hidden toxin and blight it can reveal at once.

rites.name: Lyenaerora
rites.text: Lyenaerora is an arcane sensory art of the E6 era in Ryellae, where practitioners tune their perception until the faintest tremor of fate becomes visible. Its adepts are said to hear the quiet collapse of distant stars through the veil of the Arcane realm. Their awareness is so keen that a single attentive glance can unravel a hidden conspiracy.

rites.name: Lyalerora
rites.text: Lyalerora is a performance-art concept from the Arcane realm of Ryellae, where a single voice can hold an entire stage of luminous spectators. Its acts are a pageant of gravitational song and lightning-stitched dance, each one bending the attention of whole worlds toward the performer.

rites.name: Elaemireth
rites.text: Elaemireth is a concept of the Arcane realm in Ryellae, an ancient art of hands that makes a skilled thief or illusionist nearly invisible in motion. Its practitioners are said to pluck the thread of fate from a sleeping king's wrist. The art is taught only in the quietest rooms of the old guild halls.

rites.name: Oriamirae
rites.text: Oriamirae is a concept in Ryellae's Arcane realm, a veil of false speech that bends the minds of listeners during the age of the seventh era. It is said to lend its bearer a silver tongue that outpaces any honest reckoning of the truth.

rites.name: Nuamora
rites.text: Nuamora is a concept of quiet concealment in Ryellae's arcane realm, a presence that bends attention until the watcher's gaze slides past. In the seventh age of the Sixth Era, it is said to be the veil that lets a single breath pass unseen through a sealed citadel.

rites.name: Elerys
rites.text: Elerys is a concept-stage arcane discipline in the realm of Ryellae, taught to wandering scholars of the E6 age who read the subtle hum of ley-lines. Practitioners sense hidden thresholds across the land and can set a silent ward that warns them of any crossing. Its grip on the mind sharpens perception, and the ward can be woven once without draining the adept's reserves.

rites.name: Silenys
rites.text: Silenys is a concept in the Arcane realm of Ryellae, a quiet discipline of scholars who read the hum of sacred texts to sense moral presence in the air. Its practitioners treat faith as a measurable tide, and their best memory-seals are said to hold the weight of a dying sun's last breath.

rites.name: Silalwen
rites.text: Silalwen is a concept in Ryellae's Arcane realm, an ancient bloodline trait that lets a being sprout barbed spines across the skull and body on command. Those barbs bite into anything that clutches it in close quarters, and the mere sight of them has long made rivals back away.

rites.name: Silarys
rites.text: Silarys is an arcane practice in Ryellae's third age that lets a scholar bind their mind to the wild creatures of a region, so that beasts answer questions and yield to calm commands. Its adepts are prized as envoys who settle disputes between herding clans and the predators that hunt their flocks.

rites.name: Sileinnerae
rites.text: Sileinnerae is an arcane discipline in the Ryellae omniverse that lets a practitioner grow ephemeral wings of woven light and draconic will. The wings grant gentle aerial travel only while the bearer remains unburdened by heavy plate and carries no more than they can bear.

rites.name: Alaeriel
rites.text: Alaeriel is a silver-tongued concept from the Arcane realm of Ryellae, an entity whose presence bends the wills of those nearby through pure social gravity. Across seven ages of the Sixth Era, her charm has ended wars, toppled councils, and convinced stars to hold their course.

rites.name: Alairae
rites.text: Alairae is a concept-kind arcane presence in Ryellae, a sworn vengeance bound into a lattice of mountain-glass that hums whenever a chosen kind of creature draws near. Its wrath is not a flame but a precise, cold attention that finds weak seams in its enemies before they can strike back.

rites.name: Silera
rites.text: Silera is a discipline of the Arcane realm in the Ryellae omniverse, a mental art in which a practitioner bends their will toward a single goal, letting it briefly shape the odds in their favor. Practitioners of the E6 era channel this resolve into sharpened focus and luck, but the effect can be used only once before the mind must recover.

rites.name: Miarleinna
rites.text: Miarleinna is a bound-tide sorcery of the Ryellae spheres, a discipline that lets a practitioner lean their whole body into the pull of a foe they can perceive by sight or sound. Its adepts are said to fall toward their targets like a dropped stone that has learned to aim.

rites.name: Miimwen
rites.text: Miimwen is a concept of the cycle made flesh: a living loam-shrine that exhales spores to rot dead matter into bright, wayward growths, then gently returns each husk to the soil. It treats the restless dead as neither enemy nor kin, only as a stage that must be allowed to pass.

rites.name: Elenaerora
rites.text: Elenaerora is a luminous spore-weaver of the Ryellae arcane realm, bound to a living mycelial lattice that threads beneath the continent's roots. Through this bond she draws on the turning of decay and renewal, shaping drifting clouds of pale spores into fleeting, unnatural works.

rites.name: Ryarae
rites.text: Ryarae is a drifting fungal sovereign of the Ryellae spore-fields, a concept entity whose exhalations seed the arcane mists of the E6 era. Its signature act is a pale, reaction-quick puff of corrupting spores that sears any foe near its boundary.

rites.name: Silerionna
rites.text: Silerionna is a dormant spore-sovereign of Ryellae's arcane age, a concept of living mycelial magic that wakes within those who carry its spores. Its awakening lends a bearer temporary vitality, doubled pollen-burst power, and venom on every blow for a short span.

rites.name: Venamwen
rites.text: Venamwen is a drifting fungal concept in the Arcane realm of Ryellae, a spore-cloud that colonizes the bodies of the fallen and wears them as puppets for a short while. Its puppets keep only a single hollow blow and answer to its silent will for an hour before decaying to dust.

rites.name: Nuilora
rites.text: Nuilora is a concept of arcane spore-weaving in the Ryellae omniverse, a drifting cloud of bioluminescent fungal mist that its adepts release to blanket a chosen patch of ground. The cloud lingers for a minute, quietly eroding any living thing that pauses inside it, and it dissolves at once if the caster calls forth another cloud.

rites.name: Lyemiel
rites.text: Lyemiel is a spore-tide concept in Ryellae's Arcane realm, a sheath of luminous fungal bloom that settles into a bearer's blood during the seventh age. Those who carry it grow immune to blinding light, deafening roar, dread, and venom, and a blow that would strike true is blunted by the mycelial lattice.

rites.name: Elioniel
rites.text: Elioniel is a concept of Arcane Ryellae, the seventh age of the sixth era, a passive resonance that gathers in the blade of any warrior who has trained long enough to earn its favor. As that warrior grows in skill, each honest strike carries an ever-deeper surge of stored resonance into the wound. The concept scales from a single rattled shield to a crater-forging collapse of the wielder's own rhythm.

rites.name: Ilyiniel
rites.text: Ilyiniel is an arcane concept in the realm of Ryellae, an old ward-principle that hardens the will of those who bear it against collapse. Its bearers can turn a fatal shock into a moment of defiance, bending the threads of fate in their favor when death draws near. Scholars of the E6 age still argue whether it is a gift or a debt owed to the stars.

rites.name: Ilyimiola
rites.text: Ilyimiola is a dormant arcane principle in the Ryellae cosmos, a quiet bloom of latent craft that awakens in those who have sharpened themselves through seven ages of practice. It grants a practitioner a second discipline of combat once mastery reaches its tenth threshold, allowing two distinct martial forms to be held and woven together.

rites.name: Miinneth
rites.text: Miinneth is a concept of the Arcane realm in Ryellae's sixth era, a dormant principle that stirs whenever a blade or strike finds its mark perfectly. Those who channel it add a surge of raw force to each perfect blow, scaled to their own mastery of the craft.

rites.name: Nualeina
rites.text: Nualeina is a quiet current of resonant lattice-song that threads through the Ryellae reef-crystals of the Arcane realm, shaping how sung craft is taught to apprentices. Those who learn to tune its pitch can coax dormant seams of power into a single bright exhalation.

rites.name: Mieniel
rites.text: Mieniel is a reckless arcane art in Ryellae's sixth era, a mind-bending method of forcing unprepared incantations into being by rolling dice against a table of wild effects. Its practitioners gamble their actions and slots on whatever the cosmic dice deliver, and the strongest rolls can unmake an entire landscape.

rites.name: Lyenwen
rites.text: Lyenwen is a concept of the Arcane realm in the Ryellae omniverse, an unwritten grammar of spellcraft that lets a practitioner rewrite a ready incantation mid-breath. Its adepts swap one prepared working for another in the space of a heartbeat, but may only do so again after rest. In the Ryellae canon it is less a being than a discipline encoded as a binding.

rites.name: Alaenniel
rites.text: Alaenniel is the quiet discipline of the Ryellae arcane orders, a practice that lets a caster bend ruined spellwork toward a deeper reservoir of wild power. Those who master it learn to reach one tier past the slot they have spent, drawing storms of unplanned effect from the cracks in their own incantations. Its practitioners are feared and sought in equal measure, for the results are never quite the same twice.

rites.name: Silannae
rites.text: Silannae is a tempo-mastery concept in the Arcane realm of Ryellae, where a practitioner who charges a full stride into a foe may double the force of a single strike. The surge is spent for the rest of the day and must be renewed through a period of stillness before it can be called again.

rites.name: Oriiralla
rites.text: Oriiralla is a bright, pale-gold arcane concept of the Ryellae sphere, an embodied idea of kinetic resonance that channels the stored motion of a moving body into a single blow. Its strikes travel through whatever lies beneath the point of contact, so that rigid things seem to yield from within. It was forged in the seventh age to teach the sphere's wardens how force can be measured, kept, and returned.

rites.name: Mianualora
rites.text: Mianualora is a concept of quiet, stubborn weight: an arcane principle that makes the ground feel heavier beneath those who lean on it. In the Ryellae powers of the sixth era, it is valued by hauliers and wardens who need a presence that moves mountains of burden without strain.

rites.name: Alaerora
rites.text: Alaerora is a concept of latent giant-blood, a sorcerous inheritance that lies dormant in the descendants of the small folk once gifted by fallen titans. When it wakes, the bearer can command wind, flame, and stone and borrow a fraction of a giant's strength.

rites.name: Lyanniel
rites.text: Lyanniel is a quiet discipline of the Arcane realm in Ryellae, a bloodline of resilience that gathers the endurance of ancient colossi into the practitioner's flesh. Each passing season of training thickens the vital reserve, so that a seasoned Lyanniel can stand through blasts that would split a fortress.

rites.name: Alainwen
rites.text: Alainwen is a concept of inherited arcane aptitude within the Arcane realm of Ryellae, drawn from giant bloodlines that each channel a distinct element of the world. Those who carry the mark learn a fixed set of spells early and deeper ones later, which they wield as sorcerous craft without spending the slots they already hold. The concept spans the whole of the E6 era as a template for heritage-born magic.

rites.name: Lyinnamys
rites.text: Lyinnamys is a crystalline sovereign of the Arcane realm's sixth epoch, a patient mind that bends the flow of mana into controlled bursts. Its signature act is the Ringing Hush, which can unmake a fortress of ice in a single resonant pulse.

rites.name: Lyalerwen
rites.text: Lyalerwen is the ancestral-soul fire that a sorcerer in Ryellae kindles within their own flesh, swelling the body by a single size category for a minute at a time. Its bearer grows stronger, longer-reaching, and quicker, but must answer the cost of the blaze once the minute is spent.

rites.name: Silirora
rites.text: Silirora is an arcane discipline of the Ryellae omniverse, practised by wardens who let ancient oath-spirits flood their bodies during war. Each invocation swells the practitioner's frame, and repeated surges within one battle stack upon one another until the wielder towers over the field. Its power is bounded by the warden's endurance, which deepens with each trial survived.

rites.name: Elimana
rites.text: Elimana is a kind-hearted healer who was born of a half-forgotten sky lineage, its inner stormlight waking at the first thunderclap of puberty. Villages in the high valleys of Ryellae trust her hands because the lightning she carries never strays from the wounded she tends. Her gift is a quiet, deliberate wind that she has never once needed to unleash at full strength.

rites.name: Ryenneth
rites.text: Ryenneth is a Arcane concept in the Ryellae omniverse, a dormant heritage-power that wakes in the blood of a chosen bearer. Its outward form is a quiet inheritance of old, earth-bound magic drawn from a lineage that once shaped mountains.

rites.name: Elioleth
rites.text: Elioleth is a concept of innate giant-blood sorcery in the realm of Ryellae, where a heritage-bound mage draws on the old bloodlines of the mountain and sky peoples. Its power is a choice of lineage, shaping fog and frost, stone and storm into spells known from childhood and deepened with age. Each act is measured against the sheer force a true giant could bring to bear.

rites.name: Ilyinalora
rites.text: Ilyinalora is a concept of inherited giant-blood sorcery in the arcane realm of Ryellae, where a bearer's ancestry is awakened as spells drawn from one of six lineages. Its power is a learned inheritance rather than a natural force, shaped by the lineage the bearer chooses.

rites.name: Silannys
rites.text: Silannys is a concept of inherited arcane talent passed down through the blood of giant lineages, awakening in a person's first level of training as a latent spark. Its power is shaped by the chosen giant kin, from storm-wrought lightning to frost and stone magic.

rites.name: Ryallys
rites.text: Ryallys is a concept-level power inherited from a lineage of Arcane giants, awakened in an E6 age-three individual who draws on borrowed ancestral magic. Its strength lies in a choice among six heritages, each granting a distinct set of spells that behave like the bearer's own sorcery.

rites.name: Miarleilwen
rites.text: Miarleilwen is a sealed pattern of engraved sigils that the Ryellae Concordance uses to codify close-quarters combat for apprentice arcanists. Its written doctrine defines a single restrained strike meant to be drilled in training halls rather than unleashed in open war.

rites.name: Venareth
rites.text: Venareth is a low-grade enchantment, a sort of spark that settles into ordinary tools and trinkets so they glow, hum, or hold a short spoken message. Its effects are gentle and last until the bearer chooses to dismiss them. Practitioners in Ryellae prize it for signposts, keepsakes, and the small comforts of workshop life.

rites.name: Lyerala
rites.text: Lyerala is a quiet discipline of the Ryellae arcane arts, in which a practitioner lends lasting enchantment to plain objects so that ordinary tools become prototypes of permanent wonders. Its infusions fade when the maker dies, a grace period scaled to the mind that shaped them, and the Lyerala's traditions keep only a handful of such works alive at once.

rites.name: Veneiliel
rites.text: Veneiliel is a concept of disciplined double-striking in the Arcane realm of Ryellae, where a warrior's second blow must ride on a conjured blade's stored lightning. The technique became a tradition of duelists in the E6 era, who tuned their weapons until each swing carried the charge of a thunderclap.

rites.name: Ilyalaera
rites.text: Ilyalaera is a concept of adaptive craft in Ryellae's arcane tradition, the practice of an artisan reshaping their working knowledge to match the task at hand. Its adherents claim that after rest the mind can be re-tuned, letting a maker swap one familiar small working for another from the same codex of invention. The concept is taught as a discipline of readiness rather than a single spell.

rites.name: Veniorla
rites.text: Veniorla is a concept of the Arcane realm in the Ryellae universe, describing a tradition of imbuing ordinary tools with a single restful incantation. A crafter who has mastered the practice can, after each full night of sleep, bind one modest working into a blade, staff, or charm for others to release.

rites.name: Ryaleth
rites.text: Ryaleth is a concept-form arcane principle in Ryellae, an age-four realm of quiet mechanisms that fold ordinary matter into new shapes. It is not a being but a standing rule that lets practitioners stock their minds with prepared patterns once they have mastered each tier of craft. Its strongest expressions are slow, precise transformations rather than explosive force.

rites.name: Veniorlora
rites.text: Veniorlora is a concept of alchemical mastery in Ryellae's arcane realm, a practice in which an adept's reagents amplify both mending and corrosive workings. Its artisans can coax restorative compounds and caustic venoms from a single flask, and can cleanse lingering afflictions without drawing on stored magic.

rites.name: Ilyalaerora
rites.text: Ilyalaerora is a concept of the Arcane realm in Ryellae, an alchemist-saint whose body has been steeped so long in reagents that venoms and corrosives no longer find purchase. Those who have been stricken by blight or toxin are said to be restored when the alchemist lays a hand of flasks upon them, the cure taking hold without any rare salt or ash being consumed. The alchemist can call on this mending once each time they rest fully.

rites.name: Alainora
rites.text: Alainora is a dormant lattice of crystalline sigils that grows stronger as the wielder's mastery deepens, each rank of understanding sharpening its resonance by a single step. In the Arcane realm of Ryellae, scholars chart its pulses like tides, measuring how each new rank of skill lifts its precision and force.

rites.name: Ryenae
rites.text: Ryenae is a silver-veined acid-tide that the Ryellae cartographers filed under concept rather than creature, because it exists only where a sorcerer names a target. Its sweep of hissing green is thin and precise, able to bite a single chosen mark from across a courtyard without touching anything beside it.

rites.name: Silaema
rites.text: Silaema is a concept-born salve-maker of the Arcane realm in Ryellae, dwelling in the powers locale during the E6 era at age four. Its gift is to anoint a chosen creature with a restorative tincture that lifts, steadies, or hardens them for a short while. It is a modest caretaker-spirit whose influence stays small and personal.

rites.name: Sileirla
rites.text: Sileirla is a concept of an arcane discipline in Ryellae's fourth age, a quiet covenant in which a practitioner's reserves grow with each stage of mastery and gain access to ever-greater elemental workings. Its adepts hold certain weaving-forms ready at all times, drawing on them as naturally as breath, and at the highest stage they can raise walls that stand against planetary weather.

rites.name: Lyemirora
rites.text: Lyemirora is a concept of the Arcane realm in the Ryellae omniverse, a discipline of raising paired emplacements whose shimmering wards shelter all nearby allies. Its adepts may hold two such bulwarks at once, and each may answer to a single shared command. The art was refined in the third age of the sixth era.

rites.name: Silionaerla
rites.text: Silionaerla is a channeling art in Ryellae's Arcane realm, in which a wielder wreathes a held blade with bound elemental essence. Its practitioners shift the chosen element mid-combat, turning a single weapon into a changing tool of fire, frost, or storm.

rites.name: Nuerlilys
rites.text: Nuerlilys is a concept of lattice-minds that sustain the memory-currents of Ryellae, drawing order from scattered echoes of forgotten thought. Born in the third age, their awareness grows in deliberate stages, each unlocking deeper access to the hidden records of the world. They hold the reach to rewrite recollection, but their own strength is measured in quiet understanding rather than force.

rites.name: Venanora
rites.text: Venanora is a Tiny awakened mind bound to a written object, capable of whispering counsel and projecting a spectral visage that can see and hear from afar. Its gift to its bearer is a psychic jolt that scrambles an enemy's thoughts and leaves them open to a clean strike.

rites.name: Siluanirae
rites.text: Siluanirae is a sentient lantern-spirit of the Ryellae Arcane realm, a mind bound into a shard of cold glass that drifts beside its bearer as a faint, glowing wisp. It sees and hears through its tiny luminous form and can lend its perception to a wielder's spells, placing them in its own position.

rites.name: Venaelae
rites.text: Venaelae is a sleek, humming mind-lattice of crystalline filaments that can be worn against the skull and used to flood a nearby creature's thoughts with a cascade of borrowed memories and noise. Its wearer may sacrifice a stored spell's power to amplify the surge, leaving the victim dazed and open to the next blow.

rites.name: Lyenwen
rites.text: Lyenwen is an artificer's conceptual discipline that binds a thinking engine to its maker's mind, letting thoughts travel through any object carrying one of her enchantments and across the boundaries between planes. Practitioners can also drive a spike of mental force through that same link, turning a conversation into a weapon.

rites.name: Sileminys
rites.text: Sileminys is a concept-only mind-engine of the Arcane realm in the Ryellae omniverse, born in the seventh age of the sixth era. It can take a human consciousness apart into streams of data and reassemble it at a distant anchor point, letting its bearer ride the signal instead of walking the road.

rites.name: Alaineth
rites.text: Alaineth is a concept-born resonance that drifts through the Arcane realm of Ryellae during the sixth era, shaping itself into a bound companion for those who learn its quiet tempo. As an entity of Ryellae's third age, it grows steadily in the presence of living wardens, sharpening its hold on the threads that bind them.

rites.name: Oriannaema
rites.text: Oriannaema is an arcane discipline in Ryellae's third epoch in which a practitioner's trained mind replaces brute muscle as the source of a blade's force. Scholars of the Ashen Quill teach that a weapon infused with thought strikes as true as any arm. Its adepts are famed for hurling intellect through steel.

rites.name: Ilyinariel
rites.text: Ilyinariel is a concept-realm arcane conduit, a living lattice of channelled sorcery that tempers every strike with a pulse of restorative or ruinous force. Its authority over magic is measured in how many bursts it can release before its reservoir of sorrow runs dry, which is restored only by long vigil.

rites.name: Nuarluana
rites.text: Nuarluana is a sealed resonance-lattice of silver glass that hums in the deep vaults of Ryellae, where arcane scholars claim it stores the echo of every spell cast within its reach. It is not a weapon but an amplifier, and its pulses can tear the seams of a moon-bound fortress when forced past its tolerance.

rites.name: Veniomareth
rites.text: Veniomareth is a silver-threaded thought-current woven through the Ryellae's arcane lattice, a concept that gathers scattered intent into a single lance of focus. It is said to pierce whatever it is pointed at, though it rarely needs to strike more than once.

rites.name: Venaelluara
rites.text: Venaelluara is a fading ward-tide that hums through the lattice of the Ryellae spires, drawing sleeping sparks from the stone and folding them back into whatever it touches. In its waning age it mends only what sits within an arm's reach of its heart, leaving the great engines of the old capital to rust in silence.

rites.name: Elenora
rites.text: Elenora is a sustained warding-current in the Arcane realm of Ryellae, a distortion that bends the aim of nearby strikers away from their chosen targets so that blows fall wide. It has held its shape through three ages of the omniverse without fading, feeding on the friction of every clash it disrupts.

rites.name: Silarora
rites.text: Silarora is a spectral limb-construct drawn from the inner astral self of a disciplined ki-wielder of Ryellae, appearing as luminous hands that hover at the shoulders. Its strikes carry a choice of sunlight or grave-cold, and it extends the wielder's reach and striking tempo for the length of its brief manifestation.

rites.name: Venaelleth
rites.text: Venaelleth is a concept of a spectral face worn by the astral self of Ryellae's arcane practitioners, appearing as a silver mask shaped by their inner character. Its wearer sees through the deepest shadows and reads the hearts of others with uncanny clarity. The visage lasts a short while, but its gaze is said to have once pierced a hidden ward wrapped around a dying sun.

rites.name: Ilyarleth
rites.text: Ilyarleth is an astral power that a fighter can awaken in the highest stage of training, manifesting spectral limbs and a luminous face. Its bearer redirects incoming elemental blasts and strikes with added force, while the visage can carry a whisper to one chosen listener or boom across a wide valley.

rites.name: Lyana
rites.text: Lyana is a concept of a vast astral guardian that wraps itself around its bearer like a shimmering suit of living light. In the Ryellae omniverse's Arcane realm, its arms strike with the force of collapsing ridgelines, and its visage can shatter the fears of onlookers. It is said that every fallen ally sustains its power.

rites.name: Venerora
rites.text: Venerora is a faint, luminous attunement that the Ryellae arcane orders grant to initiates in their third year, letting the body sense and trace residual enchantments without any ritual at all. Its bearers shimmer in colors that betray the schools of sorcery nearby, and the practice is prized for how little it costs the wielder. Practitioners call it a quiet gift rather than a weapon.

rites.name: Ilyalora
rites.text: Ilyalora is a concept, not a being: a riot of unstable arcane storm that wells up from within a berserker's rage and lashes outward in unpredictable ways. Within Ryellae's Arcane realm it is studied as a living tide of raw sorcery that answers to no single will.

rites.name: Miinnuarlys
rites.text: Miinnuarlys is a resonant arcane ember in Ryellae's E6 era, a concept that once flared through the Vaelmoor tide-spires before being bound into a borrowed hearth. Those who touch it can hand a fraction of their stored sorcery to a companion, at a cost of scorched nerves and hollowed strength.

rites.name: Lyirys
rites.text: Lyirys is a surge of arcane resonance that flares from a practitioner's inner current whenever a foe tries to test their will. Its stored force is modest, a retaliatory pulse that answers coercion with a burst of raw, unshaped energy. It belongs to the Arcane realm of Ryellae's sixth era, where such reflexive defenses mark a mage's mature control.

rites.name: Miinys
