rites.text: Miinys is a vault of spilled starlight that gathers in the marrow of those who rage in the Ryellae hills. At its fullest, a single bound lets one wielder reshape the sky's chaotic currents, turning a murmur of raw force into a burst of unpredictable power. The wielder may reshape the surge at will, though each reshaping is a gamble against the next.

rites.name: Lyilena
rites.text: Lyilena is a silver-threaded mind-weaver of the Ryellae concept-realm, able to stitch a whispering bridge between her thoughts and another's across a short distance. The bridge hums for ten minutes and frays if she falls or is struck senseless. Its energy is modest, measured in the quiet power of a single shared thought.

rites.name: Ryanneirlys
rites.text: Ryanneirlys is a quiet, cerebral concept in the realm of Arcane, an era-six mind-art that reshapes thought from the inside out. Its practitioners learn subtle, unfamiliar mental techniques as they grow, letting them bend perception without altering the body.

rites.name: Oriareth
rites.text: Oriareth is an arcane aberration-born ward, a living shield whose body secretes a viscous, shimmering slime that deflects blows and blunts incoming spells. Within the Ryellae omniverse it is taught as a discipline for wanderers who stand between their kin and the world's hungers, measured by how little a strike can take from them.

rites.name: Nuenae
rites.text: Nuenae is a concept-born channel of the Arcane realm in the omniverse of Ryellae, drawn from the third age of the sixth era. Its power lets practitioners release woven thought as raw intent, bypassing material rites by spending reserved inner fire. Its feats scale with the will of those who hold it, reaching planetary violence in rare hands.

rites.name: Venilleth
rites.text: Venilleth is a veil-woven concept of the Arcane realm in Ryellae's sixth era, a discipline in which the mind is wrapped in layered silk of thought so that intruding whispers slide off unseen. Practitioners of the age of seven are said to turn aside fear and enchantment as easily as a river turns aside a fallen leaf.

rites.name: Nuamiorlora
rites.text: Nuamiorlora is a slick, many-limbed aberration of the Arcane realm, born from a bargain between a drowned sorcerer and a sea of mucus that remembered every shape. It is said to bleed through the seams of Ryellae, slipping between narrow cracks to unpick the lies that hold a body together.

rites.name: Nuamwen
rites.text: Nuamwen is a psychic-reality anomaly that flickers through Ryellae's arcane reaches, appearing as rippling sheets of luminous gel or swarms of translucent parasites. Wherever it lingers, the ground resists and minds scream, yet it can snatch allies away in a sudden lurch of space. It has been seen drawing ruined cities back into the veil between realms.

rites.name: Ilyaremys
rites.text: Ilyaremys is a spectral tentacle conjured from the undersea dreams of Ryellae's drowned archive, a ghostly limb that lashes at foes and slips away between strikes. Its lashes can freeze or crackle with storm-light, and each renewed summoning sharpens its bite. Scholars note it answers only to those who have learned to listen to the deep.

rites.name: Nuerwen
rites.text: Nuerwen is a bonded channel of tide-sung thought, woven into the minds of the deep-water kin of the Ryellae shallows. Those who carry it can speak across the wet dark to any sea-bound creature within a short reach, and that creature answers in kind.

rites.name: Alaeluanwen
rites.text: Alaeluanwen is a tidal veil woven from the breath of drowned choirs, worn by those who have sworn to the deep sea-spirits of Ryellae. Its wearer can draw life from both sky and brine and swim as swiftly as they walk, while frost loses its bite against them.

rites.name: Silela
rites.text: Silela is a shielding discipline of the Arcane realm in the Ryellae omniverse, drawing a single coiling limb of pale light out of the dark to catch harm meant for its bearer or a nearby companion. The limb blunts half of any blow that lands within its reach, then unravels into motes and is gone. Practitioners train for years before they can call one back in a second.

rites.name: Ryilora
rites.text: Ryilora is a silent, translucent maw born from the hungering dreams of Ryellae's oldest gods, and it devours anything that wanders within its reach. Those who call it upon a chosen point hold it there for a single minute, during which the maw grips its prey and feeds on frost or lightning. Each use drains its summoner's reserves and leaves them temporarily fortified by the stolen vitality.

rites.name: Ryenae
rites.text: Ryenae is a sealed lattice of silver tide-glyphs that hangs in the Ryellae's dim axis, humming whenever a chosen supplicant calls its name. When summoned it drags nearby allies through a shimmering undertow to any remembered place, or lashes foes with cold and storm-bright cords.

rites.name: Nuiliorla
rites.text: Nuiliorla is a dormant concept-engine in the Arcane realm of Ryellae, a lattice of resonant thought-glass that hums only when a mind presses against it. Its designers in the third age of the sixth era named it for the quiet pressure of an unheard chord.

rites.name: Silerleth
rites.text: Silerleth is a concept of resonant speech in the Arcane realm of Ryellae, an entity that can be heard and understood by any creature it chooses to address. Its voice reaches beyond the boundaries of tongues, binding listeners into shared comprehension for a brief span. Though its feats are modest, it commands a deep subtlety of persuasion across the age of its making.

rites.name: Silaemys
rites.text: Silaemys is a quiet discipline of the Ryellae arcane orders, a way of softening a crowd's temper through measured, honest speech. Its practitioners claim the skill reshapes feeling without breaking will, and they recharge the gift only through deep rest. Its earliest lessons were carved into the courts of the third age.

rites.name: Mialleth
rites.text: Mialleth is a concept in Ryellae's Arcane realm, a knot of spoken reasoning woven with enchantment that can either steady a listener or tangle their thoughts beyond unraveling. Its speech carries a quiet weight that reaches across rooms, bending the minds of those who can hear it. It is a craft of persuasion made into a weapon of the mind.

rites.name: Alaareirla
rites.text: Alaareirla is a concept of Ryellae's Arcane realm in the E6 era, a resonance of spoken persuasion that carries a listener's resolve across a crowd. Its refrains are said to outlast failure, letting a faltering voice keep a fragment of courage until a rest restores it.

rites.name: Elualora
rites.text: Elualora is the lingering resonance of an arcane tide that once swept through the Ryellae cloud-harbours, now kept as a discipline of bodily grace. Those who attune to it can call upon borrowed momentum, moving with a sure footing that seems to bend the rules of gravity for a short while.

rites.name: Elioraelys
rites.text: Elioraelys is a concept of guided precision in the arcane realm of Ryellae, a discipline in which a practitioner's strikes are steered toward the seams of an opponent's defenses. Its influence is confined to a single minute of focused action, during which fortune itself seems to lean toward the wielder's blade. The power is valued more for its reliability than for raw force.

rites.name: Ilyinnemeth
rites.text: Ilyinnemeth is a battle-hymn of Ryellae, a concept of valor that surges through the bodies of comrades when a blow lands true. Its power is a wellspring of courage that can either harden allies against harm or cow foes until dread overtakes them. The surge can be spent only once per turn, forcing its bearer to choose carefully where the courage flows.

rites.name: Lyiremeth
rites.text: Lyiremeth is a concept of the Arcane realm in the Ryellae omniverse, a guardian-principle that bends the trajectory of incoming hostility around any who stand under its oath. Its power is an act of redirection rather than destruction, turning a blow aside and returning a single strike of its own in the same breath.

rites.name: Ilyelina
rites.text: Ilyelina is a concept of stories given form, an arcane tradition in the Ryellae cosmos where a hero's reputation becomes a shield and a spear. Those who bear it borrow the weight of songs sung about them, turning rumor into grace, luck, and defiance. Its power is brief and must be rested for before it can be called again.

rites.name: Venameth
rites.text: Venameth is a concept of sight-granting light in the Arcane realm of Ryellae, an ancient vision that pierces every shadow and lends its clarity to nearby allies. It is said to have been woven during the third age of the Sixth Era by wardens who feared that darkness would swallow their fellow watchers. Its gift fades slowly, returning its keepers to fullness after each long rest.

rites.name: Eliriel
rites.text: Eliriel is a dusk-thread weaving practice from the arcane traditions of Ryellae, in which a practitioner sews a faint watchfulness into another's nerves so they wake sharper at the first sign of danger. The gift lasts only until the opening clash of a fight and dissolves once it has been spent, and it can be rewoven at will.

rites.name: Elaeruana
rites.text: Elaeruana is a concept-born power of the Arcane realm in Ryellae, a sphere of soft dusk light that travels with its bearer and mends the frayed nerves of anyone who lingers within it. Its tide of calm lasts only a short while before it fades back into the bearer's presence.

rites.name: Mialae
rites.text: Mialae is a concept born in Ryellae's arcane realm during the third age of the E6 era, a quiet power that answers to the hush between day and night. It grants a steadiness against terror and a brief surge of lift whenever shadows gather close around its bearer.

rites.name: Miireimwen
rites.text: Miireimwen is a concept of hushed nightfall in Ryellae's Arcane realm, a veil that thickens around chosen watchers so they alone can pierce it. Its ceiling is set by the planetary scale of the Ryellaen dusk, so the veil can smother a whole region's light without ever burning anything. Only its bearers can see through what it hides.

rites.name: Miiriel
rites.text: Miiriel is a wildfire spirit of the Ryellae omniverse, a sentient blaze that kindles in the hollow of a dying forest and answers to whoever carries its ember. Born from the fourth bloom of the Sable Cinders, it wanders between kindled groves, guiding travelers who promise to let its flames take what has already decayed.

rites.name: Alaanae
rites.text: Alaanae is a concept of kindled cinder-bonds in the Ryellae omniverse, where a living ember binds to a caster and magnifies both ruin and mending. Each act of flame or healing lets the bond gift a surge of stored heat to the spell, and the flame may leap from either the caster or their bound ember.

rites.name: Nualora
rites.text: Nualora is a concept of living embers that the Ryellae people call the last breath of flame, a force that gathers in fallen bodies and rekindles them as warmth. Those who learn to coax it can scatter restorative or scorching sparks from a recent death, though each act draws heavily on the caster's own vitality. Its power is modest against the scale of worlds but grows with the number of those who witness it.

rites.name: Ryilleth
rites.text: Ryilleth is a concept of defiant flame in the Arcane realm of Ryellae, a warden-spirit that refuses to let its bearer fall. When death looms, it erupts into a ring of living fire that scorches nearby foes and grants a surge of borrowed vitality. It can only be called upon once before the bearer rests fully.

rites.name: Venamae
rites.text: Venamae is a kindled ember-spirit of the Ryellae arcane realm, born seven ages ago from a dying lantern-star's last flicker. It grows in power as its bearers learn their craft, its strength rising step by step with each rank of mastery it is trusted to carry.

rites.name: Miamiola
rites.text: Miamiola is a concept of Ryellae's arcane age, a gleaming lantern-spirit that unfolds from the hearts of old beacon keepers. When it is called, it slips its bearer and nearby allies across short gaps of light, leaving behind a brief flare that scorches anyone standing too close to where it was.

rites.name: Miamys
rites.text: Miamys is a quiet art in the Ryellae cosmos, a method of coaxing a being's hidden designation out of its own resonance until the name rings aloud in the listener's mind. Practitioners say a creature that refuses to yield its name is the rarest sign of a lie. Those who wield it carry the knowledge at a cost, since a stolen name always remembers whom it was torn from.

rites.name: Veneirla
rites.text: Veneirla is a concept of the Arcane realm, a presence that answers only to its own true name, which it speaks aloud to anchor its will across the age's low-hum tides. Lesser entities of this kind hold the names of stars and the names of the sleeping dead, so Veneirla's word can bind or loosen them.

rites.name: Ryireinnae
rites.text: Ryireinnae is a concept of resonant speech, a word-of-power that binds to a creature's true name and bends spells to that name. Its uses are finite and recovered through rest, which makes each invocation a deliberate, costly act within the Ryellae arcane order.

rites.name: Oriilleth
rites.text: Oriilleth is a dormant naming-current woven into the bedrock of Ryellae's Arcane age, a sigil-science that lets a speaker bind a true name to a force and release it. Its seven ages of sleep leave it hungry for speakers who can carry its resonances without fraying. Scholars treat its deepest utterances as a reserve of pure, deliberate ruin.

rites.name: Venaerae
rites.text: Venaerae is a concept of Ryellae's arcane tradition, a binding-craft by which a speaker's utterance of a creature's hidden true name slips past its protections so that spells strike with force or thought rather than their usual elements. Scholars of the E6 era, three ages past the founding of the schools, still argue over whether the practice was ever truly learned or merely inherited.

rites.name: Ryamys
rites.text: Ryamys is a binding-wrought sheath of crystallized aether that forms about a caster whenever a spell strikes its chosen foe, absorbing the backlash as a shell of living light. It thickens as the caster's mastery of the Ryellae weave deepens.

rites.name: Nuamae
rites.text: Nuamae is a quiet binding-rite of the Ryellae arcane orders, a ward-sigil that clouds a target's will just long enough for the first resistance to falter. Scholars of the sixth era mostly employ it as a tool of persuasion rather than harm, since its hold lasts only a single struggle.

rites.name: Lyima
rites.text: Lyima is a sigil-bound resonance woven into the Ryellae arcane lattice, a quiet echo that attaches to a wounded foe and rings back with force on the first harm it suffers. Its strength swells as the bearer's mastery deepens, deepening the reverberation from a faint shiver to a bone-cracking chime.

rites.name: Elaemae
rites.text: Elaemae is a concept of the Arcane realm in the Ryellae omniverse, an unseen thread of insight that lets a practitioner read the enchantments clinging to any target and unpick one of them by sheer cleverness. Its dispelling is a matter of wit rather than force, so its energies stay modest and its reach is intellectual.

rites.name: Ryaneth
rites.text: Ryaneth is a sealed tide of resonant glass that drifts between the drowned spires of Ryellae, bending anything that strikes it toward or away from its current. Its arcane pulse, when it lands, can fling a foe several strides across the basin floor and leave them sprawling.

rites.name: Ryareth
rites.text: Ryareth is a sealed resonance-glyph in the Ryellae era of arcane craft, used by scholars to reach into hidden places. When a practitioner names a presence within reach, the glyph lets the working find its mark even through walls of shadow or stone.

rites.name: Elamys
rites.text: Elamys is a runic discipline of the Ryellae Arcane realm, in which an initiate scribes temporary sigils onto armaments and armor. Each sigil fades at the close of a full rest, so every dawn the practitioner must re-engrave their gear anew. The art is taught as a rite of readiness rather than a weapon in itself.

rites.name: Mienys
rites.text: Mienys is a concept of borrowed colossal might, a sigil-kindling technique by which an Arcane practitioner swells to towering proportions and gains the strength of an ancient mountain-born titan for a brief span. The stature gained is limited by the surrounding space, so a cramped tunnel holds the practitioner to their ordinary size. The technique may be called upon twice before rest is needed.

rites.name: Nuira
rites.text: Nuira is a concept of warding light in the Ryellae omniverse, a silver glyph that flares across the sky to shield a friend from a blow just as it lands. Its wardings are said to bend the lethal arcs of incoming strikes, and it can hold three distinct sigils at once. Those who train with it learn to read the lines of danger before the blade falls.

rites.name: Nuelleireth
rites.text: Nuelleireth is a concept of arcane power in the Ryellae omniverse, a sigil-bearing force that writes itself permanently into whoever carries it. Its bearers grow taller and stronger as the marks deepen, reshaping flesh around each new inscription. The power is young in its third age, and its full reach remains unmeasured.

rites.name: Ryanirleth
rites.text: Ryanirleth is a sigil-carved discipline of the Arcane realm, a practice in which a bearer inscribes lattice-marks that store and release tidal force across Ryellae's third age. Its adepts learn five marks each, and every mark may be woken twice before the bearer must rest, a rhythm that restores all charges with the dawn of each recovery.

rites.name: Ryinna
rites.text: Ryinna is a sigil of the Arcane realm in the Ryellae omniverse, a rune of foresight that lets its bearer read the rippling threads of coming events. Those who invoke it step briefly outside the flow of time and can bend the fortune of anyone within sight, tilting a blade or a plea toward success or ruin.

rites.name: Miarora
rites.text: Miarora is a concept of a drifting bloom-spirit that gathers the pollen-light of dying stars into a living swarm, able to lift and reshape matter by coaxing its motes into obedient tides. In the Ryellae powers-tradition it is known as a gentle keeper's companion, though its swarms can strip a valley bare when provoked.

rites.name: Alaarionwen
rites.text: Alaarionwen is a swarm of pale, glimmering fey spirits that cling to a wielder and surge along their weapons when the moment is right. Its agitation makes each strike bloom with a bite of unseen force, dragging a foe closer or hurling it back at the wielder's will. The swarm wanes after a few uses but returns with the dawn of each new rest.

rites.name: Veneirora
rites.text: Veneirora is a concept-form swarm-lattice of the Arcane realm in the E6 era, a drifting cloud of self-assembling motes that gathers into a ring and carries a wielder through the air. Its gathered form can hurl a bearer across open ground or lift them above it.

rites.name: Miellae
rites.text: Miellae is a shimmering swarm-spirit of the Ryellae arcane realm, a gossamer mind that can coax one of its drifting motes into the body of a small creature for a single hour. Its loyalty is measured in how gently it bends the threads of its kin, not in force, and its wings hum faintly with the echoes of whatever it witnesses.

rites.name: Alaimae
rites.text: Alaimae is a recollection-engine woven into the lattice of Ryellae's Arcane realm, a faint resonance that lets a soul reclaim fragments of skill from a life it once lived. Each dawn after deep rest, it grants a passing mastery over one craft or instrument, which may be exchanged for another when the next rest ends.

rites.name: Silaenniel
rites.text: Silaenniel is an ascetic-artifact of the Arcane realm, a dormant lattice of pale glass that hums with the stillness between heartbeats. Its wielders are said to need no breath, meal, or dream, resting instead in a waking trance from which they hear the world as clearly as ever. It is revered in the crypt-orders of Ryellae for granting resilience against rot and venom.

rites.name: Lyilannora
rites.text: Lyilannora is a concept of cold, dormant force that stirs in the marrow of those who return from the dead, and whose strength awakens within a radius of a few meters of the body. Its bolts, once loosed in the quick instant after a swift movement, can wither a foe at the distance of a short street. The one who wields it can only spend it once per flicker of action, for it draws from the same reserve as their sudden strikes.

rites.name: Sileruanwen
rites.text: Sileruanwen is a bone-lantern art of the Ryellae's arcane scholars, in which a mage kindles a thread of memory inside a fallen body and borrows whatever skill the departed once held. The borrowed gift fades with the next rest, leaving the speaker unsure whose hands had truly learned it.

rites.name: Alaamys
rites.text: Alaamys is a concept of the Arcane realm in the Ryellae omniverse, a silent dialogue between the living and the powers that govern the threshold of ending. When a bearer stands at the edge of death, Alaamys opens a channel where three-word answers are drawn from the memories of every soul that has ever passed, and returning from the brink lets the bearer rewrite the self that nearly vanished.

rites.name: Veneillae
rites.text: Veneillae is a veil-walking concept in the arcane realm of Ryellae, a being who drifts between this world and a dim shadow-layer at will. Its passage is quick and quiet, but any solid barrier of strong enchantment turns the step into a stumble. Misjudged arrivals in occupied space violently hurl it aside.

rites.name: Venerla
rites.text: Venerla is a discipline of the Ryellae Arcane realm, an inner-flame art by which a warrior's mind is wound tight and loosed through the body. Its practitioners are taught to shield their allies with a rippling aura of resolve, or to sharpen each blow with a stinging surge of thought. Its gifts are modest at first but grow with the adept's mastery.

rites.name: Silannora
rites.text: Silannora is a veil-cantrip woven into the grammar of Ryellae's arcane tongue, letting a practitioner conjure a drifting ghost-hand from sheer intent. Its shape is a whisper of will, able to nudge a teacup or turn a page, yet it is governed by the mind rather than by any spoken incantation. The hand may be rendered unseen at the caster's pleasure, the way a thought passes unnoticed in a crowded room.

rites.name: Lyirlora
rites.text: Lyirlora is a telekinetic weaver of the Ryellae Arcane realm, able to snap an unseen force at any foe within a short reach and yank them closer or fling them back. Each use drains a reservoir of mental discipline that refills only after a full rest. Its strikes are modest in raw power, but it has perfected the art of timing them to upset an opponent's footing.

rites.name: Elarlenna
rites.text: Elarlenna is a bastion-concept of Ryellae's Arcane realm, a shield of woven will that a disciplined warrior raises from their own mind. It lasts a minute and shelters the nearby allies who stand within its circle.

rites.name: Alaannelora
rites.text: Alaannelora is a sentient psychic current that lingers in the rune-carved bones of the Ryellae deep wells, sharpening the will of anyone who lifts a blade in its name. Its touch doesn't wound the body so much as drown the mind, leaving foes staggered and unbalanced. Scholars argue whether it is a spirit, a habit of thought, or a dying god's last grudge.

rites.name: Ilyimiel
rites.text: Ilyimiel is a mind-concept born in the Arcane realm of Ryellae, an ever-shifting thought-current that a warrior can invoke to harden their will into living armor. Once roused in moments of peril, it knits wounds closed each turn and quickens the body until the surge fades or the bearer falls.

rites.name: Ilyenniel
rites.text: Ilyenniel is a mental discipline in the arcane powers of Ryellae, a focus of the mind that a practitioner awakens after rest to gain a temporary edge. Its shaping grants silent speech across a short distance, a brief burst of quickened stride, or a surge of bodily vigor. The effect fades when the next long rest comes.

rites.name: Ryerlinae
rites.text: Ryerlinae is a concept of dread-forged resonance in the Arcane realm of Ryellae, where a mind's fear can be lashed into a visible edge. Its strikes hollow out a target's resolve, leaving the struck one trembling until the next dawn of its own cycle. Those who resist are granted a day's immunity, a quiet cost the wielder accepts.

rites.name: Silerlae
rites.text: Silerlae is a veil of shimmering, humming static woven by the Ryellae's quiet-minded sensitives, used to dim their bodies from sight for a short while. The veil breaks the moment its wearer strikes or compels another mind to resist, and it refreshes only after a full night's rest.

rites.name: Mierlualys
rites.text: Mierlualys is a mind-cutting weapon-art of the Arcane realm of Ryellae, in which a wielder sharpens a manifested psychic edge and drives it straight through another being's thoughts. The strike can daze the target for a full turn, and each use consumes one of the blades held in the wielder's hand. Adepts train to sweep the edge across a foe's will with a single, measured motion.

rites.name: Silualys
rites.text: Silualys is a concept of dormant mental resonance in Ryellae, a faint thread of focused thought that lets a mind lightly touch and steer the material world. Its adepts describe it as quiet, precise, and almost unnoticed, shaping small things through will alone. Its reach has never been measured against anything larger than a single room.

rites.name: Mianwen
rites.text: Mianwen is a quiet discipline in Ryellae's arcane tradition that lets a practitioner, while carrying a sealed psionic focus, call forth a minor working as a swift flicker of intent. Its signature effect leaves those touched by it with no lasting enmity toward the caster once the working fades.

rites.name: Ryaliorae
rites.text: Ryaliorae is a quiet mental discipline in the Ryellae omniverse, letting a practitioner shape a telekinetic hand that vanishes from sight at will. Its three-year-old lineage is used mostly for delicate work: lifting fragile reliquaries, threading needles across a crowded hall, and nudging loose stones off ledges.

rites.name: Miareth
rites.text: Miareth is a quiet convention of the Ryellae arcane arts, a thought-forged refinement that lets a speaker send a whisper of meaning across any distance without gesture or breath. Its practitioners keep a focus stone against the heart so the working can be woven in the space of a glance. Elders of the E6 age regard it as the gentlest of the sealed arts.

rites.name: Lyala
rites.text: Lyala is a concept of luminous thought-form transformation, in which a practitioner dissolves their flesh into shimmering mental light for a short span, reshaping their appearance at will while gear fuses into the glow. The form grants resistance against both mental assault and ordinary blows, letting the user spellcast through pure intention. Its use is limited by the mind's capacity to rest and recover.

rites.name: Lyinwen
rites.text: Lyinwen is a concept of attuned mental discipline in the Ryellae omniverse, a practice in which the mind learns to bend three arcane threads: domination of will, distant sight, and force without touch. Adepts who master it can call on any of these threads without the usual ritual vessels, and each may unleash one unbidden surge before needing a full night's rest to draw on it again.

rites.name: Eliorimae
rites.text: Eliorimae is a binding-current that threads through the sealed vaults of Ryellae, where scholars channel their focused thought into a single pulse of force. It is said to sharpen any working woven from will, letting the caster lend their own keen reasoning to the strike against one chosen foe.

rites.name: Alaimeinys
rites.text: Alaimeinys is a concept of Ryellae's Arcane realm: a mind-born sheath of thought that lets a psion drift above the ground and slip through solid matter like mist through a crack. Stepping back into the flesh while lodged in stone or timber hurls the body outward, and each stride of that forced ejection wrenches it with a violent pulse of force.

rites.name: Venaemilla
rites.text: Venaemilla is a lingering psychic curse that Ryellae's Arcane scholars classify as a concept rather than a creature or place. It seizes a single mind within sight and drowns it in despair until the victim wrestles free through a mental struggle at the close of each turn. Its strength in this age lies less in destruction than in silencing the minds that wield magic.

rites.name: Lyenneth
rites.text: Lyenneth is a concept of the Arcane realm in the Ryellae universe, an intangible tide of clashing wishes that drowns a single mind in indecision. It is said to have been first named in the third age of the sixth era by scholars who watched a rival's will fracture under its pull.

rites.name: Eleirlora
rites.text: Eleirlora is a shielding discipline of the Arcane realm, practiced in the third age of the E6 cycle, in which the mind is wrapped in a tight spiral of recursive, self-echoing thought. Adepts who hold the spiral can deflect intrusions and burn away mental assault until their next turn comes around.

rites.name: Ryanae
rites.text: Ryanae is an arcane discipline in the realm of Ryellae, where practitioners drive a focused spike of unmaking thought into a single watcher's skull. Those struck stagger and can only flee, while the lucky who resist are merely dazed. Advanced adepts split the spike to pierce several minds at once when they stand close together.

rites.name: Silalys
rites.text: Silalys is a mind-born force of the Arcane realm, an invisible surge that a practitioner directs outward through a widening cone of focused thought. Those caught within it are hurled back and thrown to the ground, though those who brace against its pull may shrug off most of its weight.

rites.name: Lyemeirwen
rites.text: Lyemeirwen is a mind-shattering discord that Ryellae's Arcane scholars classify as a concept rather than a practice, a thread of dissonance pulled through a single listener's thoughts. Its victims stagger in silence for a time, each beat of their attention contesting the noise until their own will reasserts itself.

rites.name: Orianiorlae
rites.text: Orianiorlae is a veil-weaving concept in the Arcane realm of Ryellae, a silvery haze that settles over a single creature's thoughts like fog over still water. Those who wear it cannot be read, pierced by mind-speech, or caught in a lie by any probing art, though the veil itself leaves no mark of its presence.

rites.name: Venirora
rites.text: Venirora is the quiet discipline of unseen grasp, a concept in Ryellae's Arcane realm where a practitioner learns to coax small objects and pressures across a room without touching them. Its adepts train until the invisible hand can nudge a rival's footing, though nothing in the art exceeds a bump or a tug.

rites.name: Ryemiel
rites.text: Ryemiel is a silver-threaded mind-weaver of the Arcane realm of Ryellae, able to hear and speak thought across a short gulf of air. Her gift sharpens her own reasoning and grants a knack for reading or swaying hearts. Within the Arcane powers of the E6 era she is a quiet hub of understanding rather than a force of destruction.

rites.name: Oriinneth
rites.text: Oriinneth is a feral spirit that dwells within the Arcane realm of Ryellae, awakening in those who take on the shape of the beast. Its power grows over time, lending natural claws and fangs the strength to pierce wards meant to turn away ordinary blows. It can also reshape a bearer's body to suit the terrain, granting swimming, climbing, or greater leaps for a time after each rest.

rites.name: Siluarlora
rites.text: Siluarlora is a feral curse-spirit of Ryellae's Arcane realm, bound to those who howl in ritual frenzy. When its host lands a blow while berserk, it can drive the victim's mind into savage rage, forcing a lashing counterstrike or a flood of psychic agony.

rites.name: Alaimora
rites.text: Alaimora is a sanctified frenzy-rite of Ryellae's ash-marsh clans, a ferocity that can be kindled in willing companions and shared like a flame passed hand to hand. Those touched by it fight recklessly and gain a surge of borrowed vitality, while the kindler's own spirit steadies against terror. The rite may be enacted only a limited number of times between restorations at dawn.

rites.name: Eleraema
rites.text: Eleraema is a healing discipline practised by the Vellon monks of Ryellae, who channel restorative breath into their palms to knit torn flesh. Its adepts treat each mending as a small, deliberate act, and a skilled hand can restore a fallen ally between blows of combat. The discipline is considered gentle and unassuming, though the Vellon teach that its quiet pulse once rebuilt a mountain-sized sanctuary after an earthquake.

rites.name: Silimeirora
rites.text: Silimeirora is a dormant mineral-current of Ryellae's arcane deep, a glowing vein that stores old song as pressure. When disturbed by a living hand it releases one measured pulse of withering force, and only once per cycle of the tide. It is rarely seen, as its power is spent the instant it is called.

rites.name: Ryiremys
rites.text: Ryiremys is a concept of a radiant brine-mist that clings to the wearer of a warding sigil, rendering the air around them too thick for arrows and spells to pass cleanly. Those who linger in its drift grow sluggish and wracked with fevered sickness until the mist is called back. Its power is modest, meant for guardians of the Arcane realm rather than for sieges.

rites.name: Elerimeth
rites.text: Elerimeth is a concept of quiet restoration in the arcane realm of Ryellae, a discipline that mends bodies by tracing and unwinding the faint threads of illness and sensory loss. Practitioners of this art can, alongside their gentle healing, dissolve a single affliction gripping a patient, clearing blindness, deafness, paralysis, or poison from the flesh.

rites.name: Miireth
rites.text: Miireth is a concept of the Arcane realm in the Ryellae omniverse, a sanctuary-art that lets a practitioner halt a living being's passage through time. Its stillness is so complete that even the sharpest sight and the subtlest sorcery read the held creature as already gone. A single hold may stand at any moment, so Miireth keeps its pause for one trusted soul at a time.

rites.name: Lyinniomora
rites.text: Lyinniomora is a concept of quiet warding within the Arcane realm of Ryellae, an invocation where a bearer lends their steadfast presence as a shield for nearby allies against mental snares. It is measured in the Era E6 and only two cycles old, so its sway remains modest and mostly felt in councils and vigils.

rites.name: Miannae
rites.text: Miannae is a radiant sentinel of Ryellae's arcane realm, able to sear the unworldly apart with a flare of pure sanctified light. Its presence alone drives back elementals, fey, fiends, and aberrations within earshot, forcing them to flee its reach. Those it cannot banish it still scorches into ruin when it lets its full radiance burst forth.

rites.name: Miareth
rites.text: Miareth is a sentinel-concept of Ryellae's Arcane realm, a resonant pattern of wakefulness that hums through the ground of the E6 age and sharpens every mind near it. Its presence is not a weapon but an attentive field, lending the minds around it reflexes that were once measured only by the Ryellan wardens who first charted it. Its influence grows with age, reaching far enough to warn an entire camp before the first blade is drawn.

rites.name: Silinnama
rites.text: Silinnama is a ward-glyph concept of the Arcane realm in Ryellae, born in the third age of the E6 era, that answers hostile sorcery by reflecting its failure back onto the caster. When a guarded soul shrugs off an enchantment, the glyph flares and lashes the hand that cast it with a burst of raw force.

rites.name: Lyiraennae
rites.text: Lyiraennae is a sanctified warden of the Ryellae powers, bound by an oath to keep the boundaries between worlds intact. When her vow is invoked, she can briefly kindle a radiant ember of her patron's light that pierces illusion and drives back uninvited outsiders to their homes.

rites.name: Venuarlora
rites.text: Venuarlora is a concept of quiet warding in Ryellae's arcane realm, an old pact that wraps its bearer in a single chosen element after every restful night. Its sphere is a shield rather than a weapon, and it is said to pass that shield to whoever is bound to its keeper's vessel.

rites.name: Ryarla
rites.text: Ryarla is a concept of ward-bargaining drawn from the Arcane realm of Ryellae, where a vessel-bound spirit can be petitioned for a shield over a chosen soul. When an incoming blow threatens that soul or its bonded companion, the ward lets both swap places in an instant, so the strike lands on the other instead.

rites.name: Veneilwen
rites.text: Veneilwen is a court-bound spirit of the Ryellae Arcane realm, a tithe-collector who summons wandering minds into the gilded halls of her sovereign. Those drawn in are stilled with wonder and entertained rather than harmed, and they may linger or find their way back through their own struggle against the pull. She is one of few who can open such doors on command, and each use drains her until she rests.

rites.name: Oriimys
rites.text: Oriimys is a concept of a patron's favor in the Ryellae realm, an arcane grace that a supplicant may plead for when the stakes are high. Its gifts are gentle restorations and small confusions of the senses, yet the being can also fold ancient knowledge into a single breath. Each plea exhausts it until rest or until an offering of worldly wealth is carried to the patron's domain.

rites.name: Alaarleth
rites.text: Alaarleth is a sworn warden of the Ryellae concept-realm, a guardian who trades stored starlight for the right to shelter others from elemental harm. Each dawn after rest, the warden chooses one of four wild forces to ward against until the next long slumber, and may bind a single companion beneath the same shield through a faintly humming crystal vessel.

rites.name: Eluarora
rites.text: Eluarora is an abstract covenant-concept in the arcane realm of Ryellae, a gift that lets a bearer choose one of four elemental shields after each restful slumber. Its lingering ward can also be passed to a bound companion through a vessel of gathered echoes. Its reach is modest, shielding a mortal frame rather than reshaping the world.

rites.name: Lyemys
rites.text: Lyemys is an arcane concept in Ryellae, a quiet bargain struck between a patron and a chosen wielder who wears their protection like a shifting coat. Each time the wielder completes a long rest, a single elemental ward awakens, and it holds until the next restful night closes. Tethered companions may borrow that same shelter through a sealed vessel.

rites.name: Alaalionnys
rites.text: Alaalionnys is a sealed ward-spirit that drifts through the ember-lit halls of Ryellae's Arcane vaults, lending a single elemental shield to whoever rests beneath its gaze. Its tethered glass vessel can extend that same warding to a bound companion, so long as the tether holds.

rites.name: Ryeneth
rites.text: Ryeneth is a floating note of possibility that a bard releases to hover near an ally, storing a spark of borrowed courage. Its brief flicker can shatter nearby foes with a thunderclap, shield its bearer, or sharpen a failed attempt into success. In the Ryellae omniverse it is taught as the first and most humble song of making.

rites.name: Siluala
rites.text: Siluala is a dormant animating tune of the Ryellae's Arcane realm, held in the hands of wandering performers who coax ordinary objects into temporary, obedient motion. Its song lasts an hour, or until the vessel is broken, and only one object may dance at a time.

rites.name: Elaerleth
rites.text: Elaerleth is a concept in the Ryellae omniverse, a chorus-song that drifts through the Arcane realm of the fourth age. Its bearers can weave a single fleeting object of sung matter into being, wrapped in glimmering notes that hum softly to the touch.

rites.name: Alairiomys
rites.text: Alairiomys is a concept within the Arcane realm of Ryellae, a resonant force that answers a bard's chosen cadence with a ringing shockwave. Its power is measured not in strength but in the stored tone of a single recited note, which can be unleashed to shatter nearby hearts and bones alike. Three ages old, it remains a quiet discipline that few have learned to voice.

rites.name: Orianeilae
rites.text: Orianeilae is a concept of resonant song-bindings in the realm of Ryellae, where a wandering chorus stores a sung note inside a listener's breath. When that breath falters against peril, the stored note bursts forth as a shield of living warmth that cushions the body until it fades.

rites.name: Elannereth
rites.text: Elannereth is a concept of resonant attention in the arcane realm of Ryellae, a quiet pull that lets a listener reach again for a fleeting favor and keep whichever reach lands truer. Its wielders describe it as a second breath taken before the first is spent, a gift of hesitation turned into advantage.

rites.name: Ryemaerlys
rites.text: Ryemaerlys is a resonant lattice of silvered glass that hums through the Ryellae reaches as a conduit of arcane tuning. Its bearers are said to shed a stroke of force and then flicker sideways out of the strike's wake before the echo lands.

rites.name: Veniollys
rites.text: Veniollys is a concept of stillness woven through the arcane powers of Ryellae, a principle that the shape of a thing belongs only to itself. Scholars in the sixth era of Ryellae describe it as a silent ward that no incantation can bend into a new outline. It is held as a theory rather than a physical artifact, invoked to explain why certain ancient relics never warp.

rites.name: Oriinora
rites.text: Oriinora is a dormant concept of cadence-woven resonance, imagined by the scholars of Ryellae's third age as a bridge between song and force. Its theorists held that a single struck chord could unmake a hostile rhythm, though no practitioner ever sustained the notion long enough to test it.

rites.name: Siliominiel
rites.text: Siliominiel is a silver-threaded ward-lattice of the Ryellae Arcane sphere, woven in the third age of the sixth era to bind allied wills together. Its strands tighten when bonded souls draw near, lending each a fragment of the other's resolve for a single breath of effort.

rites.name: Ilyemae
rites.text: Ilyemae is a concept in the Arcane realm of Ryellae, a bond-woven force that spreads a wounded creature's suffering across the willing companions standing near it. Its authors wrote it into the Arcane era E6 as a stabilizer of group survival rather than a weapon. Its energy is measured against the scale of the fights its bearers survive.

rites.name: Silarleina
rites.text: Silarleina is a bond-weaving concept in the Arcane realm of Ryellae, in its third age of the sixth epoch. Two souls who share a thread of trust can shield one another from harm when they stand near each other.

rites.name: Oriemora
rites.text: Oriemora is a quiet discipline of the Ryellae arcane arts, taught in the third age of the sixth era by hermit-scholars who bind their inner stillness into the sparks they cast. Its practitioners learn that a spell's force grows with the steadiness of the mind that shapes it. The art is valued more for consistency than for spectacle.

rites.name: Silaemwen
rites.text: Silaemwen is a concept in the Arcane realm of Ryellae, a bond-weaving principle that links allied souls across any plane they share. When one linked soul falls, the other is steadied with heightened resolve and shielding, and may draw strength from its own reserves to restore the fallen one.

rites.name: Alaareth
rites.text: Alaareth is a drifting orrery-spirit of Ryellae's silver tide-cities, a mechanism of brass moons that turns the wheels of time for those it favors. It can stall a falling bell mid-toll or hurl a city's ceremonial gears across a bay, tuning its own tick to outlast nearly any storm.

rites.name: Lyinualys
rites.text: Lyinualys is a concept in Ryellae's Arcane realm, a quiet tether to a lattice of perfect sequence that stills the wild tilt of fortune around a chosen observer. In the Sixth Era of the fourth age, its bearers can cancel the doubled or halved luck of a nearby soul, though only a limited number of times between restful pauses.

rites.name: Silionneth
rites.text: Silionneth is a concept of ordered warding in the Arcane realm of Ryellae, where a shimmering lattice of structured light can be drawn around a bearer and dissolve incoming harm. Each thread of the lattice is a small, spendable fragment of order that absorbs blows when called upon. The ward endures until the caster rests or chooses to renew it.

rites.name: Venionimeth
rites.text: Venionimeth is a concept of Ryellae's Arcane realm in the fourth age, a stilled moment of mechanical resolve in which a mind briefly rewinds its own errors. Those who enter it can refuse the worst outcomes of any test, and their enemies lose the ease of striking them cleanly. It can be called on once per rest, or again at the cost of a spent reserve of arcane pulses.

rites.name: Lyennae
rites.text: Lyennae is a concept of restorative order in Ryellae's arcane realm, a cube of tireless gleaming spirits that mend wounds, repair broken things, and unravel spells across thirty feet. Its power is measured in small gestures of balance rather than destruction, sustaining the living and the made within its reach.

rites.name: Veniomwen
rites.text: Veniomwen is a concept from the Arcane realm of Ryellae, a standing ward-tradition in its sixth age that lets a chosen practitioner keep a fixed roster of spells ready without drawing on their daily allotment. Its wardings grow in strength as the practitioner advances through the disciplines, from simple force-bolts to walls that can pierce stone.

rites.name: Ryennaliel
rites.text: Ryennaliel is a dormant resonance woven into the shimmering veils of Ryellae's Arcane realm, a principle that doubles the rhythm of a bearer's strikes whenever they reach for their weapon. In its third age of the sixth era, scholars note it has become a quiet current that lets any hand move twice in the span of one heartbeat.

rites.name: Oriileinnae
rites.text: Oriileinnae is a concept-class ward-engine lattice that Ryellae's arcane artificers grow inside the armored shells of their war-suits, a self-sustaining knot of resonant glyphs. It stores and redirects arcane tension so that a wearer can haul a fleeing foe back across the field or blaze a faint shimmer onto a marked target. Its bearers treat it as a quiet, almost domestic tool rather than a weapon of great destructive reach.

rites.name: Nuella
rites.text: Nuella is a concept of arcane gauntlet-craft in the realm of Arcane, forged in the sixth era of Ryellae and only three ages old. Her plated fists hum with stored storm-charge that discharges in sharp thunderclaps on contact, and any foe struck by them is left dazed and drawn toward her, unable to focus on anyone else until the next turn.

rites.name: Sileinna
rites.text: Sileinna is a ward-song drawn from the hum of the Ryellae tide-chimes, letting a bearer bind a thin shell of protective resonance around their body each turn. The shell fades the moment the bearer sheds their worn sigil-plate, so it must be kept close to the skin. It has not been tested against the sky-quakes of the outer reaches.

rites.name: Venaemeilae
rites.text: Venaemeilae is a gravitic tether discovered by Ryellae tinkerers who learned to bend the hum of armor cores into a pulling field. It seizes a foe as they end a move within sight and drags them close enough to strike.

rites.name: Lyerleth
rites.text: Lyerleth is a concept-born arcane current in the Ryellae omniverse, a luminous residue left in any being struck by a storm-born discharge. Those marked by it shine faintly until the next dawn of their attacker's turn, and anyone else who strikes them finds their aim strangely sharpened.

rites.name: Silarioleth
rites.text: Silarioleth is a starborn guardian of the Ryellae cosmos, a figure whose body is a living chart of drifting lights that its devotees read like scripture. In the Arcane realm of the E6 era, it can bend the three ancient sky-patterns into its flesh, healing the wounded, loosing shafts of pure luminance, or steadying a mind against the storm of sorcery. Its power is considerable but bounded by the reach of its own starlight.

rites.name: Nuinaerlys
rites.text: Nuinaerlys is a radiant sigil that manifests as a luminous chalice in the sky above a practitioner of the Luminist tradition. When the bearer channels a restorative rite, the sigil pours a surge of life‑energy, instantly replenishing 1d8 plus half the caster’s level in vitality for any creature within a thirty‑foot radius. The effect is subtle yet profound, turning the act of healing into a shared blessing that echoes across the realm.

rites.name: Nuelirora
rites.text: Nuelirora is a starborne concept in the Ryellae omniverse, an archer-shaped constellation that lends its favor to those who bear its mark. Its bearers gain a swift quickened shot, loosing a luminous shaft of pale light at a foe they can see across a modest span of ground. The arrow's sting grows with the bearer's inner clarity and steadiness of spirit.

rites.name: Venuariola
rites.text: Venuariola is a lattice of luminous sigils that drifts above the bearer's shoulders like a patient observer's gaze, lending steadiness to a mind wrestling with fragile workings. In the Arcane realm of Ryellae's third age, it is said to stiffen resolve at the moment a spell threatens to unravel. Its wielders treat it less as a gift than as a quiet co-author of their discipline.

rites.name: Oriilys
rites.text: Oriilys is a concept-level arcane principle in Ryellae's Sixth Age, the faint hand that tilts fate by a few points whenever a gaze falls upon a chosen witness. Its bearers read the lattice of distant suns and whisper wagers into the flow of luck. It is less a weapon than a quiet thread pulled through the great loom of destiny.

rites.name: Siluameth
rites.text: Siluameth is a veiled tide of starlight that lives between the cracks of the Ryellae sky, drawn into the minds of those who learn to hum to dead constellations. Its bearers lose their weight for a time, letting blades and blunt iron pass through them like rain through mist. Those who stay in the veil too long forget which side of the sky they were born beneath.

rites.name: Siluarlora
rites.text: Siluarlora is a conceptual lattice of woven starlight that the Ryellae mystics call the Dawn Loom, a scattering of cold fire seeded across the sky of the Arcane realm. Its brilliance can be drawn down in a single blinding flare that repositions allies and sears foes with radiance. The Loom persists through the seventh age of the realm, though its strands dim whenever the old constellations shift.

rites.name: Ryirae
rites.text: Ryirae is a concept of drifting sylvan moonlight in the Arcane realm of Ryellae, a pale luminous current that bends the paths of travelers who walk beneath it. Its wisdom is subtle, teaching lost wayfarers to seek out the hidden seams between mortal and glimmering worlds. It is less a being than a standing tide of enchantment, felt more than seen.

rites.name: Oriemys
rites.text: Oriemys is a concept of guarded minds and silver tongues, a quiet discipline in the Arcane realm of Ryellae that teaches the bearer to resist enchantment and fear while bending others with words. Its adepts are said to slip free of hypnotic songs and to make a crowd laugh, weep, or trust on a single sentence. Its power is social rather than cataclysmic, drawing on the mind and the voice.

rites.name: Silinualora
rites.text: Silinualora is a concept of mind-scarring enchantment bred in the lightless hollows of Ryellae's sunken fey courts, where it is said to be woven from the echoes of despair. Those who carry it can sheathe their blades in a dark psychic sheen that lingers for a single breath of battle, then fades like frost in dawn light. It belongs to the Arcane realm's third age and is remembered more for its cruelty than its reach.

rites.name: Orianae
rites.text: Orianae is a concept of the Arcane realm in the Ryellae universe, a discipline of stolen dreams and borrowed seasons taught to wanderers who walk between twilight and sunlit glades. Its practitioners press a single fear-laden note into a foe at the moment of a strike, and can charm others through the simple truth of being understood.

rites.name: Ilyemioniel
rites.text: Ilyemioniel is a concept of mental current in Ryellae, a dreaming tide that runs between minds and lets a resolute ally's composure be turned outward as a sway over a rival's thoughts. Its wielders are said to move like weather through crowds, redirecting fear or fascination toward whoever stands nearest the edge of their attention.

rites.name: Sileilae
rites.text: Sileilae is a concept in the Arcane realm of Ryellae, a quiet art of slipping out of mind-sight so completely that a watcher forgets one was ever there. Practitioners stake their presence against a target's resolve, and a failed attempt leaves that target blind and deaf to them for a full day. The effect can be shaken loose by sustained pressure, and a resisting mind is shielded from the attempt for a week.

rites.name: Venualora
rites.text: Venualora is a corrosive arcane current, a sheet of shimmering green vapor that its wielder projects along a chosen line through the air. Anything it touches is coated in a clinging, sizzling residue that eats at flesh and armor alike until someone scrapes or rinses it away. The current is taught in the Ryellae academies as a discipline of patience rather than brute force.

rites.name: Elerlae
rites.text: Elerlae is a sigil-bound pact-form, a shimmering contract of ash and light that a caster speaks into being to borrow the infernal or celestial tides. Its bearer grows spectral pinions, turns aside the ravages of flame and venom or of radiance and madness, and strikes with a double cadence. Within the Arcane realm of Ryellae, it is taught only in the third age's quietest schools.

rites.name: Elenneireth
rites.text: Elenneireth is a concept of Ryellae's Arcane realm, a veil of bound grief that gathers the restless dead into a wreath around a single willing chosen. Those spirits cannot be touched or unmade, and every strike struck near their keeper carries the chill or the light of their memory into the wound.

rites.name: Nuirliomwen
rites.text: Nuirliomwen is a summoning rite that tears open a crack in the sky of Ryellae and draws through a thing from beyond the Veil of Cinders. The spirit takes whatever shape the summoner's will prefers, wearing eyes, tendrils, or gleaming crystal, and it answers only to spoken commands. Its tenure in the mortal plane is fleeting, for it unravels once wounded or when the rite's threads fray.

rites.name: Veneimiorys
rites.text: Veneimiorys is a summoned beast-spirit of the Ryellae arcane tradition, drawn from the wild places of the realm and given brief corporeal form at a caster's call. Its bond is loyal and temporary, dissolving when wounded past endurance or when the spell's threads are released.

rites.name: Ryinae
rites.text: Ryinae is a radiant herald summoned from a sky beyond the veil, a being of folded light that answers a caller's word and vanishes once its sustaining thread breaks or its task closes. Its manifestations are measured in the banners of the Ryellae chroniclers, who record each appearance as a small revelation rather than a conquest.

rites.name: Eleinuarwen
rites.text: Eleinuarwen is a bound elemental spirit of the Ryellae arcane tradition, summoned from the outer planes and given a shape wreathed in its chosen element. It serves its caller faithfully for a single working, then unravels back into its home plane once its strength is spent or the binding ends.

rites.name: Miirwen
rites.text: Miirwen is a capricious spirit of the Ryellae powers-tradition, summoned in one of three moods that shape its form and temperament. It serves its summoner loyally for a short span, vanishing when wounded or when its binding ends.

rites.name: Venimora
rites.text: Venimora is a spectral fiend summoned in Ryellae's arcane circles, a manifestation of ember-black wings and shifting infernal sigils. It answers its summoner's commands for a brief span, then unravels back into the ash-choked depths from which it came.

rites.name: Elioniel
rites.text: Elioniel is a spirit-summoning art of the Ryellae arcane realm, drawing shadowy wraiths out of a hidden twilight dimension. Those who call it must bind the summoned spirit to a dominant emotion that shapes its ragged, twisted body. The spirit serves its summoner briefly before dissolving back into the dark.

rites.name: Oriarys
rites.text: Oriarys is a sigil‑bound conduit that summons a wandering echo from the Void. The echo appears as a translucent, shifting silhouette that can take on the guise of a mist, a roiling ash cloud, or a skeletal husk, each with distinct abilities. It lingers until its essence is exhausted or the sigil is broken, offering aid to those who invoke it.

rites.name: Venilleth
rites.text: Venilleth is a psionic wellspring within the Ryellae omniverse, a self-renewing reservoir of mind-force that waxes and wanes with every use. Its bearers can shield allies with telekinetic walls, leap across chasms, or drive blows with a surge of unseen force.

rites.name: Venara
rites.text: Venara is a shimmering psychic ward woven by the Ryellae mind-scholars of the Arcane realm, able to blunt harm aimed at a nearby ally or at the caster. It is a reflexive lattice of thought that bends incoming force aside as it lands. Its strength grows with the wielder's mental discipline, making it a prized defense across the young Ryellae age.

rites.name: Mieruanna
rites.text: Mieruanna is a seventh-age arcane discipline in Ryellae, practiced by wardens who bend their own momentum across the ruined ley-roads of the E6 realm. Its practitioners can stretch a leap far beyond natural reach, paying only a sliver of their stride for the privilege. The art is respected as a quiet craft rather than a weapon.

rites.name: Miaruaniel
rites.text: Miaruaniel is an arcane concept from the Ryellae omniverse, a discipline of kinetic resonance taught in the sixth era to bind a practitioner's will to the weapon in hand. Each strike can be followed by a pulse of pressure drawn from the practitioner's own latent potential, delivered at close range.

rites.name: Orielaemeth
rites.text: Orielaemeth is a meditative discipline in the Ryellae omniverse, a stillness that lets an adept quiet the storm of their own mind and reset a surge of inner force to its first, humble measure. It can be drawn upon only once before the adept must rest fully to recover the wellspring.

rites.name: Veniolwen
rites.text: Veniolwen is a mind-forged discipline of the Ryellae Arcane realm, practised by wardens who bind their will to the weight of falling stars. Its adepts can hurl a foe across a field by thought alone, and the strongest of them can unmake a sealed vault by pulling its keystone from across the sky.

rites.name: Miariomiel
rites.text: Miariomiel is a dormant crystalline lattice drifting through the Ryellae ether, its song bending the gravity of nearby stars. Mystics of the E6 age learned to tune their minds to its harmonics, though the cost of each attunement is paid in memory.

rites.name: Sileimys
rites.text: Sileimys is a telekinetic discipline of the Ryellae omniverse, practiced by wandering archivists who lift stones and friends alike with a silent, focused will. Its adepts draw upon a finite reserve of inner resonance that thins with each use, forcing them to choose carefully what they carry through the air.

rites.name: Nuirualla
rites.text: Nuirualla is a discipline of inner tempering practiced by the Veilward monks of Ryellae's third age, who channel a silver current of thought through the marrow to harden flesh against venom and mental assault. Adepts are said to shrug off toxins that would fell a dragon and to hold their minds steady against the screaming of a collapsing star-temple. Its power is considered the quiet foundation of the realm's arcane martial traditions.

rites.name: Orianaella
rites.text: Orianaella is a warding concept in the Ryellae arcane realm, a discipline of braided starlight that binds protective lattices around allies in a single breath. Her wards lend half-cover against blows for a short span, and she can only weave them again after long rest or by spending a deeper reserve of her own power.

rites.name: Venemeth
rites.text: Venemeth is a silent resonance woven into the dreaming lattice of Ryellae, a concept that sings through the minds of its archivists rather than any physical body. Its custodians draw it into the world by tuning their own thoughts, and each invocation slightly dulls the reservoir they draw from. It is an art of gentle leverage, not of raw force.

rites.name: Elalora
rites.text: Elalora is the discipline of mind-borne aid, a sustained ritual in which a practitioner's trained craft is lifted by a quiet inner current when skill alone falls short. Its adherents describe a flicker of foreign resolve that steadies a failing hand or sharpens a faltering judgment at the critical instant. Scholars of the Arcane realm rank it as a modest but reliable art, its reach limited to refining what the body and training already know.

rites.name: Ryannaelys
rites.text: Ryannaelys is a silent weaver of minds from the Arcane realm of Ryellae, whose thoughts thread between allies across a mile of stone and air. Its gift is for quiet passage, binding companions into a shared whisper that outlasts any shared tongue. Its own strength is spent on nothing louder than a hush.

rites.name: Oriennaerys
rites.text: Oriennaerys is a psychic blade-craft of the Ryellae powers, in which a practitioner's thought takes shape as a slender edge of luminous mind-force. Each blade is summoned from an open hand, strikes once with keen precision, and dissolves the instant it lands or misses, leaving nothing behind but a faint ringing in the air. Masters learn to conjure a second blade as a swift follow-up strike.

rites.name: Ryanneth
rites.text: Ryanneth is a concept of arcane will that exists as a thin vein of psionic light running through the Ryellae cosmos, a power that bends the blades of a mind into instruments of place and aim. Its essence is measured in how far a single thought can carry a body across a field of stars. Its wielders treat distance as a decision rather than a fact.

rites.name: Silionora
rites.text: Silionora is a resonance-tuned discipline of the Ryellae Arcane order, in which a practitioner's thought is hammered into lattices of humming crystal that bend the wills of nearby minds. Its tacticians trade a sliver of the mind's latent capacity for a last-moment surge of focus, so a near-failed strike can be pushed across the line, though each such rescue permanently dulls the instrument. Its adepts treat the dulling as a sober tithe rather than a wound.

rites.name: Nuillae
rites.text: Nuillae is a mental discipline in Ryellae's arcane tradition where a practitioner flings a shard of focused thought across open air and steps into the spot it strikes. Each use drains the reservoir of the talent, which must be patiently restored over time.

rites.name: Silaraerlae
rites.text: Silaraerlae is a concept born in the Ryellae omniverse, a veil of shimmering psychic static that conceals a thing and all it carries from every sense in the Arcane realm. It lasts for ten minutes or until dismissed, but is torn away the moment its bearer strikes or compels another mind.

rites.name: Ryameinnora
rites.text: Ryameinnora is a concept in the Arcane realm of Ryellae, a mind-shaped rite in which a practitioner sits still for a tenth of a bell and lets the thought-current settle. The rite grants knowledge of a borrowed working for as many hours as the inner die reveals. It is a quiet, portable learning rather than a grand force.

rites.name: Venarleth
rites.text: Venarleth is a mental discipline in Ryellae's Arcane realm that lets a caster shape a spell through thought alone, dispensing with spoken syllables and hand motions. Those who master it feel the magic bloom behind their eyes before any gesture would have been needed.

rites.name: Ilyemannora
rites.text: Ilyemannora is a quiet mental weaving in the Arcane realm of Ryellae, a thread of shared thought stretched between two minds across the Vellonic hills. Its bearers are called Threadminds, and the lingering bond can carry whispered understanding for as long as the rolled measure allows. Ilyemannora binds only one listener at a time, and a new bond unravels the old.

rites.name: Alaerwen
rites.text: Alaerwen is a concept in the Arcane realm of Ryellae, a psychic resonance that rides along any spell a caster lets loose in the third age of the sixth era. Once per turn, the wielder can siphon a fleeting pulse of mind-force into a struck foe, turning ordinary damage into a second, invisible wound.

rites.name: Venarys
rites.text: Venarys is a late-era psychic metamorphosis that a Ryellae adept can invoke as a brief reshaping of flesh and bone, letting the body slip through gaps and rise on currents of thought. It is a personal art, valued for its utility rather than its violence, and its practitioners are trained to use it in the narrow spaces where ordinary strength fails.

rites.name: Oriamys
rites.text: Oriamys is a radiant psychic halo that an Arcane mind can wreath around itself for a minute, a crackling field that seizes the thoughts of anyone who steps inside. Those caught within feel their momentum drag and fray, and the aura's reach extends across a broad circle of ground. Its keeper spends the aura's strength in pulses, each one searing the minds nearby.

rites.name: Ilyilionae
rites.text: Ilyilionae is a concept of the Ryellae omniverse, a discipline of inward will in which a mind learns to govern its own flesh, sustaining the body and restoring its weariness through quiet focus. Practitioners of the Arcane realm cultivate this as a personal craft rather than a weapon, so its energies stay modest and intimate.

rites.name: Alaileinys
rites.text: Alaileinys is a gentle sorcerous discipline in Ryellae's Arcane realm, taught in the seventh age to anyone willing to practice patient, honest speech. Its practitioners refine their presence one careful notch at a time until their words carry naturally to listeners.

rites.name: Veneriliel
rites.text: Veneriliel is a concept of the Arcane realm in Ryellae's third age, a mental bulwark that turns a failed resistance into a success. It answers a mind's failure with a sudden surge of hidden will, reinforcing its own defenses or those of a companion within sight.

rites.name: Nueniel
rites.text: Nueniel is a psionic awakening in the Ryellae concept realm, a wellspring of mental force that swells and shrinks with each use. Its power grows with the one who wields it, and a conserved reserve can briefly flare into a planet-scale strike.

rites.name: Silaena
rites.text: Silaena is a discipline of the Arcane realm in the Ryellae omniverse, practiced in its seventh age by minds that bend fate by lending a sliver of inner resolve to any deed. Practitioners can fold a hidden surge of focus into a trial after the outcome is cast, though only before the outcome is seen.

rites.name: Siliriel
rites.text: Siliriel is an arcane discipline in the Ryellae omniverse, a mind-lattice that threads a practitioner's will into the fabric of a blow. Those who master it learn to let a single strike carry the weight of a sharpened thought, letting an ordinary hit briefly outshine its own force.

rites.name: Lyala
rites.text: Lyala is a discipline of the Arcane realm in the Ryellae omniverse, a practice of stilling one's inner tide so that a reserve of latent force settles back to its origin. Practitioners of the sixth era treat it as a quiet, repeatable reset that can be drawn upon only once before the body must rest.

rites.name: Oriamiolys
rites.text: Oriamiolys is an arcane conduit of the Ryellae realm, a shimmering lattice of bound memories that drifts among the ruins of an older age. It hums faintly whenever a traveller pauses to rest, offering whispered craft and forgotten lore to whoever bears its thread. Its gifts last only until it is drawn upon again, so every new reliance costs a fresh tether.

rites.name: Ilyanae
rites.text: Ilyanae is a concept in the Arcane realm of Ryellae, an echo of grief that lingers where the dying have passed. Its power lets a drawn-out sorrow spill into the world as a chorus of phantom mourning that strikes a second target near the first.

rites.name: Lyilys
rites.text: Lyilys is a soul-harvesting relic of the Ryellae dead-lands, a glassy ember that crystallizes from the last breath of anyone who dies near its bearer. Each captured ember carries the faint voice of its former owner, who may answer a single question before dissolving into light. The embers are kept in hollow reliquaries that hum when the bearer's heart stops.

rites.name: Ilyamiel
rites.text: Ilyamiel is a concept of spectral passage in the Arcane realm of Ryellae, where a practitioner can slip partway into the world beyond life. Its shifting form drifts on faint currents, passes through solid matter at the cost of a painful jolt if it lingers within, and must be renewed through rest or through the sacrifice of a bound keepsake.

rites.name: Eleirora
rites.text: Eleirora is a concept of the Arcane realm in the Ryellae universe, a tolling sorrow that rings outward from a single afflicted soul and strikes two listeners at once. Its echoes carry through the Sixth Era's ruined sanctuaries, where mourners still hear it when the wind moves through hollow bells.

rites.name: Siliona
rites.text: Siliona is a crystalline arcane principle in the Ryellae cosmos, a bedrock current that binds the mineral strata of the realm into slow, patient memory. Its adepts draw on its stillness to anchor wards and to hold fractured places together, though the tradition warns that unbridled tapping can crack the ground beneath them.

rites.name: Ryameth
rites.text: Ryameth is a wind-woven arcane current that drifts through the high valleys of Ryellae, carrying the scent of distant storms and whispered vows. In the sixth era it is said to answer any soul that breathes a true name into the gusts, though it rarely grants more than it is asked.

rites.name: Oriinys
rites.text: Oriinys is a bound lantern-spirit of the Ryellae arcane courts, a concept of kindled will that takes the form of a slow-burning ember wrapped in silver filigree. It grants wishes only to those who first feed it a memory they are willing to lose.

rites.name: Eleinora
rites.text: Eleinora is a tidal arcanist concept from the Ryellae omniverse, a bound wellspring of drowned moonlight that the Arcane realm's elders channel to quench seas of fire. Her power is said to rise and fall with the pull of the mirrored tides of Vessa, and she is remembered chiefly for calming the great flood-scars of the E6 age.

rites.name: Siliomiel
rites.text: Siliomiel is a sworn-pact channel of the Ryellae arcane tradition, a glimmering conduit through which a bonded wielder folds a patron's elemental wrath into a single strike. Each cycle of the wielder's rest-and-rise, one blow may carry an added surge of ember, frost, quake, or storm, scaled to the wielder's rising mastery.

rites.name: Elilys
rites.text: Elilys is a concept of drifting ether-skimming, a quiet power that lets its bearer ride the thin air of the Arcane realm for a span of minutes. Those who attune to it gradually take on a shielding resistance keyed to the element of their chosen patron. Its use is limited by a renewable tally that refills only after a full day of rest.

rites.name: Venaelenora
rites.text: Venaelenora is a concept of the Arcane realm in the Ryellae universe, a wish-bound patron that answers a single petitioner with one borrowed spell. Its grants are minor and temporary, yet the patron's power is vast enough that each favor draws quietly on the strength of a dying star's last light.

rites.name: Silioleth
rites.text: Silioleth is a bound spectral tome that has fused its soul with a scribe of the Order, letting the pair swap places across the veil at will. Each death it reverses costs the book written knowledge, leaving forgotten spells that only a grand restoration can return to its pages.

rites.name: Nuerliomae
rites.text: Nuerliomae is a concept of arcane inventiveness, a discipline that lets a practitioner borrow the craft of tinkering and turn it into a few reliable workings. Its adherents learn a small set of enchantments and may replace one as their understanding grows, drawing power through a favored set of tools. Within Ryellae, it is a modest art, valued for ingenuity rather than raw force.

rites.name: Ryerlys
rites.text: Ryerlys is a concept of an arcane chef-artisan in the Ryellae omniverse, whose hearth-craft fills the bellies of the weary and mends their wounds. Their culinary rites turn humble provisions into restorative feasts and small, lingering treats that steady the spirit in battle. Though modest in scale, their mastery is treasured across the Arcane realm of the E6 era.

rites.name: Eliorla
rites.text: Eliorla is a concept of the Arcane realm in Ryellae, a discipline of pressure-craft in which the practitioner learns to find the weak seam of any foe and press them where they least wish to stand. Its adepts are remembered less for raw force than for the way a single decisive blow can reposition an enemy and leave them open to the next strike.

rites.name: Eluamirae
rites.text: Eluamirae is a concept of a dormant eldritch wellspring that awakens in those who study forbidden lore, granting a single borrowed invocation that can be swapped as the bearer grows. Within Ryellae's Arcane realm, it is treated less as a power than as a door that the bearer chooses which hinge to open.

rites.name: Lyemiel
rites.text: Lyemiel is an arcane concept in Ryellae's Era E6, a faint silver sigil that appears on the skin of those who have brushed against the Thousand Glimmering Glades. Its bearers can slip briefly through space and read the intentions woven into events yet to come. The mark is said to have been carved by a fey patron who wished to see the future from a mortal's eyes.

rites.name: Silennila
rites.text: Silennila is a discipline of shifting ember-light practiced by the wardens of the Ryellae archipelago, who learn to bend a single style of flame around their blades. Its adepts may swap their chosen technique each time they advance, carrying the rhythm of their past lessons forward. The art is prized as a quiet, portable inheritance rather than a grand display of force.

rites.name: Venirae
rites.text: Venirae is a concept in the Arcane realm of Ryellae, a quiet marksman-spirit who has never needed a barrel to aim. Across the fourth age of the sixth era, the Venirae's sight is said to bend ordinary brass shot into arcs no mortal gunner could follow.

rites.name: Orialleth
rites.text: Orialleth is a concept of arcane will in the Ryellae omniverse, a discipline by which a caster bends the shape of their own spells through deliberate effort. Practitioners learn to alter a spell's behaviour at the moment of casting, drawing on a small well of refined mental force that refills after rest.

rites.name: Alaemaelys
rites.text: Alaemaelys is a concept of Ryellae's Arcane realm, a discipline of precision that lets a practitioner's blade find the seams in any defense. Its adepts learn to reroll a single misfortune during a strike and to channel an extra measure of force into every perfect blow. The art is said to have been taught by a river that never once washed over the same stone twice.

rites.name: Miilliomwen
rites.text: Miilliomwen is a poison-artisan concept in Ryellae's arcane realm, a craft that lets practitioners steep blades in venom faster than thought. Its adepts are said to distill toxins from dying stars' ash, though the source of their power is secret. Their poisons are known to pass through any ward against venom.

rites.name: Miinualwen
rites.text: Miinualwen is a quiet arcane discipline in Ryellae's sixth era, a practice of refining one's grasp of a chosen art until mastery sharpens the mind itself. Practitioners who reach its final stage can briefly bend a single learned craft into something that rewrites the physical world around them. The tradition is regarded as the most patient of all the arcane paths.

rites.name: Mierluannae
rites.text: Mierluannae is a shadow-weaver of the Ryellae arcane realm, a concept born in the third age of the sixth era, who learned to fold dusk into living cloth. Their craft lets them drape the dark over ordinary objects and spend it as a quiet, gloomy pressure that dims whatever it touches. They are celebrated as a scholar of twilight rather than a destroyer.

rites.name: Venamae
rites.text: Venamae is a concept of arcane discipline drawn from the Arcane realm of Ryellae, where a practitioner learns to bind protective wards into a hand-held ward-plate. The discipline's old masters held that a shield should be a conduit for will, not merely a barrier.

rites.name: Venela
rites.text: Venela is a concept in the Arcane realm of Ryellae, an insight into where a blade must cut to do the most harm. Her knowledge makes every slashing strike bite deeper, slowing foes and leaving wounds that cloud their aim.

rites.name: Ryalys
rites.text: Ryalys is a concept of inspiring presence in the Arcane realm of Ryellae, where a single figure's steady nerve lifts the spirits of everyone nearby. Its influence extends to the act of guiding allies toward a common foe, letting one signal sharpen two blades at once. In the Sixth Era it is taught as a quiet discipline rather than a spell.

rites.name: Veneiriomae
rites.text: Veneiriomae is the Hollow Tracer of the Ryellae's arcane wilds, a concept of a mind that reads the faint residue left by any living thing and binds its fate to a single pursued quarry. Those who walk its path can lend that focus to others, though the gift is said to wear down the tracer's own memory of the hunt.

rites.name: Elaeluanora
rites.text: Elaeluanora is a whispering spirit-weaver of the Ryellae omniverse, able to draw gentle unseen counsel from wandering ancestral echoes and pass it to allies. Her guidance reaches farther than any ordinary voice, sharpening the choices of those who listen.

rites.name: Elaema
rites.text: Elaema is a hollow, cold-burning lantern-spirit that drifts between the sunken cathedrals of Ryellae, collecting the last breaths of dying constellations. When it wakes, the stars of its old sky answer its call, and the light it kindles can scour whole regions of shadow.

rites.name: Alaamuana
