rites.text: Alaamuana is a ritual of borrowed insight, in which a circle of minds calls upon the watchers of the veil to whisper a single forbidden craft into one willing listener. Its power is quiet and carefully bounded, lasting only until the sleepers of the household rise again.

rites.name: Eleiniel
rites.text: Eleiniel is a semi-permanent binding of spirit and song, a thread that lets an ancient choir of wandering voices lend their resonance to every telling of a tale. Within Ryellae's arcane eras it is treated as a quiet inheritance, cherished more for its steadiness than its force. Its wielder can draw on the choir's breath as though it were a spare chord, sparing the hoarded inspiration that would otherwise be spent.

rites.name: Elaelimwen
rites.text: Elaelimwen is a concept from the Arcane realm of Ryellae, a transformation that wraps its bearer in a veil of dread drawn from a hidden sovereign of the deep ash-marshes. For one minute at a time, the bearer's form darkens into a shroud of drifting embers, and foes who are struck tremble in terror of the bearer's gaze. The form can be assumed as many times as the bearer's mastery allows, returning fully after a long repose.

rites.name: Siluamora
rites.text: Siluamora is a hollowed mystic-engine of Ryellae's Arcane realm, a frame of grey lacquer that drinks breath and thirst into a slow ember. Its touch can rewrite a blow's nature into a quiet rot, and when its shrouded aspect is raised it deepens that rot into a wound that refuses to close.

rites.name: Alaameth
rites.text: Alaameth is a concept of a grave-bound force in the Ryellae omniverse, a dark tide that lives inside the living and answers to rot and ending. When its bearer falls, the tide can burst outward through the body, scouring everything nearby before it returns the bearer to life with a faint hold on the world. Such bursts can be used only once in a long span of years.

rites.name: Elalwen
rites.text: Elalwen is a spirit-walker of the Ryellae's Arcane realm who can cast her soul free of her flesh, leaving a sleeping husk behind. While disembodied she drifts through stone and steel and can hang motionless in the air for as long as her will holds. Her released spirit can tear open a sealed vault or collapse a fortress wall with a single unleashed surge of her own vitality.

rites.name: Ilyaneth
rites.text: Ilyaneth is a sanctioned warden-engine of the Ryellae arcane order, a bound lattice of silver sigils that serves as a seat of judgment when no magistrate can be reached. Its wardens may pronounce and enact sentence in the field, but every binding is logged to the order's ledger, and any sentence found unjust is struck from the lattice and its bearer unmade.

rites.name: Miilla
rites.text: Miilla is a concept in the Ryellae omniverse: the sanctioned voice of a divine patron, through which instructors command their initiates. Those who abuse this authority are said to be struck down personally by the god they claim to speak for.

rites.name: Silemae
rites.text: Silemae is a concept of quiet ambition that spreads through whispered encouragement, teaching that a self-made path to the afterlife is worthy even when it crowds out others. Its power lies in the drive it kindles, which can reshape loyalty and purpose across an entire era of Ryellae.

rites.name: Alairwen
rites.text: Alairwen is a concept of arcane resonance in the Ryellae omniverse, a current of devotion that binds a practitioner's will to the rhythm of the deep ley. It is said to surge brightest when its bearer willingly surrenders the self to a shared purpose.

rites.name: Ilyeniel
rites.text: Ilyeniel is a concept of the Arcane realm in Ryellae, the still-forming discipline of a warden who teaches by standing unafraid at the edge of the wastes and letting students witness his resolve. Its essence holds that strength is never spoken but earned, and that the ones who watch are shaped by what they observe and then attempt to copy.

rites.name: Nuana
rites.text: Nuana is a sealed arcane discipline in Ryellae that measures devotion by the force of a practitioner's surrender to the unseen. Its adepts channel longing into controlled bursts of raw power, and the most devoted can bend a single hour of their own duration into something that feels eternal.

rites.name: Veneimora
rites.text: Veneimora is a dreamlike concept in the Arcane realm of Ryellae, an ink-shadow that the Ryellae mystic-sisters call the Veil of Dusk. Its bearers can dissolve their lower bodies into drifting smoke, rising on the night wind for a short span before settling back into flesh.

rites.name: Ryiruallae
rites.text: Ryiruallae is a lattice of silver-thread familiars woven by the artificers of Ryellae's third age, each one a tiny clockwork spirit bound to a single apprentice's will. Its arcane ritual lets a mage animate a bell-sized construct that speaks with the caster's voice and shares their senses across the planes. The entry is a craft and a bond rather than a force of nature, so its releases are small and its endurance modest.

rites.name: Venaelameth
rites.text: Venaelameth is a concept of quick, improvised sorcery in the Ryellae omniverse, where a practitioner coaxes short-lived workings out of aether using tinkered mechanisms and borrowed rites. Its craft is modest in scale, yet its ingenuity has let minor magic spread into everyday life across the Arcane realm.

rites.name: Elemora
rites.text: Elemora is a quiet concept in the Ryellae cosmos, an arcane principle that teaches minds to lean on accumulated study when reasoning through puzzles. Practitioners in the E6 era describe it as a tide of half-remembered lessons lifting each careful thought.

rites.name: Nuarliolae
rites.text: Nuarliolae is a silent, sight-bound art of the Arcane realm in the Ryellae cosmos, taught in the seventh age of the Sixth Era to wardens who read distant currents of light. Its practitioners sense hidden threads of meaning across great gulfs and loose their force without fear of the far distance blunting their aim.

rites.name: Ilyaminiel
rites.text: Ilyaminiel is a crystalline binding of arcane sympathy in the Ryellae cosmos, a concept that lets its wielders weave resonance between minds and sigils. Its earliest lattice was sealed in the sixth age, and its practitioners still tune the old harmonies by ear.

rites.name: Sileilaena
rites.text: Sileilaena is a quiet doctrine of the Ryellae's deep-stone tradition, a discipline in which practitioners learn to fold their presence into the grain of the earth. Its adepts can slip past sentinels in caverns and fissured cliffs as though they were a seam of the rock itself.

rites.name: Siliora
rites.text: Siliora is a dormant arcane principle in the Ryellae cosmos, the quiet thread that binds unlocked doors to the will of those who open them. It is said to have been woven during the sixth age as a way to measure how far intent can bend a lock's own geometry.

rites.name: Orielioneth
rites.text: Orielioneth is a veiled warding discipline of the Ryellae arcane schools, practiced by wanderers who refuse heavy shells and trust suppleness over plate. Its adepts can shrug off scorching flame and the mind-piercing whispers of the deep, and a body left bare of metal gains a reflexive evasion drawn from quick, practiced footwork.

rites.name: Elenareth
rites.text: Elenareth is a quiet doctrine of the Ryellae arcane schools, a discipline in which a striking hand leaves behind no opening for the enemy to exploit. Practitioners who commit a blow to a foe find that the foe cannot pounce upon their withdrawal until the turn has fully ended.

rites.name: Veniollima
rites.text: Veniollima is a rune-sigil of the Arcane realm's sixth era, etched into the soles of wayfarers' boots to let them sprint over shattered ground without stumbling. Its bearers claim the glyph lightens the body for a single stride-burst, though sages argue it merely borrows the momentum of the world itself.

rites.name: Miallineth
rites.text: Miallineth is a sealed resonance of the Ryellae arcane lattice, a rule-thread that binds a traveller's vitality and grows it with each crossing of a threshold of experience. Those who draw upon it find their endurance swelling in steady increments, two points at a time, as their mastery deepens over the years.

rites.name: Veniometh
rites.text: Veniometh is a cold-shrugging arcane discipline in the Ryellae cosmos, a practice that lets its wielders stand unharmed in any frost, from glacier winds to the hollow vacuum between suns. Adepts of the sixth epoch treat chill as a tide they can wade through rather than a wound they must endure.

rites.name: Venila
rites.text: Venila is a bonding-art in the Arcane realm of Ryellae, an ancient discipline in which two souls are woven into a single resonance that persists through the seventh age. Practitioners who keep their paired soul within sight may catch a failing moment and reshape it into a fresh attempt, while those who have lost their pair are left immune to terror.

rites.name: Venuamora
rites.text: Venuamora is a concept of the Arcane realm in Ryellae, a tide-bound creed whose devotees measure their oaths against the slow pull of distant moons. It is said to gather the scattered breath of storms into a single drawn-out lament that can unmoor coastal shelves. Its name is spoken more often as a warning than as a prayer.

rites.name: Elioreirlys
rites.text: Elioreirlys is a silver-tongued glamour woven into the speech of the Ryellae archons, a concept that bends listeners' perceived truth without touching their minds. It is most often wielded in the courts of the E6 era, where a single honeyed sentence can redirect the flow of allegiance across a continent.

rites.name: Elenae
rites.text: Elenae is a concept of quiet attunement in the Ryellae omniverse, a sense of the Arcane realm that lets a practitioner feel the slow pulse of growing things. In the E6 era, Elenae is three ages old, a young and humble current still learning its own reach.

rites.name: Ryinnys
rites.text: Ryinnys is a sealed resonance of the Ryellae's arcane tide, a concept-form rather than a body, that hums across the void-sea charting drifts for lost navigators. Its only recorded act was to fold a dying moon's orbit into a single bright seam, releasing energy comparable to a planet's destruction. Scholars of the E6 age still debate whether it was ever truly a being.

rites.name: Silioramiel
rites.text: Silioramiel is a ward-glyph in the Ryellae arcane tradition, inscribed as a thin silver lattice that flares when its bearer would otherwise fall, holding them at the last heartbeat. Once the glyph has spent its breath, it stays dormant until its wearer has slept through a full night of quiet.

rites.name: Miinwen
rites.text: Miinwen is a fading sigil of the Ryellae Arcane, a rune-carved edge that lends a warrior's strike a second bite whenever a blow lands true. Its power is drawn from the ringing of struck steel, and it hums loudest when the wielder finds a perfect opening.

rites.name: Elaenarys
rites.text: Elaenarys is the Veilthread, a silver lattice of tempered sorcery that binds the blood of the Ryellae's oldest ward-wardens. Its wearers shrug off every venom, rot, and toxic breath, but the thread grows heavy with what it refuses, and too much absorbed corruption can collapse a ward into a single bright, poisonous flare.

rites.name: Miinneth
rites.text: Miinneth is the sealed grammar of tides that the Ryellae reef-scholars inscribed into the moon's wake during the sixth age. Its wording permits a single hour of uncorked oceanic force, and the scholars keep it locked behind seven tidal wards.

rites.name: Eliomenna
rites.text: Eliomenna is a crawling-gait discipline practiced by the ash-runners of Ryellae's dry highlands, who drop low and drive off the ground with their forearms to outpace danger for a brief span. The technique is taught as a short rite, not a mighty art, and its practitioners treat it as a quick, humble edge rather than a weapon.

rites.name: Eluaneth
rites.text: Eluaneth is a wind-threaded veil of arcane current in the Ryellae sky-lanes, a charm that lets its bearer lift and drift through the air so long as no heavy plating weighs the body down. Its carriers gather at the high ridges of the Vaelmoor to learn the old drifting rites before the seasonal gales arrive.

rites.name: Sileimeth
rites.text: Sileimeth is a quiet mnemonic weave in the Ryellae arcane tradition, a binding of memory and intention that lets its wielder kindle warmth and trust between strangers. Its practitioners teach it in the age of the Seventh Lantern, and it is valued more for its gentleness than for any destructive power.

rites.name: Siluanimeth
rites.text: Siluanimeth is a crimson-veined thorn-spirit of the Ryellae hollows that feeds on the warmth of those who lie still before it, whether they offer themselves or are pinned by its roots. Its touch leeches vitality, leaving the victim's strength diminished until a full night's rest restores it, and the drained vigor flows into the spirit itself. Left unchecked, it can wither a sleeper's life to nothing.

rites.name: Orieniel
rites.text: Orieniel is a loom-spell of the Arcane realm in Ryellae, a concept that binds the scattered threads of a dying sorcery into a single refrain. Practitioners in the E6 age, three ages after the great unraveling, use it to rewrite the memories of hollow wardens into obedient lanterns. Its power grows with each verse sung against the fading dark.

rites.name: Ilyannuarys
rites.text: Ilyannuarys is a veil-sigil of the Ryellae arcane realm, inscribed in a dying age of the seventh cycle to hold back the hollowing tides. Its wardens draw on it to unmake the grief-hungry entities that feed on mortal sorrow, though each use leaves the warden's own memories thinner.

rites.name: Elanora
rites.text: Elanora is a concept of a hushed grove-spirit in the realm of Ryellae, bound to the slow turning of seasons. She draws strength from the moon's silver tide, gathering it into a brief surge of sharpened reflexes and steadied limbs.

rites.name: Elinarwen
rites.text: Elinarwen is a silver-veined sanguine rite of the Ryellae arcane circles, a bargain of crimson tithe that quickens the limbs of whoever drinks. Those who taste the tithe swell with borrowed vigor, outpacing storms and bending iron.

rites.name: Eleiniola
rites.text: Eleiniola is a concept of resolve woven into the Arcane realm of Ryellae, a sheltering discipline that steadies the mind against sorcerous intrusion. In the third age of the sixth era, scholars taught that a settled will could turn aside spells the way a stone turns a stream.

rites.name: Lyarae
rites.text: Lyarae is a silent sigil-mind that lives inside the cracked lattice of ruined aether engines, remembering how each vanished device was forged. When it wakes, it can recite the exact making and failings of any relic it touches, reading the old craft as plainly as a scholar reads a letter. Its knowledge is strongest where the old engines once gathered the most power.

rites.name: Miirleinnae
rites.text: Miirleinnae is a flame-spirit of the Ryellae arcane courts, born three ages ago from a single ember that refused to die. Her blaze is less a power she wields than the substance of her own being, kindled and sustained by the attention of the circles that tend her.

rites.name: Ryeniel
rites.text: Ryeniel is a concept of ember-shaped sorcery bound to the Ryellae omniverse, where every incantation of a fire-kindled rite stirs a bursting heat from the caster's own body. Its flare scorches only those the caster chooses, sparing allies standing close by. In the third age of the Arcane realm it is studied as a mark of disciplined flame.

rites.name: Silara
rites.text: Silara is a sunless ember-weaver of the Ryellae Arcane concordance, whose dim lantern-scales drink flame until they glow with borrowed heat. Those who train under her learn to lend that stolen fire to their own sorceries, letting their spells pierce the hearths of rival wardens.

rites.name: Elarlys
rites.text: Elarlys is a flickering ember-dance that the sorcerers of Ryellae's Arcane realm call a reflexive heart-flame. When struck in melee, the bearer can answer with a scorching riposte that burns through even the strongest warding. Its power grows with the bearer's arcane mastery.

rites.name: Miira
rites.text: Miira is a dormant arcane principle in the Ryellae cosmos, a quiet ember that only wakes within those who have reached the highest tiers of their craft. Once awakened, it grants its bearer an absolute shelter against flame and lets every working they shape pierce the defenses that normally blunt heat.

rites.name: Nuallimae
rites.text: Nuallimae is a concept of a scholar-engineer who reads the hidden grammar of stone and gear, able to trace the intent behind any lattice of load-bearing arches or sluice works. Their mind can sense the strain that a vaulted hall has been built to endure, and their own tools respond to that understanding.

rites.name: Silaennae
rites.text: Silaennae is a concept of the Arcane realm in the Ryellae universe, a quiet cantrip-born power that grows with the wielder's wisdom and age. Its early workings are small, curses and bruising frost, while its later shadows can swallow a room whole.

rites.name: Eluarleth
rites.text: Eluarleth is the quiet art of vanishing into the world's own veils, drawing a sheltering stillness from leaves, sleet, and drifting haze. Its practitioners in Ryellae's shadowed groves can slip out of sight wherever weather and growth offer even the slightest concealment.

rites.name: Ilyimiel
rites.text: Ilyimiel is a dormant lattice of crystalline memory that hums beneath the Ryellae tundra, recording every season the world has forgotten. When its song is answered by a binding ritual, it can unmake the frost of a whole province in a single breath.
